fdroid:com.ashkanrafiee.balance.name: Balance
fdroid:com.ashkanrafiee.balance.description:
Balance turns supported SMS into balances, transaction history and payment reminders. Processing stays on your phone: no account, cloud service, analytics or internet permission. Saved financial records are encrypted; CSV exports are not.
Supports Persian SMS formats from Iranian banks and selected financial services. Accounts are shown separately when messages include an account number.
See your money clearly:
- Latest balances by bank and account, a combined total, and accounts you can exclude
- Configurable warnings for old balances, plus a home-screen widget
- Explanations for individual account balances and history entries
- Deposits and withdrawals by day, month and year; filters and search across history
- Unaccounted rows for changes between balance statements that recorded transactions do not explain — not invented transactions or guesses about missing payments
- Bank-stated reasons, payment channels and matched merchants when available; an OTP alone never confirms a transaction
- Save private notes and reusable tags together; export your filtered view as CSV
- One-off and recurring payments and receipts on consistent schedules, with separate payable and receivable totals
- Reminder taps open and highlight the due payment with its name and amount visible; Android restrictions can delay delivery
Choose how it looks:
- Persian or English, Persian or Gregorian calendar, light or dark mode and eight theme colors
- Toman (10 Rial), Rial or a custom unit label; a custom label does not convert currencies
- Optional balance masking and automatic hiding, both off by default
- Optional PIN, password or fingerprint lock, with widget protection and screenshot blocking
Stay in control:
- Turning off SMS access does not delete saved data
- Figures depend on accessible messages, not a live bank connection; missing, deleted or restricted SMS can leave gaps
- Safely re-read messages without clearing saved data; check exclusions when newly recognized accounts appear
- A separate full reset deletes balances, history and commitments after two confirmations; deleting notes and tags is optional. Back up first: scanning cannot recover deleted SMS
- Password-encrypted backups, including retained bank-message samples, and selective restore on the same or a newer app version
- Report shows parsing results and lets you choose samples to copy or email. OTP values are removed; review samples before sharing. Email needs your approval
Balance does not upload your data. Report, sharing, CSV export and backup hand selected data only to the app or location you choose.
Free and open source. Report a bank message or balance that looks wrong through Report.
Support development: https://github.com/AshkanRafiee/balance#donate

fdroid:com.openjump.app.summary: Analyze jumps and exercise velocity from video, offline
fdroid:com.openjump.app.description:
OpenJump measures athletic jumps from recorded or imported video. Select takeoff and landing frame by frame; calculations use the video's real presentation timestamps rather than its nominal frame rate.
• Six protocols: countermovement jump (CMJ), squat jump (SJ), Abalakov, unilateral jump, drop jump and standing horizontal jump.
• Jump height, flight time, takeoff velocity and protocol-specific metrics; calibrated horizontal distance.
• Athlete profiles, teams, local history, progress and comparisons.
• Experimental video Encoder: scale calibration, visual tracking, repetition analysis, velocity and trajectory charts, and trajectory-video export.
• Manual backups and user-initiated JSON/CSV exports.
• Configurable units, light/dark appearance and eight interface languages.
Analysis and saved measurements stay on your device. No accounts, ads, automatic analytics or Internet permission. Sharing, exports, backups and support email require your action; destination applications may transfer those copies. Manual backup JSON is not encrypted.
Results depend on video quality, viewpoint, calibration and event selection. Encoder is experimental and has not been validated against a physical encoder. OpenJump is not a medical or clinically validated device. Save an analysis before leaving it: unsaved work does not survive process death.

 Privacy features

fdroid:eu.sportwetter.app.name: SportWetter
fdroid:eu.sportwetter.app.summary: When does the weather suit outdoor sport? Heat, cold, wind, rain, air.
fdroid:eu.sportwetter.app.description:
SportWetter shows you when the weather suits outdoor sport: heat stress by WBGT, cold, wind, precipitation, thunderstorms and air quality, for nine sports and the next 72 hours.
 Overview 
Search for a place or use the approximate location. The app scores the forecast on the device: the verdict for now or for your session, the best time, the hourly course per day and an outlook on which day fits. Official severe weather warnings appear in the wording of the weather services. Where the sport needs it, water temperature, rock condition and the regional avalanche bulletin are added.
 Plan 
Set a session with start and duration and hand it on as a calendar file. A drinking and eating plan for the hottest hour. A route from a GPX file, a chain of places or a distance is split into legs, and each leg is scored at its arrival time.
 Diary 
Record sessions and rate the conditions, the heat profile learns from that. Import from GPX, TCX or CSV.
 Settings 
Heat profile per sport, body profile, training times and alert thresholds. The backup is a file in the same format as on the website sportwetter.eu. The score can be exported hour by hour as CSV or JSON. Display and input work in metric or imperial units.
 Your data 
No account, no ads, no analytics. Profiles and diary stay on the device. Only coordinates and search terms go to the sportwetter.eu server, plus the version number of the app. Permissions: internet and the approximate location, which is requested only on tap.
SportWetter measures nothing on your body. The recommendations rest on published thresholds and on forecasts that can be wrong. The responsibility stays with you.
German and English, chosen in the settings or following the language of the device.

fedora-packages:colorized-logs/colorized.description: Some tools like gcc, dmesg, grep --color, colordiff, ccze, etc can enhance their output with color, making reading a lot more pleasant. The difference can be as big as between slogging through twenty pages of a build log to find a failure, and a swift drag of the scroller to do the same within a second. Such colored logs can be usually viewed on a terminal or with "less -R"; this package gives you: * ansi2html: convert logs to HTML * ansi2txt: drop ANSI control codes * ttyrec2ansi: drop timing data from ttyrec files * pipetty: makes a program think its stdout and stderr are connected to a terminal; use as a prefix: "pipetty dmesg|tee" * lesstty: pipe a program (as above) to "less -R"

fedora-packages:conntrack-tools/conntrac.name: conntrack-tools

fedora-packages:conntrack-tools/conntrac.description: With conntrack-tools you can setup a High Availability cluster and synchronize conntrack state between multiple firewalls. The conntrack-tools package contains two programs: - conntrack: the command line interface to interact with the connection tracking system. - conntrackd: the connection tracking userspace daemon that can be used to deploy highly available GNU/Linux firewalls and collect statistics of the firewall use. conntrack is used to search, list, inspect and maintain the netfilter connection tracking subsystem of the Linux kernel. Using conntrack, you can dump a list of all (or a filtered selection of) currently tracked connections, delete connections from the state table, and even add new ones. In addition, you can also monitor connection tracking events, e.g. show an event message (one line) per newly established connection.

Защита браузера: блокировка слежки за фокусом вкладки, анти‑фингерпринт, сетевая и device‑защита, Threat Shield от фишинга, ADS Block, помощник копирования. Исключения доменов, статистика и пауза на вкладке.

Important note: this addon is meant to be used by existing customers of vpn.ac . It is a paid service, don't try it if you aren't already a customer. It requires a paid, active account. 
SecureProxy browser extension provides with the ability to surf the web securely and privately without connecting to a "classic" VPN. It works like a browser proxy and all browsing traffic is encrypted through a secure tunnel. 
 Stealth against Firewall/DPI : when inspected using DPI technologies, the connections using the SecureProxy don't trigger alerts like a classic VPN would usually do.

firefox-addons:3126384.description:

 Profiles: vision, dyslexia, ADHD, motor, cognitive and epilepsy
 Reading controls: text size, line height, letter and word spacing, text alignment and reading fonts
 Reading aids: Bionic Reading, reading ruler, magnifier, reading progress and estimated reading time
 Read aloud: selected text, paragraphs or the main content of a page
 Focus and calm: focus mode, distraction reduction, autoplay media control and reduced animations
 Visual settings: high contrast, dark and light color themes, grayscale and link highlighting
 Focus timer: built-in Pomodoro timer with an optional notification sound
Settings are preserved per website. The widget can be disabled globally, while individual domains can be blacklisted and whitelisted again at any time.
The interface supports German and English and automatically follows the browser language.
Activation and widget settings are stored locally in the browser. The extension does not load JavaScript from external servers.

Nowadays search engines are greedy and want to keep you on their search results page for as long as possible. That's why they make each search result open in a new tab.
With this extension, simply click the toolbar icon when you are on a search results page, and the extension will remember the domain of the page and the next time you are on that page, the extension will force links to open in the same page.
To remove the domain from the extension, simply visit the same page and click the toolbar icon again.
 Permissions Disclosure: 
 Access browser activity during navigation : It will match if the current URL is in the whitelist and if so, execute code to open links in the same tab.
 Display notifications to you : Just to show simple alerts when you add/remove domains from the whitelist.

bluejetty:00016287:ios.name: Dino Quest: Fossil Games
bluejetty:00016287:ios.summary: Hop in into a jurassic game adventure around the world, play some minesweeper and battleship games and discover the mysteries of the dinosaurs in Dino Quest, a dino game like never before! Be part of a T-rex simulator and roar after each fo
bluejetty:00016287:ios.description:
Hop in into a jurassic game adventure around the world, play some minesweeper and battleship games and discover the mysteries of the dinosaurs in Dino Quest, a dino game like never before! Be part of a T-rex simulator and roar after each fossil encountered!
Dino quest is a dinosaur game that brings the classics back, including minesweeper and battleship games mechanics, where you’ll explore different continents to find the fossils of millions of years of history. Then, bring them to your own museum collection and show everyone that you are a master in archeology games. With accurate information and an exciting gameplay, Dino Quest is the definitive archeology game app for every jurassic game, T-rex simulator and exploration game fan.
Start your jurassic game journey, pick your tools, remember the classic minesweeper and battleship games techniques and get it on into this mighty dino game! Enjoy the exploration games mechanics and choose a continent to fully discover: Africa, Asia, the Americas, Australia or the Europe. In each continent of this vast exploration game, you can find dig sites with different fossils of dinosaurs that actually lived there. it's the best representation of history in dino games!
Use your minesweeper techniques, battleship games strategies, skill and the game special tools to dig the right tiles, locate the ancient bones and uncover every mystery of this archeology game. Are you seeking the thrill of a T-rex simulator and the breathtaking adventures of an exploration game? Then Dino Quest is the right dinosaur game for you!
Collecting the fossils hidden in this dinosaur game enables you to complete the dino skeleton, unlocking authentic real world information about your incredible discovery. Being in the top of the archeology games and dino games, Dino Quest gives you accurate geographical location of the fossils to reflect real discoveries of prehistoric life. Who said that jurassic games, especially one that is also a T-rex simulator, can’t be fun and educative at the same time?
By mixing some minesweeper, battleship games mechanics and an entertaining adventure, Dino Quest is sure to entertain everyone. Give your best, have fun and complete all the fossil collections in Dino Quest, the dinosaur game that will never be extinct.
HIGHLIGHTS
• The top notch in archeology games, with accurate information of dinosaurs and archaeological parks.
• Use the techniques of classic minesweeper and battleship games to find every fossil hidden in this dino game.
• Dinosaur games can be fun and educative! Play and learn the fundamentals of paleontology.
• A challenging T-rex simulator with all the exciting experiences of an exploration game.
Jump in into the best among the jurassic games apps to explore and learn more about these giants of the past: Triceratops, Velociraptor, Stegosaurus, Spinosaurus, Archaeopteryx, Brachiosaurus, Allosaurus, Apatosaurus, Dilophosaurus! And of course that a T-Rex simulator couldn't leave out the great Tyrannosaurus Rex!
Please note! This game is free to play, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money. Some features and extras mentioned in the description may also have to be purchased for real money.

- Stunning Full HD Graphics showcasing massive truck details

bluejetty:00029034:ios.description:
Embark on a thrilling adventure in the world of hospitality with "Idle Hotel Kingdom." Become a master hotel tycoon and build your very own hotel empire from scratch. This captivating simulator game combines the excitement of a tycoon game with the addictive nature of an idle game, offering you an immersive experience like no other.
In "Idle Hotel Kingdom," you are tasked with managing every aspect of your hotel business. From constructing and designing the most luxurious accommodations to providing top-notch services for your guests, the success of your empire lies in your hands. As a savvy tycoon, you must strategize and optimize your operations to maximize profits.
Immerse yourself in the bustling world of hotels as you build and expand your properties. Utilize your management skills to attract guests from all over the globe, ensuring their stay is nothing short of extraordinary. As your hotel empire flourishes, unlock new and exciting features that will keep both you and your guests entertained.
But "Idle Hotel Kingdom" isn't just about running a hotel – it offers unique and thrilling activities to keep your guests engaged. Race against the tides with exhilarating water sports, including thrilling water races and jet skiing. Embrace the winter wonderland and manage a world-class ski resort, catering to adrenaline-seeking skiers and snowboarders. Pamper your guests with luxurious spa treatments and soothing massages, allowing them to unwind and rejuvenate in the most tranquil surroundings.
With "Idle Hotel Kingdom," the possibilities are endless. Expand your empire, upgrade your facilities, and attract VIP guests to experience the epitome of luxury. Manage your resources wisely, employ skilled staff, and watch as your hotel becomes the go-to destination for travelers worldwide.
Are you ready to embark on this epic hotel tycoon and idle game adventure? Join "Idle Hotel Kingdom" now and prove your mettle as the ultimate hotel tycoon!
Note: "Idle Hotel Kingdom" is part of the thriving genre of idle games and tycoon games, delivering a unique combination of hotel management and simulation gameplay.

Are you ready to dominate the streets and build your own mafia empire? In Crime Empire: Wars & Mercy, you’ll step into the shoes of an ambitious gangster aiming to conquer the criminal world. Navigate through intense gangster games scenarios, strategize your moves, and rise to power in the treacherous mafia city.
With gripping storylines, challenging gameplay, and a world teeming with rival factions and crime bosses, Crime Empire immerses you in the ultimate battle for dominance.
Features That Define the Game:
Dynamic Storylines: Experience thrilling chapters that keep you at the edge of your seat as you uncover secrets and forge alliances.
Lead Your Crew: Manage your gang and turn them into the most feared force in the urban crime underworld.
Realistic Gameplay: Tackle dangerous mission games, survive war crime battles, and prove your worth in a boss game.
Build Your Criminal Empire: From humble beginnings to becoming the ultimate crimelord, climb the ranks of the mafia crime lords.
Vivid World: Explore the beautifully detailed gangster city, brought to life with stunning visuals and immersive storytelling.
Compete and Conquer: Face rival gangs, challenge mafia bosses, and evade authorities in your quest for power.
Multiple Endings: Your choices shape your legacy, leading to unique outcomes in every playthrough.

Crime Empire: Wars & Mercy isn’t just another mafia game. It’s a journey into the gritty, high-stakes world of gangster mafia crime, where your every move counts. bluejetty:00066352:ios.description:
Throw the enemies out with your tail!
Guaranteed excitement with simple control!
Tap & drag to where you want to move, release to rotate and attack with your tail.
That's all it takes, and palm sweating experiences are waiting for you.
Your tail will grow longer the more meat you eat.
Be careful of poisonous mushrooms.
It's your choice either to wait until your tail grows and then attack, or start attacking right away as the situation permits!
If you survive regular stages and become 1st, you will go to the next stage.
Collect all the coins in bonus stages.
Boss characters in check points are not the same as regular enemies! Be mindful!
As you become comfortable with the game, why don't you challenge winning the championship!
Good to know:
• With regular size meat, your tail will grow by one step.
• You will grow larger if you have larger meat.
• You will shrink with poisonous fungus. But, you can grow back with some meat.
• If you get involved in bomb explosion, your tail will shrink back to original length.
• If you use your tail on bombs, they may explode. Better to push them away instead.
• You can sweep the mushrooms off with your tail. But you can also throw the meats away at the same time, so be sensible in the use of that capability.
• Some area of ground will sink as time passes. There will be more frequent battles because of that.

Download Playground AR now and start creating!

bluejetty:00089662:ios.description:
With Sugarless, you grow a beautiful garden by becoming sugar-free. Make use of cognitive-behavioral therapy principles and let us guide you on a step-by-step Journey to liberate yourself from sugar.
Research shows sugar can make you sick, wreck your smile, and drag down your mood. Sugarless helps you start a healthier and happier life today.
* BLOOMING GARDEN *
Grow a garden that flourishes when you meet your goals and withers when you don't.
* TAILORED TO YOU *
Pick a strategy that fits you: The Sugarless Way, No Added Sugar, Low-Carb, or full Keto.
* DAILY ADVICE *
Get daily tips, motivational messages, and research facts to help you stay sugar-free.
* STAY CONSISTENT *
Get a daily reminder to log your progress. See your streak and success rate.
* PRIVATE BY DESIGN *
No account, no tracking. All your data stays on your device.
Everything above is completely free. When you're ready to go deeper, there's the Journey:
* UNLOCK THE JOURNEY *
Our premium Journey makes your sugar-free lifestyle even easier and longer-lasting.
Based on cognitive-behavioral therapy principles, it will gradually guide you through 20 steps, exploring your motivations, triggers, cravings, and reactions.
At the end of the Journey, you'll understand much better why you crave sugar — and you'll have concrete habits to resolve cravings and feel better. All for the price of two chocolate bars a month.
* PANIC BUTTON *
Journey subscribers unlock the Panic Button widget for the iOS home screen. When sugar cravings hit you, tap it and follow the instructions for quick relief.
The Panic Button recommends an immediately actionable tactic you can use to overcome your cravings.
Plant your first seed today.
---
Hi! We're Viktor and Michal. We used to devour cakes and chocolate bars like a swarm of locusts, and unfortunately, we still sometimes do. One of us is a software engineer, the other a psychologist — so we decided to create an app to help people just like us.
But we didn't want it to be just another habit tracker. That's why we built Sugarless to leverage psychological knowledge on habit change and therapeutic approaches to addiction. We believe that whether you use the free version or start the premium Journey, we can help you deal with this unhealthy habit.
Since Sugarless keeps all your data on your device, we can't see how you use the app — so your feedback is even more important to us. Let us know about your experience at reddit.com/r/sugarless or email us at feedback@sugarlessapp.com.
---

MaxZoom: Ultra Zoom Camera HD is your ultimate photography tool, designed to push the visual limits of your smartphone. Whether you are trying to capture detailed shots of distant objects, read incredibly tiny text, or explore the night sky, this ultra camera app transforms your device into a powerful pocket telescope and magnifier.
Experience the power of extreme digital zoom combined with advanced AI processing to ensure every shot remains crystal clear and HD, even at maximum magnification. From daytime adventures to tactical nighttime photography, MaxZoom has all the pro-level tools you need.
🔥 KEY FEATURES 🔥
🔭 Extreme Telescope Zoom
Unlock the hidden potential of your device's lens. Our advanced zooming algorithms allow you to magnify distant objects like never before—perfect for bird watching, sports events, concerts, or capturing the moon.
✨ AI Image Enhancer
Say goodbye to blurry or pixelated zoomed-in photos. With a single tap, our built-in AI enhancer restores lost details, removes noise, and sharpens your images into breathtaking HD quality.
🌡️ Thermal Mode Vision
Explore the unseen with our simulated thermal vision filter. This unique mode applies a high-contrast, infrared-style color matrix to your camera feed, giving your photos and videos a stunning tactical aesthetic.
🔍 Magnifier Pro & Macro Reader
Struggling to read tiny text on medicine bottles or electronic manuals? Switch to Magnifier Pro for extreme close-up shots. Activate the high-contrast B&W (Black & White) text filter to make incredibly small letters legible instantly.
🌙 Astronomy & Sky Events Tracker
Plan your perfect astrophotography sessions. Track real-time moon phases, illumination percentages, and upcoming sky events directly from your app dashboard to know exactly when to point your camera at the sky.
⚙️ Professional Camera Controls
Take full manual control over your photography. Adjust exposure, lock focus, and utilize the built-in flashlight for perfectly lit shots in any environment.
📁 Secure In-App Gallery
Easily manage, view, and organize all your high-definition captures in one dedicated place without cluttering your phone’s main gallery.
Turn your smartphone into a versatile optical tool. Download MaxZoom: Ultra Zoom Camera HD today to see the world closer, clearer, and better!

bluejetty:00023463:ios.description:
Sausage Man is a cartoon-styled, competitive shooting, battle royale game featuring sausages as protagonists. It is a game that you can get started with effortlessly and play anytime, anywhere. You will roleplay as funny and adorable sausages and fight in high-octane, imagination-filled battles. 
[Exhilarating Combat with Tactical Firepower]
Sausage Man features a fast-paced and detailed combat system, including realistic bullet physics. Scavenge for powerful firearms and tactical gear, including flare guns, revival tools, tactical shields, and ID card systems to test the strength of you and your friends’ teamwork.
[Mess Around in a Vibrant, Open World]
There’s more to the combat zone than just intense fighting! Screw around in a vibrant game world where you can sing, jump and get into all kinds of hilarious fun with your friends. Put on a life buoy and blast your enemies as you float on the water! Annoy snipers by double jumping with gleeful abandon! Let your imagination run wild and have a ball of a time.
[Be All the Sausage You Can Be]
Express yourself as the coolest Sausage in the room! Customize your appearance with a ridiculous array of costumes that span a variety of themes, such as Koi, Cyberpunk, and French Maid, and emote with cute emoticons and animations. Build your reputation among your fellow Sausages with the unique Party Card system, which keeps track of your appearances, achievements and combat data!

bluejetty:00045583:ios.description:
Emano Flow is a simple solution for monitoring urinary health, designed for both physician and patient ease. Patients simply record audio of their urinations within the app, and our patented machine learning technology measures the flow rate and volume of each urination. Physicians can view the results in a separate, secure provider portal, providing insight on how the urinary tract is functioning.
Emano Flow is intended for use by adult male patients with lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS). It measures urinary flow rate and volume and does not diagnose any medical condition.
Physicians: Get in touch with us at support@emanometrics.com!

bluejetty:00032478:ios.description:
Download and play for free one of the best word games for adults and seniors! Whether you're a fan of crossword puzzles, scrabble, word scramble games, or just love guessing games – Wordling! is the daily fix your brain needs.
Train your brain, expand your vocabulary, and challenge yourself & your friends daily with this exciting and addictive free word puzzle. With Wordling!, you’ll enjoy a new word puzzle challenge every day that keeps your mind sharp and entertained.
WHAT IS WORDLING?
Wordling! is a unique blend of word search, spelling games, and guess the word games, inspired by viral classics like New York Times Wordle. In this offline puzzle game, your goal is to uncover the hidden word by guessing valid words and using color-coded hints to guide your guesses.
You get 6 tries to guess the correct word. Letters that are correctly placed turn green, correct letters in the wrong spot are yellow, and incorrect ones are grey. With each guess, you’re closer to cracking the code!
HOW TO PLAY
> A new word every day – never the same puzzle twice!
> Guess a valid word and use letter colors as clues.
> Win by finding the hidden word in 6 attempts or less.
> Play at your own pace – relaxing, no ads, and no pressure.
> Choose your difficulty: 4-letter, 5-letter, or 6-letter words.
Wordling! is perfect for free brain training and is one of the top free games for seniors, word games for adults, and fans of thinking games and offline word puzzles.
FEATURES YOU’LL LOVE
> Daily brain games to sharpen memory and thinking skills
> Thousands of levels – not just today's word, but past challenges too
> Spelling games for adults to test and improve vocabulary
> No ads game mode for uninterrupted play
> Word scramble and jumble puzzles
> Great for fans of word finder, boggle free, word ladder, and wordplay games
> Designed for word lovers, crossword puzzle free players, and scramble addicts
> Share your scores with friends and challenge them to beat you
> Offline gameplay available anytime, anywhere

Not only does it challenge you to beat the game in as few tries as possible, but it also challenges you even more, to simply come up with the right guesses utilizing the clues you have gotten correct. Again, PHENOMENAL!!!!
Users of all ages—from students to retirees—love Wordling! for its fun free games, word search for kids, and word games for seniors appeal. Whether you want a quick brain boost or a deep thinking session, this app is perfect.
WHY WORDLING IS GOOD FOR YOUR BRAIN
Playing word puzzle games regularly has been shown to improve memory, vocabulary, and problem-solving skills. Wordling! isn’t just a game – it’s a daily dose of brain training and mental wellness.
It’s a free word puzzle that fits in your pocket and helps keep your mind young. Whether you’re playing on your commute or during a coffee break, Wordling is your ideal word games free companion.
DOWNLOAD TODAY!
Don’t wait – join millions of users enjoying one of the most engaging word games free on the App Store. Download Wordling! today and challenge your mind with daily puzzles.
Perfect for fans of:
- wordscapes free
- word scramble games
- guess the word game
- spelling games for adults
- free brain games like Boggle
- word search no ads
- offline puzzle games

Download Wordling now – the word game everyone is talking about!

Everybody gets moody. Moods are a natural part of your emotional rhythm. Tracking them can help you find patterns in how your moods vary both over time and how they’re influenced by different situations and circumstances.
You probably already know that you feel good when you are in a positive mood, such as when you feel powerful, loving, or optimistic. And, you probably already know you feel bad when you are in a negative mood, such as when you feel anxious, scared, or sad. Other times, you might not really understand how you feel.
With this app you can record your mood and associate it with a wide range of emotions and triggers. This will help you track your thoughts as a daily journal, providing you with a visual representation so you can understand your moods and help you manage them so you can feel better.

bluejetty:00147158:ios.description:
Discover new products. Try what you love. Share your experience.
weSponsored is the app for shoppers, creators, and product enthusiasts who genuinely love finding new things - and want a trusted place to discover them.
Browse campaigns from brands across beauty, wellness, fitness, home, pets, tech, food, and lifestyle. View what each opportunity involves, apply in minutes, and manage everything from one organized app.
Find new products Campaigns are matched to your interests, so you see opportunities that actually fit your lifestyle. From everyday essentials to the latest launches, weSponsored is where shoppers discover what's new.
Know what to expect upfront Every campaign shows the details before you apply - what the brand is looking for, timelines, requirements, and any rewards.
Apply, participate, and track everything in one place weSponsored keeps your campaigns organized so you can focus on the part you love, trying the product.
Share honest feedback, privately Your feedback is submitted privately to weSponsored — it isn't posted publicly through the app. We want the real stuff: what did you love, what didn't work for you, what surprised you, what would make you buy it again, what the photos on the product page didn't prepare you for. Brands may use what they hear to improve their product detail pages, photos, and descriptions so future customers have a clearer picture of what they're buying. Your honest experience helps brands get better, and helps other shoppers find products worth their money.
Show off your content skills Some campaigns may ask you to capture photos or videos of the product. If you're good behind a camera, that's great - but you don't need to be a professional creator to participate. We're looking for people who can show a product honestly and clearly.
Connect your Instagram or TikTok for more opportunities If you're active on Instagram or TikTok, you can connect your social account to qualify for additional campaigns. Some brands are looking for participants with a social presence, and linking your account helps us match you to opportunities that fit. Connecting is optional, plenty of campaigns are open whether or not you're on social.
Built for people who share in their real communities weSponsored is for people who love telling friends, family, and neighbors about products they actually use. The best discoveries happen through people you know and trust - and that's exactly the kind of community we're building.
ID verified for a trusted community Every weSponsored participant is ID verified. This keeps the community real, protects the integrity of campaigns, and ensures brands are working with genuine shoppers and creators - not bots or duplicate accounts. Verification is quick and only happens once.
Built for people who love to shop Whether you're a creator with an audience, a power shopper who's first to try new launches, or someone who just enjoys discovering great products, weSponsored is built for you. Many of our community members become repeat customers of the brands they discover, because when you find something you love, you stick with it.
Download weSponsored to start discovering campaigns and try what's new.

listings.description:
148 newborn essentials and your hospital bag, sorted into 8 calm lists for iPhone and iPad. Mark what you already have, will borrow or get as a gift, and see exactly what's left to buy before your due date.

Make the List Yours
Eight lists cover the hospital bag, nursery, feeding, diapering, travel, health and bath time. One tap marks an item To buy, Already have, Borrow, Gift or Not needed, or select several items and mark them at once, so your progress reflects your plan, not someone else's. Add your own items, quantities and notes, and jot down who is taking care of what. Search finds the exact item and opens its list right where it is, in the app or from Spotlight.

Your Next Steps
Add your due date as you set up and you get a countdown and a short list of next steps, ordered by stage: the nursery and baby clothes first, the hospital bag and car seat closer to the date. Each list has a suggested ready-by week, from week 34 to week 37. Pick the day and time of your weekly reminder. When your baby arrives, enter the birth date and the app switches to your baby's age.

The Hospital Bag, Sorted
For Mom and For Baby cover hospital paperwork and ID, maternity pads, nursing bras, a long phone charger, snacks and going-home outfits for you both. Adjust it to what your hospital recommends.

Made for Your Family
Set it up for a first baby, a second baby (gear you kept becomes optional) or twins (quantities doubled, twin gear added). 32 practical planning tips are included; they are general guidance, not medical advice.

Free and Premium
Free: For Mom, For Baby, Nursery, Feeding and Diapering, with the countdown, next steps, search, your own items, twins and second-baby setup, tips, reminders and iCloud backup.
Premium adds Travel & Transport, Health & Safety and Bath & Hygiene, the Baby Budget (your own prices: what's left to buy next to what you planned, leaving out things you own, borrow or receive as gifts) and PDF export of your whole list. One-time purchase, no subscription. Premium works with Family Sharing: the purchase is shared, and everyone keeps their own list.

Your List Stays Yours
No account, no email, no ads, no tracking. It works offline and your list stays on your iPhone or iPad, with a backup in your own private iCloud when it's available; Settings shows its status. Dark mode, VoiceOver and Siri Shortcuts included.

One week at a time, you'll be ready.

bluejetty:00072883:ios.description:
Two players. One phone. No waiting around.
Set your phone flat on the table and sit across from each other. Every screen faces the right way for both of you. Red plays from the bottom and Blue from the top.
Play with your date, or with your kids while you wait for your food. Use it to decide who buys the next round. Each match takes a minute or two, and the questions and puzzles change every time you play.
8 head-to-head games:
• Odd One Out: Spot the one that doesn't belong before they do.
• Tap Fast: Drum your pads to push the bomb over to their side before it blows.
• Air Hockey: Real physics. First to 7 goals wins.
• Tic-Tac-Toe: Vanishing mode gives you only 3 marks each, so no more ties. Classic mode is there too.
• Quick Draw: Wait for the signal, then tap, double tap or swipe first. Touch too early and they get the point.
• Memory: Repeat the pattern. It grows by one each round, and the first mistake loses.
• Math Race: Solve it first. Pick Easy or Hard.
• True or False: Call it fast. A wrong answer locks you out. Pick Easy or Hard.
Why you'll keep coming back:
• Both players tap Ready, so nobody gets a head start
• A running score for tonight shows who's ahead across every game
• No accounts, no setup and no internet needed
• Scores reset when you close the app, so everyone starts fresh next time
Waiting for your food? Stuck in a waiting room? Settling an argument? Grab the phone and play.

bluejetty:00164762:ios.name: Ur My Type - Dating. Friends.
bluejetty:00164762:ios.summary:
On Ur My Type, you can start chatting with compatible matches in 30 seconds. We use personality types to make finding friends and dating more meaningful. 
We are turning the tables on the conventional friend finding and dating app model an
bluejetty:00164762:ios.description:
On Ur My Type, you can start chatting with compatible matches in 30 seconds. We use personality types to make finding friends and dating more meaningful. 
We are turning the tables on the conventional friend finding and dating app model and adding what's actually needed: A way to be instantly matched with people based on personality types.
This works in 3 simple steps:
1. You fill out some basic information.
2. You take our personality test to find out your own personality type.
3. We instantly connect you with compatible matches in about 30 seconds!
Our personality test is inspired by the 16 personalities test, which uses psychometric testing to classify people into 16 personality types as follows:
INFP - The Idealist
ENFP - The Inspirer
INTJ - The Strategist
ENTJ - The Commander
INFJ - The Mystic
ENFJ - The Protagonist
INTP - The Thinker
ENTP - The Visionary
ISFP - The Adventurer
ESFP - The Entertainer
ISTP - The Craftsman
ESTP - The Dynamo
ISTJ - The Inspector
ESTJ - The Executive
ISFJ - The Nurturer
ESFJ - The Guardian
The four letters in the 16 personality types above stand for the following:
E: Extrovert
I: Introvert
N: Intuitive
S: Sensing
T: Thinking
F: Feeling
P: Perceiving
J: Judging
The HR departments of more than 75% of Fortune 500 companies use a personality test that is in one way or another a variation of the 16 personalities test. At Ur My Type, we are pioneering the application of the 16 personalities in the context of a friend finding and dating app.
We have discovered that our app concept is quite appealing to introverted people. Currently, our data shows that 65% of our users are introverts. There might be more extroverts than introverts in society, but on our app the opposite is true! So, if you identify as an introvert, we believe that you will particularly enjoy our app and get to befriend and date like-minded people. 
We are idealists, but we are also realists. We realize that looks have a role to play in a dating app, which is why profile pictures are shown on our users' profiles. However, we refuse to believe that looks are the most important factor in forming meaningful relationships of any kind. Our core philosophy is that personality is the foundation for dating, making friends, and any type of human connection. 
We acknowledge that the personality types defined by the 16 personalities test are mental models and not absolute truths. However, based on the available scientific data, the immense popularity of this personality test, and our own subjective preference (in case you haven't realized already, we are big fans of it), we are convinced that it's the best tool currently available to achieve our mission of making dating and finding friends online more meaningful.
Although Ur My Type was initially launched as a dating app, it can also be used to make friends. In fact, our data shows that up to 50% of our users are on the app primarily to make friends. 65% of our users indicate that they are looking for both dating and friendship at the same time. So, whether you are looking to befriend or to date like-minded and compatible people, you have come to the right place!
We are always communicating with our users to keep improving. So if you have any suggestions, tips, questions, or feature requests, please feel free to send us an email at info@ur-mytype.com.
Available worldwide.
https://www.urmytype.app/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00073918:ios.description:
Opener is an app that allows you to open links from the web in apps instead! Copy a link and launch Opener to see the apps that it can be opened in, or use Opener's action extension right from other apps! Opener currently supports over 280 apps with more being added all the time.
In addition to opening links in apps, Opener also supports:
- Opening links in any browser of your choice.
- Creating QR codes and shortened links using the long press menu.
- Previewing links from a variety of popular services using long press menu.
- Opening the Google AMP version of pages, which are significantly faster than normal web pages.
"If you find yourself looking to view web links in apps often, Opener is a good timesaver that cleverly uses iOS extensions to speed up the process." — MacStories
"It’s simple, handy, and makes browsing the web a lot easier." — LifeHacker
"...lets you open links in their corresponding app, skipping the annoying Web view along the way." — CNET
"As someone who spends huge chunks of my day tapping on my iPhone’s screen, I skipped my Starbucks latte today and bought Opener instead." — TechCrunch
For a complete list of supported apps and browsers visit opener.link/apps

bluejetty:00087356:ios.description:
Refocus is an app blocker & website blocker that helps you limit screen time on apps!
Refocus is easy to use, yet has powerful screen time control features:
▶ Various ways to restrict or lock apps and block websites. Choose what helps you focus! Block any app or site — from social media and games to messaging and news.
▶ "Strict Mode" feature prevents you from unblocking. Set a passcode, or use an NFC tag, or wait a duration (ex. 30 seconds), or do a copy text challenge, or utilize Pomodoro (limit unblocking to 5 times per day, for 25 minutes each, with a 5-minute cooldown between each unblock).
▶ Block for a specific duration (ex. app timer for 30 minutes).
▶ Block at specific times (ex. every weekday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM).
▶ Set app limits (ex. after 10 minutes of using Instagram, block it). Set an app time limit!
▶ Hide Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts in Safari.
▶ Block at the location you pick — whether it be home, work or school.
▶ View your daily, weekly and monthly Screen Time analytics. Use Refocus as a screen time tracker!
▶ Mac app that also lets you block apps and websites on macOS.
▶ And more!
---
Visit www.refocusapp.co for more information.

This passion is echoed by millions that enjoy playing our games like Stickman Hook, Parkour Race and Sausage Flip. Play with us and see what’s next!

bluejetty:00032208:ios.summary:

موسلمانێن خوشتڤى سلاڤێن خودێ ل هەوە بن
پێغەمبەرێ مە يێ خوشتڤى صلى الله عليە وسلم دبێژيت :(هەر كەسەكێ رێكەكێ ب گریتە بەر بو ب دەست ڤە ئینانا زانستێن شەرعی خودايێ مەزن دێ بو رێكەكێ پێ ب ساناهی
bluejetty:00032208:ios.description:
السلام عليكم و رحمة الله
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
موسلمانێن خوشتڤى سلاڤێن خودێ ل هەوە بن
پێغەمبەرێ مە يێ خوشتڤى صلى الله عليە وسلم دبێژيت :(هەر كەسەكێ رێكەكێ ب گریتە بەر بو ب دەست ڤە ئینانا زانستێن شەرعی خودايێ مەزن دێ بو رێكەكێ پێ ب ساناهی كەت بو چوونا بەهەشتێ )
ژبو ڤێ مەرەمێ ئەم يێن رابوين ب دروستكرنا بەرنامەكى ئانكو (ئەپليكەينشەكێ) بو سيستەمێن
(ئەندرويد - ios)
كو يا كومڤەكەر بيت بو هەمى وان تشتێن گرنگ يێن كو موسلمان روژانە پێدڤى دبنێ، ئەڤ بەرنامە ژ چەندين بەشێن سەرەكى پێك دهێت.
ئێك: بەشێ قورئانا پيروز و تەفسيرێ، كو تو دشێی ل ڤى بەشى قورئانا پيروز و تەفسيرێ ب خينى، و ل ديڤ ئارەزويا خو قەبارێ فونتێ قورئانێ و تەفسيرێ ب گوهرى. هەروەسا تو دشێی گوهداريا قورئانێ بكەى ئەڤە ژى ژ بو وان كەسێن خاندنا وان لاواز دێ مفاى ژێ بينن.
دوو: پەرتوكخانە، ل ڤى بەشى مە پتر ژ 200 پەرتوكێن ئاينى يێن هەمە جور ب بادينى يێن كرينە تێدا دگەل بەرگێن وان ب شێوێ
(3D)
و ب رێكخستنەكا جوان، و گەلەك ژ وان پەرتوكا ئەون يێن كو بو جارا ئێكێ ب شێوێ ئەلكترونى دهێنە بەلاڤكرن، هەر وەسا مە روكار و رەنگێن جودا بو پەرتوكخانێ يێن داناين تو دشێی ل دويڤ حەزا خو بگوهرى.
سێ: بەشێ گوهداريا پەرتوكێن شەرعى ، كو ل ڤى بەشى تو دشێی گوهداريا پتر ژ 100 پەرتوكێن دى يێن شەرعى بكەى وەكى عەقيدە و تەفسير و فقهێ ئيسلامێ و فەرموودە و چەندين بابەت و زانستێن دى يێن شەرعى.
چار : بەشێ فەرموودێن پێغەمبەرى صلى الله عليە وسلم، دڤى بەشى دا تو دشێی ب سەدەها فەرموودێن پێغەمبەرى صلى الله عليە وسلم يێن صەحيح ب خينى ب زمانێ كوردى و عەرەبى و هەروەسا ب ژێدەرڤە.
پێنچ: بەشێ ناڤێن خودێ : دڤى بەشى دا ڕامانا 99 جوانناڤێن خودايێ مەزن يێن تێدا ب سێ زمانان كوردى و عەرەبى و ئينگليزى.
شەش: فەتوايێن شەرعى : ل ڤى بەشى نيزيكێ 500 فەتوا و پرسيارێن شەرعى يێن تێدا هەين دەربارەى بابەتێن جوراوجور، كو يێن هاتينە بەرسڤ دان ژلايێن زانايێن مەزن ڤە و يێن هاتينە وەرگێران بو زمانێ كوردى.
حەفت: دوعا : ب سەدەها دوعايێن دڤى بەشى دا ب زمانێ كوردى و عەرەبى ، ژ وان دوعايێن كو دقورئانێ دا يان ژى د حەديسێن صحيح دا هاتين. دگەل موناجاتان ب زمانێ كوردى.
هەشت: بەشەكێ تايبەت يێ هاتيە دانان بو وان كەسێن توشى بەرێخودانا فلم و مالپەرێن بێ پەردەبووين لژێر ناڤێ (خو رزگار بكە)، كو ب سەدەها شيرەت و رێك و بابەتێن زانستى يێن تێدا داكو ئەو كەسێن توشبوينە ڤى كارێ كێم، خو رزگاربكەن.
نەهـ: ل سەر ڤێ چەندا مە گوتى ب سەداها زكرێن جودا و دەمێن بانگا يێن تێدا هەين ئەو زكرێن كو ئەم د ژيانا خودا پيتڤى دبينى وەكى زكرێن سەفەرێ يان يێن نڤێژێ يان يێن خەوێ يان زكرێن حەج و عومرێ يان زكرێن هاتن و دەركەتنا ژ مال و چونا بازارى و هەتا دوماهيكێ ژڤان زكرێن گرنگ كو ژمارا وان ژ سەد زكرا دبوريت و مروڤ روژا پێدڤى دبيتێ.
و ل دوماهيكێ دێ بێژم ژخودێ دخازم كو ئەو ڤى كارى ژمە قەبيل بكەت و بكەتە دميزانا چاكيێن مە و دەيك و بابێن مە و هەر موسلمانەكى دا.
برايێ هەوە
كوڤان شێرزاد

شەش: فەتوايێن شەرعى : ل ڤى بەشى نيزيكێ 500 فەتوا و پرسيارێن شەرعى يێن تێدا هەين دەربارەى  بابەتێن جوراوجور، كو يێن هاتينە بەرسڤ دان ژلايێن زانايێن مەزن ڤە و يێن هاتينە وەرگێران بو زمانێ كوردى.
حەفت: دوعا :  ب سەدەها دوعايێن دڤى بەشى دا ب زمانێ كوردى و عەرەبى ، ژ وان دوعايێن كو دقورئانێ دا يان ژى د حەديسێن صحيح دا هاتين. دگەل موناجاتان ب زمانێ كوردى.
هەشت: بەشەكێ تايبەت يێ هاتيە دانان بو وان كەسێن توشى بەرێخودانا فلم و مالپەرێن بێ پەردەبووين لژێر ناڤێ (خو رزگار بكە)، كو ب سەدەها شيرەت و رێك و بابەتێن زانستى يێن تێدا داكو ئەو كەسێن توشبوينە ڤى كارێ كێم،  خو رزگاربكەن.
نەهـ: ل سەر ڤێ چەندا مە گوتى ب سەداها زكرێن جودا و دەمێن بانگا يێن تێدا هەين ئەو زكرێن كو ئەم د ژيانا خودا پيتڤى دبينى وەكى زكرێن سەفەرێ يان يێن نڤێژێ يان يێن خەوێ يان زكرێن حەج و عومرێ يان زكرێن هاتن و دەركەتنا ژ مال و چونا بازارى و هەتا دوماهيكێ ژڤان زكرێن گرنگ كو ژمارا وان ژ سەد زكرا دبوريت و مروڤ روژا پێدڤى دبيتێ.

bluejetty:00063522:ios.description:
Rod has kidnapped your friend Charlie, frozen him with a mysterious power and taken him away in his ice cream van.
Enter a first-person horror and puzzle adventure where you must explore creepy locations, uncover mysteries and solve challenging puzzles to save your friend. Sneak into Rod’s van, hide from him and find a way to escape before he catches you.
STORIES
Ice Scream 1 now features multiple stories that expand the Ice Scream universe.
- Charlie’s Kidnapping: Play the original story that started it all. Follow Rod, solve puzzles and rescue Charlie before it’s too late.
- The Missing Guard, Part 1: What if J. had investigated a mysterious disappearance before Charlie was even kidnapped? Begin a what-if story that unfolds across Ice Scream 1, 2 and 3.
- J. Asks for Help: What if J. had asked the neighbors for help instead of sneaking into Rod’s van? Discover a completely different turn of events.
More canonical stories, what-if scenarios and surprises are coming to the Keplerians Universe.
KEPLERIANS NETWORK: PLAY. CONNECT. PROGRESS.
Keplerians Network connects your Ice Scream experience and gives you new ways to play, progress and interact with other players.
- Friends: add other players, manage friend requests and follow their activity.
- Leaderboards: see how you rank globally, locally and among your friends.
- Player Profiles: build your profile, track your stats and discover your friends’ progress.
- Connected Progress: play across connected Ice Scream games and unlock rewards.
- Stories: access the different adventures available in each game.
- Events: take part in limited-time events, complete special challenges and earn rewards across KNetwork games.
- Skin Shop: unlock and equip skins to customize Rod and the kids.
- Rewards & Customization: earn Kepler Coins, unlock profile cosmetics, use boosters and personalize your experience.
GO PREMIUM
Take your Ice Scream experience even further with Premium:
- No ads: play without interruptions.
- Free boosters across your games.
- Double Kepler Coins while playing.
- Monthly exclusive gifts including Horror Coins, cosmetics, booster reloads and more.
- Access new stories and exclusive content before anyone else.
Play with headphones for the best experience.
We regularly update Ice Scream with new stories, features and improvements. Thanks for playing!
Have questions? Visit our FAQ:
https://keplerians.com/keplerians-network/
Are you a parent of a young Keplerians player? Find everything you need to keep their adventure safe and fun:
https://keplerians.com/parents-guide/

Meet Liberty Go. This clever app lets you watch live TV channels from any mobile device. Enjoy it wherever you have an internet connection with Wi-Fi, 3G , 4G/LTE and/or 5G in PR. 

What’s New 

• Watch live TV
• Personalize TV Guide so your favorites are at the top
• Search
• Recommendations
• Parental Controls
• Watch up to 3 compatible devices

What do you need

• Be a Liberty TV customer
• An Iphone or Ipad with iOS 12 or highest & above with Wi-Fi or 3G , 4G/LTE and/or 5G internet in PR
• Your “My Liberty” credentials username and password

Liberty Go is available to all Liberty Puerto Rico TV customers. Watching Liberty Go on your device through a 3G/4G/LTE/5G connection will use data and contribute to any monthly allowance set by your mobile network operator. For security reasons, and to protect the rights of our content.

Whether you grew up watching Spacetoon or you're discovering it for the first time — this is your home.

Stream legendary Arabic-dubbed (مدبلج) anime and cartoons:
• Detective Conan, Dragon Ball Super, Hunter x Hunter, My Hero Academia
• Beyblade, Inazuma Eleven, Digimon, Kuroko's Basketball
• Haikyu, Kamen Rider, Adventure of Dai

Premium Membership

• Multi-device access (phone, tablet, TV)
• HD playback
• Early access to new series
• Full music library access
The Leading Arabic Anime Platform
Spacetoon has been the home of Arabic anime for over 20 years. Spacetoon Go brings that legacy to the digital age — combining nostalgia, modern anime culture, and safe family entertainment in one powerful app.
Available in Arabic, English. Designed for MENA and GCC audiences worldwide.
More exciting features coming soon — stay tuned for interactive experiences that will let you do more than just watch!

bluejetty:00200064:ios.name: FIELD KIT Playback Engine
bluejetty:00200064:ios.summary:
FIELD KIT is an audio playback instrument built for turning recorded sound into evolving texture, rhythm, and atmosphere.
Load an audio file and create up to four independent playback windows across the recording. Each window can move thro
bluejetty:00200064:ios.description:
FIELD KIT is an audio playback instrument built for turning recorded sound into evolving texture, rhythm, and atmosphere.
Load an audio file and create up to four independent playback windows across the recording. Each window can move through a different section of the source with its own playback speed, direction, crossfade, drive, filtering, level, and pan.
Use FIELD KIT to pull overlapping textures from long field recordings, transform environmental sound into ambient beds, create asynchronous loops, or find entirely new material hidden inside a recording.
Three modulation sources can be routed independently across the playback windows, allowing parameters to drift, pulse, and evolve over time.
Features include:
- Up to four independent playback windows
- Forward, reverse, and ping-pong playback
- Variable playback speed
- Adjustable loop crossfade
- Drive and filtering per window
- Independent level and pan controls
- Three routable modulation sources
- SPLICE for working with multiple audio sources
- Save and recall .fieldkit files to share across platforms
- Internal recording in Standalone mode
- Standalone app and AUv3 Audio Unit
- Host transport support in compatible AUv3 hosts
FIELD KIT was designed around a simple idea: a recording doesn't have to be played from beginning to end. It can be a place to explore.

Discover a mystical world of astrology and alchemy in a story-rich hidden object adventure. Search beautifully hand-drawn scenes, solve zodiac-inspired puzzles and guide Elasaid through the Seven Chambers to rewrite her destiny.
After a near-fatal accident, Elasaid falls into a coma and journeys through the depths of her subconscious. Guided by mystical beings like the Fallen Angel, Mercury and the Green Lion, she must uncover the secrets of the Seven Chambers and awaken the Azoth—the power to change her fate.
WHAT AWAITS YOU
• A hidden object puzzle adventure with a rich story.
• 30+ locations & 20 mini-games – inspired by alchemy and the zodiac.
• Map & Journal – always know where to go next.
• Hidden Object & Puzzle Adventure – dozens of scenes and mini-games to explore and solve.
• Full voiceovers & HD visuals – immerse yourself in the story.

• Fully optimized for your iPad and iPad Pro — play on a big screen with stunning HD graphics and details!
• Play completely offline - Phone & tablet support — anytime, anywhere
• No data collection — your privacy is safe
• Premium Game - Try free, unlock full game once – no ads, no micro-transactions.

Tap to search scenes, collect clues, combine items from your inventory, and complete mini-games to progress the story. Use hints if you get stuck — but the reward is uncovering more of the mystery.
- Play your way
Explore, investigate and solve the mystery in your own way: adjustable challenge: Casual, Adventure, and Challenging difficulty modes. Win Achievements & Collectibles.

A gripping mystery: narrative-driven gameplay with a strong detective lead. Immersive locations: explore, seeks, search and solve puzzles.

- Free to try
Try for free, then unlock the full game for the entire mystery — no distractions, just mystery to solve.

bluejetty:00119634:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00119634:ios.description:
The SumUp Business app gives you the tools you need to get paid, manage your money, and run your business. All easy to use, all in one place.
Get paid
With SumUp, getting paid is flexible, fast, and secure—wherever and however you do business.
Card readers 
Pair the SumUp Business app with a Solo card reader to take chip & PIN, contactless, and mobile wallet payments. Use the app to track sales, add tipping options, issue refunds, and set sales tax rates. The app also powers payments on our stand-alone Solo and Terminal devices.
Point of Sale
Turn your tablet into a POS system. Accept payments, take orders, manage stock, monitor sales, and run reports—all without dedicated POS hardware.
Payment Links
Get paid remotely with Payment Links. Create a secure link directly from the app home screen, then share it with your customer via text message, email, or social media DM. The link takes your customer to a secure website to complete the transaction. A simple, safe way to take cashless payments online.
Manage your money
Our money management tools are designed for steady cash flow, secure funds, and complete financial control.
SumUp Business Account
Manage your cash flow, keep your money safe, and stay in complete control of your finances with a SumUp Business Account. You can open your account in minutes, straight from the app. If you use SumUp to take payments, you’ll get guaranteed next-day payouts, even on weekends and holidays. You’ll also receive a contactless Mastercard for all your business spending.
Invoices
Create and issue professional, legally complaint, on-brand invoices from the app in a few taps. Track the status of any invoices you’ve issued, and give customers the option to pay securely online. 
Run your business
Speed up daily tasks, connect with your customers, and build your brand—all straight from the app.
Item catalog
Create your own item catalog and manage everything you sell in one place. Add, edit, and delete items directly in the app. Add images and descriptions, apply custom tax rates, track stock, and sell online.
Reports
Generate reports that help you better understand your business. Whether you need a simple sales overview or a detailed breakdown of every transaction, you can access it all within the SumUp Business app.
Bookings
A free all-in-one booking system for your beauty or wellness business. Manage appointments, collect up-front payments, and reduce no-shows with automated reminders and cancellation fees.

bluejetty:00122787:ios.description:
Management of all of your banking transactions is in your mobile phone via our mobile banking application, Garanti BBVA Mobile! We offer more than 1000 transaction options from loan applications to automatic bill payment orders. Our Retail, Corporate and SME customers! We are at all times beside you in order to enable you to perform your banking transactions easily at any moment and from any place you like and prefer. 
Garanti BBVA consultancy is good for your financial health! Thanks to our financial health advices formulated specifically for you, you may protect and maintain your balance of income and expenses, and build up savings, in vast or small amounts, and achieve your objectives and goals. 
If you are not yet our customer, you can easily become a part of Garanti BBVA without need to go to a branch by using the Contactless Onboarding Technology.
For all kinds of your needs, you can easily file a credit application, and as soon as it is approved, you can transfer your loan to your own account and immediately start to use and spend it. 
If you wish to invest your savings, you can open an e-time deposit account via Garanti BBVA Mobile, promptly starting to make benefit from high interest rates. What’s more, whenever you need, you can withdraw money from your e-time deposit account, or deposit money therein, at any time before the end of maturity thereof.
You can apply for a credit card fits best to you, thus making benefit from very special discounts and campaigns, and easily following up the progress of your card application via Mobile. 
You can pay your bills without going to branch, and if you wish, you can give automatic payment orders without need to follow up the deadlines of them. Furthermore, you can pay your motor vehicle taxes, traffic fines, game of chance payments and many other payments via Garanti BBVA Mobile at any time and from any place you wish and like.
So as to maximize your security, we continuously follow up and apply the most advanced measures for you. While you trade, for the sake of your security, we freely make our malware detection software applications ready for your use in integration with Garanti BBVA Mobile. Thanks to tokenization, we verify your access to our mobile application by a device of your own.
Benefits offered by Garanti BBVA Mobile:
• 24/7 money transfer,
• Money transfer via Kolay Adres (Easy Address) without need for IBAN, 
• Bill and tax payments,
• Account and card balances, 
• Loan calculation, loan applications and follow-up of application,
• Credit card applications and follow-up of application,
• Tracking and monitoring the current exchange rates, 
• Opening bank accounts in foreign currency, 
• Displaying your assets and liabilities, 
• Reviewing and checking your income and expenses by categories, 
• Tracking the actions taken by you through review of our financial health advices designed specifically for you, and
• Inquiring ATMs and branches closest to you, and many other banking transactions.
Apart from those listed above, our corporate customers may further display and approve via the structure of notification their commercial banking transactions submitted for approval via Garanti BBVA Mobile, within the limits of their authorization and approval definitions. 
For use of Garanti BBVA Mobile, it is adequate for you to have a Mobile / Internet Banking password. If you don’t have a password, by clicking “Parola Al” (Get Password), you can promptly take your password by using your credit card or Paracard number. If you don’t have a card, you can communicate our customer representative by video talking, and build a new password.
Permissions held by Garanti BBVA Mobile may be retrieved via the following link: 
 www.garantibbva.com.tr/izinler

bluejetty:00138933:ios.description:
Level up your photography and editing skills with Photo Up!—the ultimate photo editor. Enhance your pics, create a stunning picture collage, apply elegant or fun filters, and much more. This photo editor doubles as a lightning-fast image editor, giving you the freedom to create anywhere.
Whether you post casually on Instagram or shoot professionally, this versatile photo editor makes your images pop and go viral. Looking for editing apps for pictures that actually work? Our all-in-one picture editor brings every tool you need together in one intuitive workspace. Open the photo editor workspace and explore powerful yet user-friendly controls tuned for mobile creativity.
◉ FEATURES
√ EDITING TOOLS
• Trim, crop, and cut to perfection, or batch edit photos in seconds.
• Fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, and more right inside the photo editor.
• Flip or rotate for the perfect angle.
• Arrange shots with customizable aspect ratios on a flexible canvas.
• Test artistic frames to give every picture collage a unique look.
• Skip the learning curve—smart presets speed up photo editing.
• Remove or blur backgrounds with a single touch.
• Apply dozens of photo editor filters and effects.
• Add text overlays and stickers to personalize your creations.
√ CREATIVE POWER
• Combine images with our free collage maker, offering multiple layouts and picture grids.
• Superimpose layers for double exposures.
• Add motion with blur effects.
• Keep edits non-destructive with re-editable layers.
• Swap backgrounds for inspirational patterns.
• Use trending filters and popular effects from leading editing apps for pictures.
• Draw, doodle, or drop in custom shapes for expressive photo editing sessions.
√ ADVANCED IMAGE CORRECTION
• Shoot and edit pictures in RAW inside the photo editor for maximum quality.
• Enter the built-in picture lab to retouch selfies like a pro.
• Precise tonal control with 16-bit image depth.
• Smart brushes select and mask effortlessly.
• Adjust tonality, color, grain, vignette, fade, and more.
• Remove blemishes and distractions for flawless shots.
• Lean on the automatic photo enhancer to instantly enhance photo quality, even on low-resolution files.
• An optional AI image enhancer delivers studio-grade detail recovery and works seamlessly with the photo editor.
√ TEMPLATES & DESIGN
• Build aesthetics quickly: collage maker templates let you drop as many pics as you want into one layout.
• Customize colors, fonts, and more to brand each design.
• Resize for any social network with one tap.
• Change backgrounds, add text, stickers, and other elements freely.
√ UNLIMITED SHARING & EXPORTING
• Export PNG, JPG, or TIFF without losing data.
• Because the image editor preserves metadata, organization is seamless.
• Save in high resolution and enhance photo quality again later if needed.
• Post directly to Instagram, Facebook, X, and more.
• Remove watermarks instantly with a PRO subscription.
◉ WHY CHOOSE PHOTO UP?
• A truly mobile photo editor that rivals desktop suites and succeeds where other editing apps for pictures fall short.
• High-speed image editor engine optimized for big files.
• A collage maker that’s as robust as stand-alone tools.
• A triple-threat workflow: edit photos, create a picture collage, and run advanced photo editing—all inside one app.
• Powered by an on-device photo enhancer so you can enhance photo quality offline.
DOWNLOAD Photo Up! today and experience the photo editor, collage maker, and photo enhancer trusted by millions to edit images in record time and turn every shot into share-worthy art!
◉ CONTACT
For app support, you can reach us at:
info@photo-up.app

bluejetty:00119830:ios.name: Learn Saxophone - tonestro
bluejetty:00119830:ios.summary: Learn to play the alto, the tenor, the soprano and the baritone saxophone and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the saxophone and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune
bluejetty:00119830:ios.description:
Learn to play the alto, the tenor, the soprano and the baritone saxophone and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the saxophone and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your saxophone easily.
You can learn and play:
- Alto saxophone
- Tenor saxophone
- Soprano saxophone
- Baritone saxophone
tonestro for saxophone offers a large collection of songs, exercises and guided lessons for every skill level. Learn how to read music notes and improve your saxophone skills by playing many songs and exercises.
With the tuner you tune your saxophone fast and easily for perfect pitch. A metronome and specially composed background music with play alongs for many songs guide you the way to perfect rhythm.
Weekly challenges with hand-picked songs give you the extra motivation to improve your skills when you compare yourself with saxophone players from around the world.
OVERVIEW
- Get instant feedback on rhythm & pitch
- Learn to play the saxophone or learn something new
- Enjoy a large collection of songs
- Discover saxophone lessons & exercises
- Start with your first lessons on music notes or choose from many songs
- Learn the correct fingerings with fingering charts
- Tune your saxophone with our integrated tuner
- Enjoy songs with play alongs
- Stay motivated with weekly challenges
LEARN
Learn how to play the saxophone or improve your skills with lessons, fingering charts and exercises. Step-by-step lessons will guide you through your first notes on the saxophone. Detailed explanations and fingering charts tell you how to play a certain note. A tuner helps you find the correct pitch. Test your knowledge in exams and see how fast you progress. Use your newly learned skills and play your first songs on your saxophone.
For experienced saxophone players there’s always something new to learn with advanced lessons, songs and exercises.
PRACTICE
Use tonestro’s live-feedback feature on rhythm and pitch to improve your skills. See where you struggle with intonation and work on your pitch to become a better saxophone player. Switch to practice mode and choose a slower tempo to work on getting that rhythm right. Let the metronome guide you through the songs and use the tuner to not only tune your saxophone but also to see which notes are the ones you have to be very careful with pitch.
PLAY
Discover songs from all music genres and play saxophone songs for every skill level. Whether you’re a fan of classical music or you prefer jazz songs instead: With tonestro’s large sheet music library you’ll find just the songs you need for playing your saxophone.
And you don’t have to play alone: With play alongs you’re playing with a whole band in the background. Always on your side is the tonestro tuner, which is an easy-to-use tuner that will make sure that you’re in tune. And there’s always the metronome that will guide you through the songs.
COMPETE
Do you want to prove your skills? Enter our weekly challenges! Compete with saxophone players from around the world and fight for the podium. Practice the songs to score as many points as possible and become the best saxophone player in the tonestro world. Don’t forget to use the tuner first, so that you can start the challenge with perfect preparation.
tonestro requires a subscription to access the entire learning content and song library. Each subscription plan may include a 3-day free trial period.
Terms: https://www.tonestro.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.tonestro.com/privacy

bluejetty:00061254:ios.description:
Geokey is the world's first multi-dimensional mobile access solution for businesses. No more key fobs, just your phone. Touchless access is here. A simple swipe to open is all it takes. Geokey is not a one-size-fits-all type of security solution. We can integrate with any type of door or software. Our job is to incorporate seamlessly into your life.
Users can log in to control (lock/unlock) and interact with available access points supplied via a list view and map view. Track how many times you accessed a point, what time's of the day you were there, and HOW LONG YOU WERE THERE FOR! Download your Geokey to be apart of one of the first controlled access solutions that will track duration of access.
Admin controllers have the ability to control when and which access points their users can have access to. Define user's access by day of the week, time of the day, or by the number of access points.
Simplicity for our users is our motto and mission. Get a push notification if you are close to an access point. Pull up your app and unlock your access point to enter.
Even though Geokey has a simple front end user experience, the backend has extra security measures to keep everyone safe. Admin can choose if users are required to use two-factor identification for access to their Geokey. Make sure the people that are coming in are the people they say they are.
Contact sales@geokeyaccess.com to get Geokey for your business!

bluejetty:00161052:ios.description:
Questa è l'applicazione ufficiale dell'Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia (INGV) che mostra i dati relativi ai terremoti più recenti che avvengono sul territorio italiano e, limitatamente agli eventi più forti, nel resto del mondo.
I parametri (tempo origine, coordinate epicentrali, profondità e magnitudo) delle localizzazioni dei terremoti sono disponibili grazie al Servizio di Sorveglianza Sismica dell'INGV, attivo 24h/24, 7 giorni su 7.
I parametri sono suscettibili di modifiche non appena sono disponibili nuovi dati.
Particolare attenzione è stata rivolta alle informazioni scientifiche riguardanti i terremoti; sono infatti presenti sezioni collegate al blog INGVterremoti ingvterremoti.com. 
NOVITA' NOTIFICHE PUSH
Abbiamo attivato le notifiche push per i terremoti con magnitudo superiore a 2.5.
Le notifiche sono personalizzabili dall'utente. 
Le notifiche sono disponibili per le localizzazioni definitive e per quelle automatiche con le seguenti tempistiche.
Nella Sala di Sorveglianza Sismica dell’INGV di Roma arrivano in tempo reale i segnali, vale a dire i sismogrammi, delle oltre 400 stazioni della Rete Sismica Nazionale e di altre reti che a essa contribuiscono. I segnali sono tutti digitali e gestiti da software dedicati. Quando un determinato numero minimo di stazioni registra un terremoto, i sistemi informatici utilizzati associano i segnali tra di loro e tentano di calcolare la localizzazione ipocentrale e di determinare la magnitudo. Nel corso di questa operazione, che può richiedere 1 o 2 minuti di tempo, viene valutata anche la bontà della determinazione con dei parametri quantitativi.
Se questi parametri mostrano una qualità sufficiente e per eventi con magnitudo superiore a 3, l'INGV comunica attraverso l'app il dato preliminare automatico in un riquadro arancione sopra la lista dei terremoti, segnalando che si tratta di una informazione non verificata con l’indicazione [STIMA PROVVISORIA]. In questo caso, la magnitudo è fornita con un intervallo di valori e l’area è indicata con la zona o la provincia all’interno della quale ricade l’epicentro.
Intanto i sismologi, che effettuano i turni 24 ore su 24, iniziano la revisione della localizzazione e della magnitudo: analizzano i singoli segnali, verificano che i software abbiano funzionato correttamente nell’identificare l’arrivo delle onde P e delle onde S e nel calcolare le ampiezze massime. Al termine della revisione, viene ricalcolata la posizione ipocentrale (latitudine, longitudine, profondità) e stimata nuovamente la magnitudo. A seconda della magnitudo del terremoto – e quindi del numero di stazioni sismiche che lo hanno registrato – e delle complessità geologiche della regione colpita, possono essere necessari fino a 30 minuti per completare la revisione.
All'interno dell'app i dati della localizzazione rivista vengono inserite nell'elenco degli eventi sismici e contemporaneamente scompare il corrispettivo riquadro arancione della stima provvisoria.
_________________________
ORARIO
Nella sezione Ultimi terremoti gli orari degli eventi sismici **non** sono più espressi utilizzando l'orario di riferimento UTC (Tempo Coordinato Universale) ma l'orario in cui è configurato il telefono.
CARATTERISTICHE
L'App permette di visualizzare gli ultimi terremoti avvenuti nei 3 giorni precedenti.
L’App permette di visualizzare anche la sismicità italiana dal 2005 in poi, tramite la sezione Ricerca Terremoti. È possibile cercare i terremoti:
- degli ultimi 20 giorni o in un intervallo di tempo selezionato. 
- in tutto il mondo, in tutta Italia, più vicini alla posizione attuale, attorno ad un Comune, e infine inserendo dei valori di coordinate specifiche.
- con valori di magnitudo all'interno di un intervallo selezionato.
Particolare attenzione è stata rivolta alle informazioni scientifiche riguardanti i terremoti; sono infatti presenti sezioni collegate al blog INGVterremoti ingvterremoti.com.

bluejetty:00031705:ios.description:
As the brand-new installment of the popular Mr. Love series, Love and Deepspace allows you to step into a sci-fi world where love knows no bounds. With immersive cutscenes, 3D storylines and interactions, love is truly within reach!
[First-Person 3D Story]
A real-time rendered 3D first-person perspective story that lets you be fully immersed in important moments with him, feeling his breath and presence up close. It breaks the boundary between reality and virtual worlds, providing an ultimate, lifelike, immersive experience.
[3D Interactions]
Real-time 3D rendering ensures lifelike interactions. Experience intimate moments like never before, watch as your actions provoke unique responses, and savor unforgettable dates, sweet voice messages, and more.
[New Home System]
Kitchen now open! The Home system just got even richer. Invite him to your cozy, carefully decorated home, shop for ingredients, cook together, and unlock exclusive recipes with him. Share more warm everyday moments by each other's side.
[Upgraded Companionship]
The Glint Photobooth feature has been fully upgraded—AR Photobooth is now available! Bring him into any scene and experience romance and companionship beyond the screen to capture exclusive moments. Additionally, during your leisure time, you can play Kitty Cards with him, have a claw machine competition, take a series of Snapshots to record your mood, or study, work, and exercise together. Experience more scenarios with him across dimensions and enjoy even sweeter moments together.
[Fight Together]
As a Deepspace Hunter, you will fight against the onslaught of mysterious alien creatures together with love interests. Along the way, your paths intertwine, and the secrets about your fates and humanity's future will be revealed.
[Profound Immersion]
Choose your voice and look. Delve into an array of customizable features, from dozens of appearance details and hundreds of makeup choices to personalized timbres, all yours to explore. Additionally, the intelligent AI face-crafting system allows you to upload your personal photo to automatically generate a digital avatar of yourself. Enter Linkon City with your own image and embark on a surreal romantic journey.
About Us

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LoveandDeepspaceEN
