bluejetty:00024942:ios.name: Kids coloring book for 3 Romeo
bluejetty:00024942:ios.summary: Romeo Colors is a creative coloring and drawing app designed especially for boys between the ages of three and six. It offers a calm, playful, and safe environment where young children can explore creativity while developing important early
bluejetty:00024942:ios.description:
Romeo Colors is a creative coloring and drawing app designed especially for boys between the ages of three and six. It offers a calm, playful, and safe environment where young children can explore creativity while developing important early learning skills.
The app invites children to color, draw, and create through activities inspired by themes they naturally love, such as dinosaurs, cars, trucks, superheroes, and construction vehicles. Each activity is designed to feel approachable and rewarding, allowing children to enjoy creative play without pressure or frustration.
Romeo Colors includes classic coloring pages, guided drawing activities, and simple pixel art workshops. The drawing guides use progressive steps and clear shapes, helping young children learn how to draw by following visual cues that build confidence over time. The pixel art mode introduces structure and pattern recognition in a playful way that remains accessible to preschool and kindergarten-aged users.
Coloring and drawing are not only fun, they also play an important role in early childhood development. Through regular creative practice, children strengthen fine motor skills, improve hand-eye coordination, and develop focus and patience. Romeo Colors encourages children to take their time, make choices, and feel proud of their creations, supporting emotional development as well as creativity.
The app is designed with parents in mind. It provides an educational alternative to passive screen time and supports independent play in a safe and child-friendly space. The interface is simple, intuitive, and adapted to small hands, making it easy for young children to navigate on their own. Activities can be enjoyed offline, making Romeo Colors a reliable choice for home, travel, or quiet moments after school.
Romeo Colors is suitable for preschool and kindergarten children who are beginning to explore drawing and coloring. It supports early learning by transforming artistic activities into moments of discovery, creativity, and personal expression. Whether a child enjoys dinosaurs, vehicles, or superheroes, the app offers a variety of creative experiences that keep children engaged while supporting their development.
By combining fun themes with educational value, Romeo Colors helps young boys learn through creativity, building confidence and imagination from an early age.

bluejetty:00085625:ios.description:
Pay for your mobility with one app! Pay your parking by phone in more than 200 cities or buy a digital bus, tram and train ticket with the 4411 app!
4411 is the biggest parking app in Belgium with more than 4,5 million loyal users in over 200 cities in Belgium and The Netherlands!
Why should you park with 4411?

4. Get notified when your max. parking time is about to expire

► On-street parking 
Start and stop your parking session via the app and receive automatically notifications about your current session. Only pay for your effective parking time. Simple, fast and never a cent too much.

► Monthly payment
 Automatic payment via debit or credit card Consult your parking sessions and transactions via mijn.4411.be.
 Proximus, Telenet, Base, Scarlet or Orange customers can make use of paid parking via their mobile bill. 
► PRO account 
Looking for a simplified way to manage the mobility costs of you and your employees? The free 4411 PRO account gives you a detailed overview of all mobility costs made within your company. Choose which services you open up to your employees and manage everything digitally via one monthly statement.

bluejetty:00100681:ios.description:
How many female astronauts do you know? How about female painters? History is full of rebel warrior girls who have done incredible things. It's time to meet them.
From aviators to scientists, and artists to civil rights activists, this is a fascinating journey through history alongside the most brilliant and brave women.
With beautiful illustrations and inspiring stories, this app is the perfect introduction to some of the incredible women who have helped us to understand our world better, and to make it a better place to live in.
In this app you will discover the history of:
• Rosa Parks
• Amelia Earhart
• Marie Curie
• Jane Goodall
• Wangari Maathai
• Frida Kahlo
• Malala Yousafzai
• Valentina Tereshkova
• Svetlana Savitskaya
• Sally Ride
• Mae Jemison
• Margaret Hamilton
• Peggy Whitson
• Liu Yang
• Katherine Johnson 
Features
• Incredible stories for boys and girls.
• Full of beautiful illustrations and animations.

bluejetty:00186848:ios.description:
Hallo, schön dass Du unsere App BSP: Bodenseeschifferpatent gefunden hast.
Wir helfen Dir dabei, dass Du Dich optimal auf Deine Prüfung vorbereiten kannst.
In unserer App sind alle relevanten BSP-Scheine enthalten:
• BSP Motor (A)
• BSP Segeln (D)
• BSP Motor + Segeln (A+D)
• Inkl. dem Hochrhein-Patent
Bei jedem Schein kannst Du natürlich auch für das Hochrhein-Patent mitlernen, wenn Du das möchtest.
DIE WICHTIGSTEN FUNKTIONEN AUF EINEN BLICK:
• Alle 518 offiziellen Fragen & Antworten
• Teste erst mit 100 Fragen
• Schalte dir dann alles frei
• Monatlich, Jährlich oder einmalig bezahlen
• Optimale Theorievorbereitung
• Inkl. Praxisvorbereitung
• Alle offiziellen Prüfungsfragen und Antworten
• Erklärungen zu jeder Frage
• Multiple-Choice Antworten
• Prüfungsbögen im offiziellen Prüfungsformat
THEORIE-VORBEREITUNG:
Unsere App enthält die offiziellen Prüfungsfragen mit den offiziell richtigen Antworten im Multiple-Choice-Format, genau wie in der Prüfung. Die zwei falschen Antworten orientieren sich von Form und Inhalt an den echten Prüfungsfragen. So bist Du optimal auf Deine theoretische Prüfung für das Bodenseeschifferpatent vorbereitet.
PRAXIS-VORBEREITUNG:
Um Dir auch die Praxis-Prüfung zu erleichtern, haben wir mit viel Liebe Foto-Tutorials erstellt, damit Du auf dem Wasser auch fürs Knoten binden gerüstet bist. Die App beinhaltet Tutorials für ALLE prüfungsrelevanten Konten. Jeder Knoten hat dazu noch eine Erklärung, die alles Wissenswerte zusammenfasst.
OFFLINE NUTZBAR:
Schlechter Empfang und kein Wifi? Egal, denn unsere App funktioniert zu 100% auch ohne Verbindung. Dadurch kannst Du Leerläufe im Zug oder Bus zur Prüfungsvorbereitung nutzen und verbrauchst dafür kein Datenvolumen.
IM LERNMODUS IMMER ALLES UNTER KONTROLLE:
Unser Ampelsystem zeigt Dir an, welche Fragen Du noch für die Prüfung üben solltest. Dabei entscheidet unser smarter Algorithmus auf Basis Deiner bisherigen Antworten, wie fit Du wirklich bist.
Bei Rot solltest Du die Frage noch ein paar Mal durchgehen und bei Grün bist Du bereit für die Prüfung.
Außerdem kannst Du Dir auch alle Statistiken anzeigen lassen.
Damit wird Deine Prüfung für den BSP Bodenseeschifferpatent zur reinen Formsache.
BEREIT FÜR DIE PRÜFUNG?
Trainiere den Ernstfall und übe mit unseren authentischen Prüfungsbögen. Schaffst Du es in der vorgegebenen offiziellen Prüfungszeit und reicht es für den BSP-Schein?
Spätestens hier entscheidet sich, ob Du für die Prüfung gerüstet bist, wenn Deine Probeprüfung bewertet wird!
Auch hier orientieren wir uns an den echten Prüfungsbögen, um Dich optimal auf Deine Prüfung vorzubereiten.
ALLE FUNKTIONEN AUF EINEN BLICK:
• Alle 518 offiziellen Fragen & Antworten
• Teste erst mit 100 Fragen
• Schalte dir dann alles frei
• Erklärungen zu jeder Frage
• Suchfunktion
• Multiple-Choice Antworten
• Inkl. Praxisvorbereitung
• Foto-Anleitungen für alle relevanten Knoten
• Inkl. Erklärungen zu allen Knoten mit Vor- und Nachteilen
• Leicht verständliches Ampelsystem im Lernmodus 
• Detaillierte Statistiken für den Lernfortschritt 
• Übersichtliche und genaue Kategorisierung aller Fragen
• Inkl. Schildern, Grafiken etc.
• Authentische Prüfungsbögen
• Prüfungsmodus unter realistischen Prüfungsbedingungen
• Eingebauter Abgabetimer mit offizieller Prüfungszeit
• Markiere schwierige Fragen um sie separat zu lernen
• Intuitive Bedienung
• Offline nutzbar
• Optionale Lernerinnerungen
• Schneller Support bei Problemen
Über uns:
Wir sind ehemalige Studenten der TU Berlin und nachdem wir vor einiger Zeit den den SBF Binnen Lehrer herausgebracht haben, möchten wir nun auch dabei helfen, dass jeder schnell und einfach für das Bodenseeschifferpatent lernen kann.
Du siehst, wir machen es Dir so Einfach wie möglich und freuen uns darauf, dass Du so schnell es geht Dein Bodenseeschifferpatent bekommst aufs Wasser kannst.
Viel Erfolg beim Lernen wünscht Dir Dein
BSP: Bodenseeschifferpatent Team!

Craft original stories in a supportive, AI-free community! Unvale allows you to create characters, build worlds, and develop amazing stories piece by piece while receiving motivation from your 300,000+ fellow creatives every step of the way. Defeat artist block, conquer procrastination, and finally start the comic, novel, or animated series that's been sitting in your head. Beginner artists are welcome!

- Answer daily questions about your characters to help define their personalities and backstories. After just a few questions, your characters may be ready for their own world!
- As your following grows, announce upcoming releases, share works-in-progress, and engage with your eager fans.
- When you're feeling stuck, participate in one of the many contests, collaborative worlds, or challenges on the platform! Art block doesn't stand a chance.
Unvale is built by a small team of creatives just like you. We are a 100% AI-free community, and we believe that the future of creativity is human-made. The next generation-defining story is being written on Unvale right now; could it be yours?

You come to CAVA for vibrant, better-for-you options – for convenience and customization. Make your meal completely yours and order it from wherever you are. Then, just head to your preferred CAVA location for easy pickup.

Order Ahead and Avoid the Line – Order in advance for Pick-Up or Delivery to get your food when you want it without waiting in line.

bluejetty:00087212:ios.description:
In the apocalypse, virus-infected beings are attacking the few remaining cities！
As a survivor, you will join the Doomsday Vanguard to become a powerful warrior, exploring ruins and defeating the evil infectees with your comrades!
As the effects of a laboratory virus leak persist, numerous mutated viruses have emerged!
Faced with such a challenging situation, make your end-of-days plan and strive to survive!
Feature Highlights:
-A large number of monsters on the same screen, destroy them!
- Use one hand to scan the entire map!
-Innovative Roguelite skill experience for you to choose from!
-Many level bosses with different difficulty options!
Featured gameplay:
The operation is simple and you can play it anytime and anywhere. No matter where you are, no matter when you want to play, you can play anytime and anywhere.
Hundreds of skills can be matched at will, allowing you to create your own fighting style. In the game, you can choose specific skills and abilities to deal with different combat scenarios and enemies. The combination of different skills can create a variety of powerful combat strategies.
Character upgrading and training give you more powerful abilities. In the game, you can gain experience points and improve your character level by defeating monsters and completing tasks. At the same time, you can also enhance your attributes and abilities by collecting props and equipment.
Equipment is your best friend! Choose the right equipment to improve your combat effectiveness. In the game, you can obtain various equipment by exploring ruins, defeating monsters and completing tasks. These equipment can improve your attack power, defense power and other attributes, making you more powerful in battle.
Many characters:
Alice: Affectionately known as the "Witch of the Sky", she is a gentle and kind-hearted mystic. She is adept at casting spells, harnessing the elements, and weaving miracles in the air with her unique magic. Alice's abilities are not only fascinating, but often helpful when needed most.
Chiharu: A talented geisha whose dance is called "The Falling Flower Fan" and is known for her grace and agility in battle. Her performance on the stage is like a visual feast, and on the battlefield, she defeats her enemies with lightning speed, perfectly combining art and power.
Mio: A mystic with great potential, who is good at harnessing the power of the stars and turning it into his own use. He is well aware of the power of the Star and always uses it for righteous causes. His righteous heart will also become a guiding light for players on their way forward.
More partners are waiting for you~

bluejetty:00118789:ios.description:
The most simple & easy Barcode and QR Code Scanner - download now for FREE!
Explore your world by scanning any QR code or Barcode to get additional information including results from popular online marketplaces such as Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Target, BestBuy, Google, Costco, Kroger, Alibaba etc. - 100% FREE! 
Also Create and Share QR codes to open URLs, connect to WiFi hotspots, add events, read V-Cards, share Geolocation etc. You can even manage product inventory for your business.
FEATURE :
• Scan, Create, Share and Manage QR codes & Barcodes. 
• Auto-detect scanning. Simply point & hold!
• Supported Code formats : QR code, Barcode, EAN 13, EAN 8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, Interleaved 2 of 5, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, DataBar, etc.
• Scan any product code & get price and other detail information about the product.
• Compare product price in best marketplaces : Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Target, BestBuy, Google Shopping, Costco, Kroger, Alibaba.
• Batch Scan Mode. You can scan unlimited Codes without preview right now & check them out later one by one when you are free! Make your shopping convenient, relaxing & stress free.
• Create any types of QR Codes : Text, URL, Phone number, V-Card, SMS, Email, Wi-Fi Hotspot, Calendar, Geolocation etc.
• Search your product result through different search engine : Google, Yahoo, Bing, Duck Duck Go, Baidu, Brave search, Yandex, Naver. 
• Easily manage unlimited scan history, export your history as CSV file and share anywhere you want.
• Instantly send your codes to any configurable web server.
• Use Barcode Scanner for product inventory and quality assurance in your small business.
• Save & Share your codes.

【即時開獎】
每週一至週六晚間 8:30 起，即時同步最新開獎號碼。

【完整獎號清單】
大樂透、威力彩、今彩539、3星彩、4星彩歷史開獎號碼，可在設定中選擇顯示 30、100、300 或 500 期，下載後離線也能查詢。
另提供 38、39、49 樂合彩開獎資訊。

【超級對獎器】
輸入號碼按一按，電腦自動比對，中了什麼獎一目瞭然。

【頭獎累積看得到】
即時掌握大樂透、威力彩槓了幾期、頭獎累積到多少。

【選號產生器】
不知道要買什麼號碼？讓樂透+ 幫你選，離線也能用。

【春節、端午、中秋加碼大紅包】
加碼期間提供大紅包、小紅包獎項資訊與專屬對獎器，幾千組加碼獎號也能秒速完成對獎！

【更多實用功能】
・頭彩商店地圖：找找附近開出頭獎的彩券行
・一鍵分享：開獎結果截圖分享或存到相簿
・開獎推播：開獎、加碼活動第一時間通知

bluejetty:00182579:ios.summary:
Let’s get cookin’!
Join SpongeBob SquarePants on a hilarious culinary adventure through the restaurants and kitchens of Bikini Bottom! When Mr. Krabs realizes there’s more money to be earned in the fast-food business, the penny-pinching en
bluejetty:00182579:ios.description:
Let’s get cookin’!
Join SpongeBob SquarePants on a hilarious culinary adventure through the restaurants and kitchens of Bikini Bottom! When Mr. Krabs realizes there’s more money to be earned in the fast-food business, the penny-pinching entrepreneur sets out to expand his restaurant empire starting with a breakfast stand outside of SpongeBob’s house…and who better to help him run it than SpongeBob SquarePants himself?
Create your own Bikini Bottom kitchen, decorate and customize your restaurant, and get ready to serve up delicious food to your guests! In this fast-food cooking game, put your time management skills to the test and experience the crazy cooking action of the SpongeBob universe. Fire up the grill and get ready to cook!
Fun and Fast-Paced Cooking
Cook and serve up delicious food including Krabby Patties, pancakes, BBQ and more! Get behind the grill as SpongeBob SquarePants to provide speedy service to the residents of Bikini Bottom. You’ll serve tons of familiar faces like Patrick Star, Sandy Cheeks, Squidward and many more! Keep your customers happy and be rewarded with tips, likes and exciting bonuses! Start as a junior fry cook and train to become one of Bikini Bottom’s premier fast-food chefs!
Explore the World of SpongeBob SquarePants
Grill up delicious Krabby Patties in the Krusty Krab, Steaks and Ribs in Sandy’s Treedome, Hot Dogs in Weenie Hut Jr’s and much more as you explore familiar restaurants and new kitchens in Bikini Bottom, Goo Lagoon and beyond! New restaurants and cuisines are added regularly, bringing new cooking challenges and recipes to learn! 
Upgrade and Decorate
Choose new furniture, decorations and more to add your personal touch to the restaurants of SpongeBob SquarePants. Upgrade your kitchen equipment to cook food quickly and provide faster service to your customers. Start out with a basic restaurant design and build your kitchen to one fit for an expert chef!
Collect, Customize and Get Cookin'
Unlock your favorite characters from SpongeBob SquarePants and dress them in amazing outfits inspired by the show! Now, upgrade your characters and get a variety of awesome skills and powers to help you cook in new and delicious ways with our revamped Avatar system! 
Hilarious Storyline
Experience an all-new and exclusive SpongeBob SquarePants story featuring SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs, Squidward, Sandy and Patrick. Play through the hilarious storyline as you progress through the game and unlock new levels. 
Join in Limited-Time Events 
Earn amazing rewards and show off your food-making skills on leaderboards by completing awesome cooking challenges. Take your game on the road with Food Truck events, hone your craft in Serve Streak Challenges and more! With new events and challenges added every week, there is always a reason to stop into Bikini Bottom and get cooking! 
FREE-TO-PLAY:
Please Note: This SpongeBob cooking game is a free to play game that includes optional in-app purchases. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
Terms of Use: http://www.tiltingpoint.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: http://www.tiltingpoint.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00022847:ios.name: Number Search - Hardest Game
bluejetty:00022847:ios.summary: Tired of playing word search games? Try a brand new number search game. This is super hard game to play as you can remember words easily when you play word search game but when it comes to remember big number then its simply super hard righ
bluejetty:00022847:ios.description:
Tired of playing word search games? Try a brand new number search game. This is super hard game to play as you can remember words easily when you play word search game but when it comes to remember big number then its simply super hard right? If so just try this once and I assure you will get to know that you have to use your full brain to play this game.
This game is not just for fun but also its for making brain more sharper. You will never get such brain games ever that we can assure here. We have made this game for all ages so anyone can play this to improve their focus on study or business which they are doing.
Features:
- 8 Challenge Levels: Whether you're a novice or a number search expert, "Number Search Challenge" offers a level to suit your skills. Begin with the simpler levels to grasp the basics, then progress to the more demanding modes for a genuine test of your abilities.
- Daily Puzzles: Take on a daily challenge with three fresh puzzles awaiting you each day. These handpicked puzzles offer an opportunity to earn extra rewards, but be warned, they're not for the faint-hearted. You'll need sharp eyes and quick thinking to complete all three and claim your reward.
- Extreme Mode: Are you seeking the ultimate test of your number-searching skills? Look no further than Extreme Mode. Here, the grids reach their maximum size, a challenging 15x15, and the numbers to find are numerous and difficult. Prepare yourself for the toughest puzzles yet, designed to push even the most experienced players to their limits.
- Hidden Mode: Step into a world of deduction and numerical prowess with Hidden Mode. In this captivating twist on traditional number search gameplay, the numbers you seek aren't fully visible. Instead, they come with missing digits, requiring you to use your cognitive skills and detective-like intuition to figure out the correct numbers and uncover the hidden digits within the grid.
- Against the Clock Mode: Experience the thrill as you race against the clock in Against the Clock Mode. Here, numbers are presented to you one by one, each accompanied by a ticking timer. Your objective? To locate and identify the number before time runs out. But fear not, as you have the option to strategically use resume tokens, allowing you to continue where you left off if the timer catches you off guard. Test your speed, focus, and accuracy in this heart-pounding mode of number-searching excitement.
We assure that this type of gameplay you have never seen in any other number search or word search games till now. So this said this is unique game to play. Any word game will not give you this type of smooth gameplay for sure.
Gameplay is very similar to any word search games you playing but the only difference is that its numbers from 0 to 9 without any proper words which you can remember easily. Numbers is hard to remember always so this will make game super challenging here.
This great Brain Game or Puzzle game or Calm Game, OR Relaxing game or whatever you can call this will give you super smooth and relaxing gameplay which you have never seen before. Ofcourse we will keep improving game always based on our users feedback.
You may have question that who can play this puzzle game? And answer is very simple that: Anyone can play this game as this game providing everything with each human being needs which includes fun, relaxation, save phone's battery, and most importantly improve focus and improve brain power. This also improved your math skills too. So you may consider this as math game too. In short call this with any name you like but main things will remains always same which is fun with focus improvements.

bluejetty:00033294:ios.description:
Plaud is the AI work companion trusted by over 3 million professionals worldwide.
Capture meetings, calls and conversations, then turn them into the work you need next. Plaud Intelligence helps you transcribe, summarize, find past context and get work done from every conversation.
At the center is Plaud Agent. Give it a task in plain language and it sees it through: drawing on the right context from your Knowledge base, producing finished work in the format you need, and delivering it where it needs to go.
CAPTURE IN-PERSON MEETINGS, PHONE CALLS, AND ONLINE MEETINGS
Use a Plaud device for in-person meetings, phone calls and conversations on the go. Use Plaud Desktop for online meetings, with no meeting bot required.
Capture more than audio. Highlight key moments as they happen, add notes and include images to give Plaud richer context.
Everything stays together across Plaud Mobile, Plaud Web and Plaud Desktop.
TURN RECORDINGS INTO TRANSCRIPTS AND CLEAR NOTES
Get transcripts and AI summaries after every recording, with support for over 112 languages, and custom vocabulary.
GET WORK DONE WITH PLAUD AGENT
Tell Plaud Agent what you need in plain language. It finds the right context from your conversations and knowledge, then turns it into the work you need.
Use Plaud Agent to:
- Turn customer calls into a research brief
- Draft follow-ups and emails from meetings
- Create project updates, reports, and presentations
- Bring back relevant context from weeks or months ago
- Reuse your preferred workflows with Skills
- Automate recurring work with Routines
- Work across Slack, Notion, Google Calendar, Linear and more
Create ready-to-use documents, presentations, reports and more, with links back to the relevant moments in the original recording for verification. Plaud asks for your confirmation before anything is sent or posted on your behalf.
USE PLAUD EVERYWHERE
Your recordings, transcripts and knowledge stay in sync across Plaud Mobile, Plaud Web and Plaud Desktop, with unlimited cloud storage.
CHOOSE THE PLAN THAT FITS HOW YOU WORK
Every Plaud device includes the Starter Plan, so you can start recording, transcribing and using Plaud Intelligence right away.
Starter Plan
Includes 300 transcription minutes each month.
Pro Plan
Includes 1,200 transcription minutes each month for professionals who record and transcribe more regularly.
Unlimited Plan
Unlimited transcription for professionals who capture conversations throughout their day.
Team Plan
Built for teams, with centralized management, file sharing and shared knowledge capabilities.
GLOBAL SECURITY STANDARDS
Plaud is compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and EN 18031.
PLAUD Terms of Service & END-USER LICENSE AGREEMENT : https://app.plaud.ai/user-agreement
Terms of Use : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00144630:ios.description:
The TopCard Security App is your secure and comfortable gateway to our digital services, such as the TopCard Portal and the TopCard Mobile App.
This is how easy it is:
• TopCard Portal: Open the login page, scan the QR code with the Security App and enter the PIN to securely log in to the TopCard Portal.
• Mobile App: Start the Mobile App, enter the PIN – done!
Benefit of the TopCard Security App:
• Quick and easy access to digital services
This is how secure the TopCard Security App is:
• The Security App is protected by a password (PIN) of your choice, even if you should lose the smartphone.
• The Security App generates and validates a new security code (one-time password) each time you log in to the Web Portal or Mobile App.
• We keep the Security App up to date in order to offer you optimum protection with two-factor authentication at all times. 
How to activate the app:
• Load the "TopCard Security App" on your smartphone.
• Start the app and follow the instructions to activate it.
Requirements:
• TopCard Credit Card or Prepaid Card
• Device with iOS 15 or higher
• Jailbroken devices are not supported. 
The TopCard team hopes you enjoy using the TopCard Security App. We are looking forward to your feedback and your rating in the App Store.

bluejetty:00084196:ios.summary:

Get to grips with a pug game specifi
bluejetty:00084196:ios.description:
Look no further!
The most pug-tastic of all pet games is finally here, so join the adventure with Super Pug Play a story match-3 puzzle that’s on a whole new level, one that stands out from all the rest.
Get to grips with a pug game specifically developed to make you look at matching puzzle games in a completely new way. You’re sure to have seen and played tons of cute match-3 games before, both on- and offline, as plenty of them are available. If you haven’t though, but always wondered what it would be like to play one, Super Pug Story is the best possible match-3 puzzle game to start off with. 
What we’re about to introduce you to here is just such a match-3 puzzle, but one with quite a few striking and unique features that will take your breath away. How this game is unlike any other matching puzzle game What exactly is Super Pug Story? Well, it’s a little bit of a toons game, a pet story, a bit of a story puzzle, and, most obviously, a fascinating and well-designed 3-in-a-row game, in which the main task is to combine gems and use magic boosters. As one of the latest fun and free no WiFi games, you can play this super match-3 story on any device. And this adventure match-3 has been brought to a brand-new level with its coherent and logical story featuring an intrepid hero. 
On top of that, the game’s other key features that set it apart from most other new match-three games, or offline puzzle games in general, are all about making you a winner. The game is full of funny characters and pleasant surprises, making it potentially one of the best new cute offline match-3 games out there. But what else does Super Pug Story have to offer? All free-to-play 3-in-a-row games try to offer players something special, so we’ve decided to let you swap lives among your friends to extend your playtime and have even more fun! A game with virtual pugs Who hasn’t fallen in love with the cute characters in these free games? Having studied your tastes, we discovered that pug games deservedly occupy one of the top positions among active players in both the story games category and fun offline games you can play with no WiFi. 
Rigorous but easy-to-play, the pug game you’re just about to dive into is the ultimate match-3 adventure that will put a smile on your face while helping you wind down. No other casual puzzle story or match adventure game has such bright graphics and challenging gameplay as Super Pug Story. Though the concept might not be brand new in the world of entertainment and 3-in-a-row games, this free puzzle adventure with a virtual pet option is sure to appeal to everyone thanks to its cutest characters, colorful game spaces, and well-designed levels. We have no doubt whatsoever that Super Pug Story will become one of your most favorite match-3 adventure quest games, not to mention your top offline games.
 So feel free to recommend it not only to your friends but also to basically anyone and everyone with a little time to spare on their smartphone. You won’t want to stop or switch to any other 3-in-a-row game, either free or paid, we promise.
 Join the Super Pug squad right now and let’s get playing!

bluejetty:00180387:ios.description:
MagicBoard is a snippet manager & auto paste keyboard app. 
We all copy and paste the same things again and again. Email replies, links, forms, video titles, app links, you name it. MagicBoard saves you time by keeping your most used text, links, and snippets inside your keyboard so you can paste them anywhere with just one tap. 
### Who it is for 
- Anyone who types a lot: From filling forms to replying to DMs and emails, your saved snippets are always ready. 
- Creators: Quickly share YouTube videos or channel links, even as stickers for Instagram. 
- Developers: Connect your apps and instantly share links, ask for reviews, or send promo text. 
### Why choose MagicBoard 
- User experience first. Simple, fast and reliable. 
- A design crafted with love, improved year after year. 
- Privacy first. Your snippets stay private on your device. 
- Time saved adds up. A few seconds saved each day becomes hours every year. 
### Features 
- Organize snippets into folders and access them from the keyboard. 
- Auto paste or copy snippets with one tap. 
- Translate snippets instantly with Apple Intelligence running on your device. 
- Generate fresh variations of your snippets with AI so you never sound repetitive. 
- Clipboard manager to import and reuse text faster. 
- YouTube integration for creators. Share video links, thumbnails or stickers in seconds. 
- App Store integration for developers. Share app links or request reviews right from the keyboard. 
MagicBoard was first built for personal use. I relied on it every day long before it became public on the App Store. 
Over the years it has saved me hundreds of hours. Now it can do the same for you. 
T&Cs and privacy policy available here: https://www.edouardbarbier.com/apps/fast-paste/privacy/ 
TLDR: No data collected, besides a few Analytics events to understand how the features are being used so I can improve the app in the future.

bluejetty:00077587:ios.name: Ginst - Arcade Music Game
bluejetty:00077587:ios.summary:
Ginst - Gravity Instrument
ABOUT
Learning to play music can be fun, inspiring, time consuming, but one thing is certain – it’s never easy. It is necessary to choose the appropriate instrument, to spend money and time for music classes and
bluejetty:00077587:ios.description:
Ginst - Gravity Instrument
ABOUT
Learning to play music can be fun, inspiring, time consuming, but one thing is certain – it’s never easy. It is necessary to choose the appropriate instrument, to spend money and time for music classes and to ensure patience for everything ahead. Not anymore.
Thanks to the intuitive interface, Ginst allows you to easily master the basics of playing, the easiest way – just enjoy the game.
This game uses original, custom made music themes available at SoundCloud service.
Ginst - the right move for your ears.
GAME BASICS
Ginst will turn your phone into a musical instrument! Explore different genres by playing carefully crafted levels in the Arcade. Play custom levels by loading MIDI files through an integrated browser. Compete with friends online or play as a band in local multiplayer. Be a part of the new musical experience!
MUSIC THEMES
Every player has the choice to use predefined themes in accordance with own musical style and sensibility: Rock, Classic, EDM and Ginst theme.
GAME MODES
Arcade - Master your skills through a series of tutorials and songs. Play songs to unlock new game modes: Quick Play, Multiplayer and Free-play.
Quick Play - Play your song in three modes: Lead, Bass, Percussive. Change your difficulty:
* Easy - just tap with left and right thumbs to produce note sound when note hits the keyboard
* Medium - use the G sensor on your phone to get the right pitch position. Playing range is larger to help catch the notes.
* Hard - Same as medium, but Playing range is exactly one note pitch.
* Expert - Play your song with G sensor on your phone with no visual data. You must use the right move for your ears :) .
Free Play - Import your favorite MIDI songs, take your instrument, select tracks to play and enjoy harmony.
* Musician - Play your music while moving your phone in freestyle. Use G sensor and specific thumbs moves to make polyphony.
Multiplayer - Play Ginst with your friends in the local network. Select Lead, Bass or Percussive track for every player. Play your instruments and songs with your band.
Preview - Watch and listen. See how our AI plays songs and learn.
Musical Instruments - You can change your musical instrument and play every mode with your desired sound.
LICENCES
Ginst - Gravity Instrument uses Unreal® Engine. Unreal® is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. in the United States of America and elsewhere. Unreal® Engine, Copyright 1998 – 2020, Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved.
This application uses a Fluid Synth Library. You can find its source code at: https://github.com/FluidSynth/fluidsynth.
PRIVACY POLICY
https://www.g2ames.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00040907:ios.name: Plixi: Body Fat Calculator
bluejetty:00040907:ios.summary:
The professional body fat calculator that goes beyond just numbers. Measure
with your caliper, calculate with validated formulas, and track your patients'
progress over time — all in one app that works 100% offline.
PROFESSIONAL-GRADE FORM
bluejetty:00040907:ios.description:
The professional body fat calculator that goes beyond just numbers. Measure
with your caliper, calculate with validated formulas, and track your patients'
progress over time — all in one app that works 100% offline.
PROFESSIONAL-GRADE FORMULAS
Choose from scientifically validated body density formulas — Durnin/Womersley
(4 sites), Jackson/Pollock (3 sites), and Jackson/Pollock (7 sites) — combined
with Siri, Brozek, or Behnke body fat equations. Each formula is optimized for
different populations, giving you the flexibility to match the right method to
each client.
TWO MODES, ONE APP
- Professional Mode: Manage multiple patients, track their progress, and share
 results. Ideal for nutritionists, personal trainers, and healthcare providers.
- Individual Mode: A streamlined experience focused on tracking your own body
 composition and body fat percentage.
COMPLETE PATIENT MANAGEMENT
- Create detailed patient profiles with custom fields
- Save unlimited measurements with full history
- View evolution charts for body fat, weight, BMI, and lean mass
- Photo gallery with before/after comparison
- Share visual progress summaries via WhatsApp, email, or any app
BUILT-IN MEASUREMENT GUIDE
Not sure where to measure? Each skinfold site includes step-by-step
instructions, anatomical descriptions, and practical tips to ensure accurate
readings every time.
BODY FAT RANGES TABLE
Compare your results against age and gender-specific body fat ranges — from
competition level to obesity — so you always know where you stand.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
- BMI and Lean Mass calculations included
- Customizable calculator display and formula settings
- Export & import data for easy backup and device migration
- Works 100% offline — no internet required
- Dark and light theme
- Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian
Free to download. Optional Premium subscription unlocks unlimited patients, full
measurement history, evolution charts, photo gallery, data export, and an
ad-free experience.

bluejetty:00186615:ios.description:
Master GMAT math formulas and solve GMAT questions with free flashcards for iOS. Practice every day to prep for the test and get a better GMAT quant score!
• 425 math cards written by our expert GMAT tutors
• Includes GMAT practice questions, solutions, and common mistakes
• Cards cover all difficulty levels
• Track your progress as you study
• Smart algorithm focuses your practice for efficient learning
This app gives you free access to all of Magoosh’s GMAT math flash cards. Sign in with a Magoosh account (or create a new one) to save your progress to the web. You can continue your practice online at http://gmat.magoosh.com/flashcards/math/
Written by GMAT experts
===
All of the formulas were selected and explained with usage examples by Magoosh’s expert GMAT tutors, led by Mike McGarry. He has been teaching the GMAT for more than 10 years.
Review that really sticks
===
Academic research has found that memories are formed by repeated exposure to new information, so Magoosh’s flashcard app uses a spaced repetition system. Concepts you are learning will reappear frequently (occurring less frequently the better you know them) and concepts you already know won’t be repeated. The GMAT list is also culled to only 425 so that you don't waste time learning unimportant concepts.
“I really like the way the words appear and the simple interface to show progress of the user. You guys have put good use of algorithms so one comes out learning the words well. The best flashcard app to date.” - Arif
"I was able to learn more words in the 4th week by using your flash card app than I learnt over the previous 3 weeks using Barron's 1100." - Sai
About Magoosh

bluejetty:00078760:ios.description:
Take control of your cardiovascular health. Whether you're managing BP hypertension, tracking your heart health, or simply promoting overall well-being, this app is your go-to companion.
Key Features:
• Manual Blood Pressure Log:
Easily log your blood pressure readings manually and keep a comprehensive record of your measurements over time. The app intuitively organizes your data for quick and convenient reference.
• Notes and AI Insights:
Add personal notes to each entry to capture important context or observations. Gain valuable AI insights into your health trends and share the information with your healthcare provider for informed discussions.
• Apple Health Kit Integration:
Seamlessly sync your blood pressure data with Apple Health Kit, ensuring a centralized hub for all your health information.
• Heart Rate and HRV Measurement:
Utilize your device's camera to measure your heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) accurately. Track changes in real-time and gain a deeper understanding of your cardiovascular health.
• In-Depth HRV Analysis:
Benefit from comprehensive HRV analysis tools that provide insights into your heart health and general well-being. Understand how stress, sleep, and daily activities impact your cardiovascular system.
• Science-Backed Breathing Exercises:
Access a variety of science-backed breathing exercises designed to help regulate blood pressure and improve overall heart health. Follow guided sessions to enhance relaxation and promote a sense of well-being.
Empower yourself with the tools you need to monitor, understand, and improve your cardiovascular health. Download the Blood Pressure Monitor & Heart Health Tracker app now and take proactive steps toward a healthier future.

This app is not to be used as a medical device.
Please consult your doctor incase of any medical condition, seeking medical advice or making medical decisions.

bluejetty:00087117:ios.description:
Hangtight is the resident engagement platform that turns dorms, apartments, and off-campus student housing into connected communities. Whether you’re a student wanting to stay informed and involved or housing staff looking to boost connection and retention, Hangtight brings everything together in one easy hub.
Say goodbye to scattered group chats, missed announcements, and forgotten plans. With Hangtight, you get:
• Organized Circles — Build groups for your floor, building, or even 1,000+ residents. Drop announcements, events, polls, and payment requests once — everyone sees it.
• Focused Chats & Threads — Keep floor updates, RA messages, maintenance requests, and move-in details in dedicated threads without clutter. Pin checklists, guidelines, and FAQs so chats double as your living resident handbook.
• Events & Calendar — See what’s happening in your dorm or building. Join study sessions, game nights, floor events, and community hangouts. RSVP, stay in the loop, and actually show up.
• Polls, Pics & More — Quick feedback from residents, share pics, and stay connected with direct messaging.
• Staff Controls — RAs and managers decide who sees what, keeping things clear and reducing noise while tracking engagement to drive better retention.
From small RA groups to large properties, Hangtight scales seamlessly for on-campus dorms and off-campus student housing. Residents feel more informed, engaged, and at home — because housing should be more than just a place to sleep.

bluejetty:00078204:ios.description:
Controlling Screen Time is critical for mental health, focus, productivity, and relationships. Social media and other addictive apps can easily distract you from your goals.
Clearspace helps you control screen time by giving you the tools to fight phone addiction by making your phone less addictive. Clearspace blocks distractions while retaining utilities. Say goodbye to impulse opens and social media doom scrolling. 
You don’t need to quit cold turkey or buy a dumb phone in order to get your scrolling in check. Instead of a new device, Clearspace gives you the freedom to make sober minded decisions about your usage allowing you to get control of your screen time.
Attention is a precious resource, protect it with Clearspace features:
- Block and Limit apps: block any apps you find distracting and limit screen time.
- Social Media Doomscrolling: app time limits enable session management makes sure you don’t scroll for too long.
- Focus management: set schedules for when to use apps
- Habit change: dopamine is less powerful when you pause before opening an app which eventually creates a virtuous habit loop to make habits more atomic.
- Screen Time Challenges: train your attention by engaging in challenges that strengthen your ability to focus.
- Minimalist Design: the app is straightforward. We don’t want to take your attention away, instead we give it back to you.
- Screen Time Accountability: have trusted accountability partners help you stick to your goals.
- Screen Time Reporting: Streaks and budgets give you a better look at your screen time data in a way that helps you improve.
- Digital Wellbeing: Align your intentions with your usage of your phone. Alignment can be helpful in health journeys battling anxiety and adhd.
Blocking Apps helps you control impulse clicks. Users find that Clearspace helps them:
- Reduce social media impulse opens
- Focus on deep work and engage in flow state activities
Social Media Doomscrolling is the cause of excessive screen time for many people, with Clearspace users report that:
- Phone Addiction subsides
- Dopamine craving for apps is less powerful
Digital Minimalism is a new health wave that Clearspace enables for users:
- Limiting apps in alignment with your intention
- Mindfulness practices encourage a more balanced approach to phone usage
Digital Wellbeing is a large and growing consideration in the health and wellness spaces. Clearspace users have found it helpful in dealing with:
- Anxiety
- ADHD
- Depression
- Socializing
Research demonstrates that negative habits are hard to change through willpower alone, but that small, recurring nudges are effective at reshaping default patterns of behavior.
Enter Clearspace.
The idea is simple:
- Select an app that you want to use less
- When you click on a selected app, decide - proceed after a deep breath or opt out?
- Over time, you'll notice you are in control of the usage
Controlling Screen Time is essential for digital wellbeing, freedom from phone addiction, and maintaining focus. Clearspace empowers users with app limits, screen time control, and an app blocker to combat social media distractions. By aligning intentions with usage, Clearspace fosters healthier habits and a mindful approach to technology. Its minimalist design ensures attention is not diverted, enabling users to reclaim their time and break free from the grips of excessive screen time. With features such as screen time reporting, accountability partners, and challenges, Clearspace offers the tools needed to reshape default patterns of behavior and reduce the powerful hold of dopamine-driven app cravings. Embrace Clearspace as your ally in the journey towards a balanced digital lifestyle. Clearspace is a diet program for your digital consumption. A reminder to breathe before making decisions.

bluejetty:00095748:ios.description:
Ricochet Squad is a 3v3 multiplayer PvP hero shooter where physics driven abilities, destructible objects, and vertical movement mean no two matches play out the same way twice.
Truly Interactive
Forget flat, static maps. Every object in the arena reacts to what you do. Grab a meteorite mid fight, pull enemies into a black hole, or knock them off a ledge with a gravity blast. Heroes have physics based abilities that interact with the environment and each other. The combos you can pull off aren't scripted, they're real. Multi level arenas with vertical gameplay mean fights happen above, below and all around you.
Master Your Hero
Every hero plays different, so find the one that fits your style. Rush in as a brawler, hold the line as a tank, back up your team as support or pick off enemies from range with sniper. But choosing the right hero is just the start. It's not only about which abilities you use, but how you move and position yourself. Controls are simple to learn but give you real precision and auto aim keeps the action fast while smart positioning wins fights.
Squad Up and Rank Up
This isn't a solo carry game. Winning takes real teamwork. Combine hero abilities for devastating synergies, coordinate pushes, and cover each other's weaknesses. Matches are fast, just 3 to 5 minutes, so every second counts. Find your squad, experiment with different hero combos, and climb the ranked ladder together.
Your Ship, Your Progress
Between matches, your ship is your home base. Upgrade your heroes, explore the world, complete quests, and unlock new characters. The more you play, the more there is to discover.
Ready to become part of Ricochet Squad?

bluejetty:00082121:ios.description:
Bubble Shooter Gem Pop is a strategy puzzle game. Complete multiple levels to engage your brain and relax your body. Experience different level layouts, and you'll entertained for hours and never get bored!
Explore this bubble space world, where you will help a cute cat called Mars fly to space and collect rainbow gems. Aim, match, and smash all the balls in this color-matching adventure and discover the ultimate bubble-popping fun!

bluejetty:00079721:ios.name: Speed Monster: Rope Hero City
bluejetty:00079721:ios.summary: Welcome to the city of wild animals. Your hero in a powerful animal is ready to act. A third-person action game in a big city awaits you. The game location is full of dangerous and exciting adventures. Plunge into the open 3D world with you
bluejetty:00079721:ios.description:
Welcome to the city of wild animals. Your hero in a powerful animal is ready to act. A third-person action game in a big city awaits you. The game location is full of dangerous and exciting adventures. Plunge into the open 3D world with your hero and fight with other dangerous animal enemy. You have to act in a modern nightmare metropolis. The city map is open from the very beginning, this will allow you to visit anywhere in the city. The city hides a large number of secrets and mini-games. Explore the urban jungle, discover interesting places for you and find out what is happening there. For example, at a military base, you can get ammo, weapons, a first-aid kit, or unique military equipment for you. The game has cool guns, beautiful cars, realistic physics and much more. To fight against bandits, your man will have superpowers. It's time to become a superhero and survival in the city. It's time to become strong, fast and hardy.
The game world is full of various dangers. Street gangs engaged in illegal activities flooded the city streets. Thieves and killers will lie in wait for you at every turn. Corrupt animal police will interfere with your confrontation. The harsh city streets will not let you relax. Here you can easily be robbed or beaten. Beware of street gangs in the alleys if you are not ready for the confrontation.
The main mission of your hero is to infiltrate an underground empire. To do this, you need to complete tasks in order to understand how the devil world works. When you realize that you’ve fully figured out in the city, act like a superhero. Eliminate all the bandits and the rest of the evil that has enveloped this city.
If you get tired of the intense action, you can always calmly explore the city in a car with good music. The game features beautiful sports cars and a large list of radio stations. Ride to interesting places.
Take your daily rewards. Come and get rewards every day and get the main prize for free. In the game, you can always replenish the supply of crystals by receiving them for free several times a day.
When passing the game, your hero will receive a level that depends on the gaming experience. The hero's skill grows in the direction with which you interact most.
Get all the achievements and unlock a valuable prize.
In difficult fights with enemies, the skill abilities may not be enough. For this, the game has a weapons store. You can buy everything you need.
In the game a large number of vehicles you can ride on any of them. Get equipment and keep it in your garage.
You can find or buy a tank and be safe.
Become an urban legend. The city is waiting for you. Take advantage of the super animal rope hero to the maximum.

bluejetty:00200066:ios.description:
Welcome to The Spalding Method ™ Phonograms app!
NOTICE: Upon installing this mobile application, you are agreeing to the terms and conditions.
This Spalding Phonograms app is designed for helping students learn the phonics connection between speech sounds and written symbols that represent those sounds (phonograms). Learning the phonograms is essential for accurate and automatic reading, writing, and spelling. Teaching all the sounds of the phonemes represented by an alphabet letter or combination of two, three, or four letters (phonograms) enables students to read, spell, and write high-frequency words quickly. Students who learn the phonograms well expand their vocabulary and are able to use effective and creative communication skills in writing. Critical thinking is involved in learning the appropriate phonogram placement within words for accurate spelling and for applying information learned during phonogram reviews to pronounce unfamiliar words. 
The Spalding Phonograms app is for students that need additional practice, including home schooling, ESL (English as a Second Language), ELL (English Language Learners), ESOL (English for Speakers of Other Languages) students, and those with dyslexia or other learning disabilities. The school and home connection is encouraged through collaboration and communication with the teacher, parent, and student for practicing the phonograms appropriately and adequately. The Spalding Phonograms app aligns with the core reading foundational skills required by state and national standards that are most crucial to the development of early reading success and reading comprehension, including:
• Phonemic awareness
• Feature recognition
• Letter recognition
• Sound-symbol relationships (decoding)
The Spalding Phonograms app provides the following options for all 87 phonograms.
• Phonogram Introduction by selected group – The student sees the phonograms in order of instruction in The Writing Road to Reading, listens to the teacher say the sound(s), and then says the sound(s).
• Oral Phonogram Review – A random phonogram card is show, followed by a pause. The student says the sound(s) and then listens to check accuracy. 
• Written Phonogram Review –The student hears the phonogram sounds, followed by a pause; the student repeats the sound(s), listens for a cue, if needed, and then writes the phonogram on lined paper. The card is immediately shown so the student can check for accuracy.
• Differentiated Practice – Specific phonograms (from all 87) can be selected that need more practice. These phonograms can then be practiced in Phonogram Introduction, Oral Phonogram Review, or Written Phonogram Review.

The school and home connection is encouraged through collaboration and communication with the teacher, parent, and student for practicing the phonograms appropriately and adequately. The Spalding  Phonograms app aligns with the core reading foundational skills required by state and national standards that are most crucial to the development of early reading success and reading comprehension, including:
•	Phonemic awareness
•	Feature recognition
•	Letter recognition
•	Sound-symbol relationships (decoding)
The Spalding Phonograms app provides the following options for all 87 phonograms.
•	Phonogram Introduction by selected group – The student sees the phonograms in order of instruction in The Writing Road to Reading, listens to the teacher say the sound(s), and then says the sound(s).
•	Oral Phonogram Review – A random phonogram card is show, followed by a pause. The student says the sound(s) and then listens to check accuracy. 
•	Written Phonogram Review –The student hears the phonogram sounds, followed by a pause; the student repeats the sound(s), listens for a cue, if needed, and then writes the phonogram on lined paper. The card is immediately shown so the student can check for accuracy.
•	Differentiated Practice – Specific phonograms (from all 87) can be selected that need more practice. These phonograms can then be practiced in Phonogram Introduction, Oral Phonogram Review, or Written Phonogram Review.

Choose to split a check and fund multiple accounts. If your check is approved, the money is as good as cash and safe to spend on purchases and payments made in-store, online and in Apple Pay. Terms and fees apply.
ENROLL, SNAP, GO!
It’s easy to get started. Create your Ingo Money profile right in the app and then link your bank debit card, prepaid card and PayPal account. To cash your check, take a photo of the front and back and submit it for review. If your check is approved and your account is funded, the money is guaranteed. No check cashing lines. No deposit holds. No take-backs. No worries.
With Ingo Money, it’s in with a check, and on with your life.
__________________________________________

You can also access the Ingo Money service in dozens of mobile banking apps including American Express Serve® and Bluebird by American Express. bluejetty:00200168:ios.summary: Satisfy is a box of eleven tactile toys made for iPhone Duo, where the hinge is the toy. Open the phone, close it, snap it flat: every toy answers with sound you can hear and haptics you can feel. No goals, no score, no timers. Just somethi
bluejetty:00200168:ios.description:
Satisfy is a box of eleven tactile toys made for iPhone Duo, where the hinge is the toy. Open the phone, close it, snap it flat: every toy answers with sound you can hear and haptics you can feel. No goals, no score, no timers. Just something deeply satisfying to do with your hands.
THE TOYS
• Wrap: a brand-new sheet of bubble wrap. Pop one bubble, or run a finger down a whole row.
• Firework: open the phone all the way and a shell bursts over the harbor. Tap the sky for more.
• Slime: glossy, sticky slime that stretches when you move slowly and churns when you move fast.
• Peel: peel the protective film off a brand-new phone as you open it.
• Pencils: a felt-tip starburst that draws itself with every fold.
• Glow: bend the glow stick across the fold until it snaps and neon floods out.
• Fire: the phone becomes a pair of bellows. Every closing stroke makes the fire roar.
• Bubbles: fan the phone open to blow soap bubbles, then pop them with a finger.
• Warp: open it to throttle up, snap it flat to jump to light speed.
• Coffee and Matcha: tilt the hinge to pour cold milk into an iced drink, stir it, then shut the phone to drink it.
MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Every toy uses a different part of the hinge: how far it's open, how fast it moves, the moment it snaps flat. The big moments land right where the hardware snaps, so the toy and the phone click together.
ON ANY IPHONE AND IPAD
No fold? Every toy plays by touch: hold, tap, swipe and rub, on any iPhone and on iPad.
ONE PURCHASE
Everything is included. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no account. Satisfy doesn't collect any data.

bluejetty:00126431:ios.description:

Used by over one million people worldwide every year, it is one of the premier platforms for computer science education. bluejetty:00075185:ios.name: Solitaire Match 3 Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00075185:ios.summary: Step into a world where classic solitaire strategy meets dazzling match 3 game fun! In Solitaire Match Game, you'll embark on a puzzle-filled adventure through a magical land where every move counts, every gem sparkles, and every challenge
bluejetty:00075185:ios.description:
Step into a world where classic solitaire strategy meets dazzling match 3 game fun! In Solitaire Match Game, you'll embark on a puzzle-filled adventure through a magical land where every move counts, every gem sparkles, and every challenge feels like a true test of mastery. From MobilityWare, the creators of the original App Store Solitaire, this is not just another bejeweled-style game, it's a beautifully crafted journey designed to delight both new players and experienced puzzle masters alike.
A Legendary Blend of Match 3 Fun
Swap and match dazzling jewels, sparkling gems, colorful candy, and shiny blocks to clear obstacles, complete quests, and collect stars. Combine three, four, or even triple matches in a row to unleash explosive chain reactions. Watch as boosters and power-ups create stunning 3D visual effects, filling the screen with satisfying blasts and brilliant streaks of light.
Epic Quests and Royal Rewards
Travel across a saga map filled with thousands of levels set in a sparkling kingdom of castles, forests, and enchanted lands. Along the way, you'll encounter unique challenges that demand clever strategy and quick thinking. Whether you're racing through puzzle blitz, carefully plotting moves to beat tricky obstacles, or crushing blocks in special challenge stages, every level feels fresh and rewarding. Collect crowns, treasures, and stars as you prove yourself worthy of the title of puzzle master.
Features Fit for a Royal Puzzle Master
-Classic match 3 gameplay fused with the charm of solitaire
-Match shining jewels, dazzling gems, and sweet candy pieces
-Strategically plan your moves to create powerful combos and blasts
-Discover challenge levels with unique puzzles and special objectives
-Collect boosters, unlock spectacular power-ups, and master every level
-Progress through thousands of stages across an enchanted magical land 
-Enjoy stunning animations, colorful 3D visuals, and satisfying effects
-Easy to pick up for casual players, deep enough for dedicated puzzle masters
Why Players Love Solitaire Match Game
Fans of bejeweled, blast games, candy-style puzzles, and solitaire classics will feel right at home. The addictive gameplay loop of swapping, matching, and progressing keeps boredom at bay, while the endless variety of puzzles makes each session feel fresh. Whether you want a quick soda blitz of fun on your coffee break or a deep dive into a magical land of puzzles for hours on end, Solitaire Match Game delivers exactly what you crave. It's the perfect blend of relaxation and excitement, offering a satisfying sense of progress with every star you earn and every level you conquer.
FAQ – Everything You Need to Know About Solitaire Match Game

bluejetty:00019490:ios.summary: Experience the life of a taxi driver in our latest taxi simulator game. Complete different types of driving missions as a taxi or private taxi driver and pick your favorite car from a selection of over 30 amazing vehicles, with more new car
bluejetty:00019490:ios.description:
Experience the life of a taxi driver in our latest taxi simulator game. Complete different types of driving missions as a taxi or private taxi driver and pick your favorite car from a selection of over 30 amazing vehicles, with more new cars being added weekly. 
Navigate around huge cities like New York, Miami, Rome or Los Angeles and adjust your driving style to different types of clients - some are in a hurry and don’t care if you run a red light, while others are terrified of dangerous driving. We take taxi simulation games to a new level with VIP clients, undecided clients and verious types of daily and lifetime milestones.
Start your taxi driving career with regular cars and work your way up to SUVs, luxury cars, sports cars and supercars. Buy better cars to be able to pick up VIP clients and to earn more for each mission. Each car you buy can be played both in taxi and private taxi mode.
Enjoy the stunning graphics and environments in this open-world driving experience. We’ve added features you won’t find in any other taxi simulation games: pedestrians open umbrellas when it rains, there are hundreds of destructible objects, there is a realistic density of cars and people on the sidewalk. Feel like an actual taxi driver with realistic controls and sounds!
Work your way up to the top in the Career mode, drive around and relax in Free Roam or play with your friends in Online Multiplayer. Help us in our effort to make this the most complete and rewarding taxi simulation game - please share your feedback!
Features
-Amazing selection of different types of vehicles
-Huge cities to explore
-Realistic Controls (tilt steering, buttons or virtual steering wheel)
-2020 updated engine sounds
-Realistic vehicle features (you car will get dirty or require repairs)
-Visual Tuning options
-Spectacular environments and weather
-Realistic city traffic (cars, vans, trucks, motorcycles, bicycles)
-Diverse and realistic pedestrian traffic
-Career, Free Roam and Multiplayer modes
-New cars and challenges added weekly
-Request new vehicles or features on our Social Pages!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.ovilex.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00193560:android.name: Find a Way: Addictive Puzzle
bluejetty:00193560:android.summary:
Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication - Leonardo da Vinci 
Find A Way is a simple minimalist puzzle game about connecting dots and spreading happiness. This brain-stimulating puzzle game is free to play, very simple, and enjoyable for
bluejetty:00193560:android.description:
Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication - Leonardo da Vinci 
Find A Way is a simple minimalist puzzle game about connecting dots and spreading happiness. This brain-stimulating puzzle game is free to play, very simple, and enjoyable for all ages. With over 1,200+ challenging & addictive levels, Find A Way is one of the best puzzle game that you will ever download.
Main Features:
Unique Concept
Sometimes the smallest ideas are the most thoughtful. Find A Way has a very simple premise, you are presented with a grid of dots & squares and you must connect all the dots. Sounds easy? But wait! dots cannot connect with squares. Dots cannot be connected twice. You must connect all the dots(Obviously). All this combines to make an addictive puzzle game that brightens your brain.
Beautiful minimal design
Enjoy flat minimalist art style graphics with soothing music that relaxes your brain. Helps in brightening your mind and developing logical thinking.
Levels with gradually increasing difficulty
Solve over 1,200+ levels divided between 640 free levels and 640 premium levels. Play the free levels before and decide for yourself if you wish to continue the journey. You can play this addictive puzzle game in various difficulty levels. Each level pack has multiple levels with an increasing challenge. Want the real challenge? Boost your brain by playing the ultimate difficult levels.
Dot Studio
Unlock Dot Studio and get access to 60+ custom dots such as cat, dog, panda, candy, pizza, cookie, Santa, football and much more. Make Find A Way a truly personalized experience.
Magic wand
Stuck on a level? Need help? Relax, use the magic wand to solve those tricky levels. Beware, magic wand are limited and you must use them as last resort. Alternatively, you can unlock Premium to get unlimited magic wands.
Night mode
Night Mode's main goal is to reduce the brightness of your screen so it does not strain your eyes while playing and you can feel relaxed. Users always come first, and night mode is and will always remain free. User satisfaction is at the topmost priority.
Smooth performance
Find A Way is a free game which is very low on system resources and it supports over a wide variety of devices. A user of low-end devices will experience smooth gameplay without any lag or hang.
Find A Way

bluejetty:00129262:ios.description:
Peeps is the best place to make new friends from all over the world! 
Wanna find new people, and meet your lifelong friend? Simply send a like, and start chatting! 
Using the Peeps app, you can build genuine friendships, join fun chatrooms, grow your audience, discover new cultures, and much more! 
EXPLORE
Swipe through a ton of new faces. Check out each person's detailed profile to decide if you think they could be your new friend! You both love Volleyball? Say hi! This guy hates dancing? No problem, swipe left! On Peeps, you'll get a chance to meet so many people you have things in common with.
CHAT ABOUT ANYTHING
Peeps allows you to join chatrooms and discuss with many online users. Whether you need advice for your relationship, or you wanna know what to make for lunch, there will always be someone there to answer you. There’s no better way to start conversations with new people and maybe meet your new bestie. Yay!
EXPRESS YOURSELF
Build a profile that makes a great first impression. Show the book you're reading and the movie you're watching, play with wild backgrounds and custom fonts, and make your profile truly yours.
GET 100s OF CHAT REQUESTS
Every day, new people ask to chat and become friends with you. Accept the ones you like and ignore the rest. You stay in control.
STAY SAFE
Peeps is a safe social app, built for genuine friendships only. Only verified profiles get access, fake accounts get banned, and you can block or report anyone in one tap.
You will also receive tons of friend requests. You can always remove friends and refuse requests, so you are in control of your information. 
With 30 free likes daily you'll be able to make new friends for free super quickly! Get more diamonds by posting your #peepsapp video on TikTok.
Connect with your friends by safely sharing your Instagram, Snapchat and TikTok accounts!
DISCLAIMER:
You need to be at least 13 years old to use this app. Additional age restrictions may apply.
Peeps is intended to be used for making friends from all over the world. We urge our users to be mindful when sharing their location and personal information. 
Additionally, Peeps is not intended for the buying, selling and promoting of adult content. Such content will be disabled and accounts will be banned. 
Please report anything that is not right.

bluejetty:00086330:ios.summary:

Get access to thousands of cars throughout the Netherlands and at more than 150 train stations.
Hit the road with one of our shared cars. Save on car costs and the trouble of owning your o
bluejetty:00086330:ios.description:
Happy to have a car nearby, without the hassle.
Get access to thousands of cars throughout the Netherlands and at more than 150 train stations.
Hit the road with one of our shared cars. Save on car costs and the trouble of owning your own car: no maintenance, parking or insurance fees to worry about. You decide when and where to go. Simply sign up, book and open the car via the app.
Renting and sharing a car via Greenwheels is this easy:.
1. Sign up for free with Greenwheels.
2. Book a car nearby and open the car with the app.
3. After your trip, return the car to your own location.
At Greenwheels you never have to search for a car or for a free parking space: our cars have their own designated location. Payment is simply processed automatically via direct debit or credit card.
Are you looking for a compact and affordable city car or an electric shared car? Or do you need a van or a more spacious station wagon? At Greenwheels you can use all our car types with one account. Simply choose the car that is most convenient for you at that moment; a large or small car for a long or short journey.
The convenience of Greenwheels
- You decide where, when and how long to go.
- Sign up for free.
- Always a (electric) car available, whenever you need one. 
- All-inclusive fees, from maintenance to car insurance.
- Pay-as-you-go, unless you pick one of our discounted rates with better hourly and kilometre rates.
- Maximum flexibility: last-minute cancelling, shorten your trip or extend it. Book far in advance or just before you want to leave.
- Affordable Day, Two-Day and Week deals for longer use.
- No more searching for a free parking spot: our cars have their own designated parking locations.
- Ideal addition to cycling or public transport.
Greenwheels facts
- Car rental or car sharing? There are more than 2,900 Greenwheels cars spread all over the Netherlands. Check out all the cars near you and at more than 150 train stations. 
- Drive less than 10,000 kilometres a year? Then car sharing with Greenwheels is a cheaper option for you.
- Each Greenwheels shared car means 14 fewer cars on the street, less CO2 emissions and more efficient use of mobility.
- Payment is easy and automatic via direct debit or credit card.
Sign up now and rent a shared car when you need one.
You can sign up in the app or on www.greenwheels.nl/en-us.

Iowa Mobile ID allows you to control what information you share during a transaction. For exa
bluejetty:00134847:ios.description:
Iowa Mobile ID is a contactless, convenient way to verify your identity from your phone while providing layers of security and privacy controls. 
Iowa Mobile ID allows you to control what information you share during a transaction. For example, when buying age-restricted items, the app can confirm you are of legal age without having to share your birth date or address.
Intuitive and easy-to-use, Mobile ID is unlocked by a selfie match to verify identity, or by using a self-selected pin or TouchID/FaceID so your personal information is always protected.
In five simple steps, you can register for your Iowa mID:
1. Download the app and set permissions
2. Verify access to your phone number 
3. Use your device camera to scan the front and back of your driver’s license or ID card
4. Follow the app’s registration steps to take a selfie 
5. Set up app security and you’re good to go! 
Please note: Iowa Mobile ID is an official state-issued ID, serving as a companion to your physical ID. As not all entities are able to verify mID, you should continue to carry your physical ID.
For more information, please visit: https://iowadot.gov/mobileid 
This app requires an iPhone 6s (iOS 14) or newer device.

bluejetty:00174850:ios.description:
Plan your Washington State Ferry trip in seconds. NW Ferry gives you real-time schedules, live vessel tracking, service alerts, terminal cameras, and drive-up space estimates — everything you need, in one fast app.
Whether you're a daily commuter or heading to the San Juan Islands for the weekend, NW Ferry keeps you one step ahead at the dock.
What you get with NW Ferry:
- Real-time schedules & fares: Check upcoming departures, fares, and seasonal schedule changes for every WSF route
- Live vessel tracking: Watch ferries cross Puget Sound in real time
- Service alerts: Know about delays, cancellations, and route changes before you leave
- Terminal cameras: See dock conditions before you drive there
- Drive-up space: View estimated vehicle space remaining for upcoming sailings
- Favorites & recents: Save your go-to terminal pairs and jump back to recent routes in one tap
- Quick route swap: Reverse your departure and arrival terminals in one tap
- Apple Watch app & widgets: Check your next sailing from your wrist — with Closest Terminal and Favorite Terminal widgets
- Home Screen & CarPlay widgets: See upcoming departures at a glance, including a Favorite Terminal widget for CarPlay
Terminals covered:
Anacortes, Bainbridge Island, Bremerton, Clinton, Coupeville, Edmonds, Fauntleroy, Friday Harbor, Kingston, Lopez Island, Mukilteo, Orcas Island, Point Defiance, Port Townsend, Seattle, Shaw Island, Sidney B.C., Southworth, Tahlequah, and Vashon Island.
NW Ferry requires an internet connection to load live schedule, fare, and vessel data.
NW Ferry is an independent app and is not affiliated with WSDOT or Washington State Ferries.

查询航班起飞时间和延误状态， 随时掌握航班实时动态，方便安排往返机场时间。

bluejetty:00150831:ios.description:
Mahjong Haven is a Mahjong puzzle game designed specifically for seniors, offering a relaxing and enjoyable experience while also boosting memory and vision skills. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned player, Mahjong Haven provides fun and challenge for everyone.
Gameplay:
- Match Mahjong tiles: Simply tap or swipe matching tiles to make them disappear, clearing the board and progressing to the next level.
- Gradual difficulty increases: Each level introduces a new challenge, gradually testing your memory and observation skills.
- Use helpful items: Utilize various items to overcome obstacles and easily clear levels.
Features:
- Senior-friendly design: With a clean, simple interface, enlarged elements for better visibility, and soothing music, the game offers a comfortable and stress-free experience.
- Classic meets innovative: Enjoy traditional Mahjong paired with fresh, fun gameplay elements.
- Brain training: Strengthen your memory and eyesight while having fun, keeping your mind sharp.
- Easy to advanced levels: A variety of levels and helpful items ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience.
Mahjong Haven is the perfect game for relaxation and mental exercise. Download now and start your Mahjong journey!

bluejetty:00041188:ios.summary: “Hasselblad Natural Noise Reduction” is the first noise reduction model that can run locally on mobile, perfectly preserving Hasselblad's natural tones and image details, and noise reduction of 100 million pixel RAW images can be completed
bluejetty:00041188:ios.description:
“Hasselblad Natural Noise Reduction” is the first noise reduction model that can run locally on mobile, perfectly preserving Hasselblad's natural tones and image details, and noise reduction of 100 million pixel RAW images can be completed in about 15 seconds, further unlocking the potential of Hasselblad's images.
When viewed on an HDR-capable iPhone or iPad, photos shot with the Hasselblad cameras truly come to life in Phocus Mobile — revealing the stunning light and shadow details and rich color gradations enabled by HNCS HDR.
Expanding the possibilities of the Hasselblad workflow, Phocus Mobile takes the image editing process to a new, portable level. Enabling the traveling or studio photographer to have a quicker, more seamless workflow.
Phocus Mobile can render natural and true colors to the greatest extent, taking full advantage of the Hasselblad Natural Color Solution (HNCS).
The following functionality is supported:
- Brand-new HNCS HDR image display, editing, and export experience
- Full quality raw editing powered by HNCS engine
- Support multi-format download (RAW/JPG/HEIF)
- Supports generating TIFF for cross-platform quality lossless editing
- Download or delete images from camera
- Camera control of capture parameters
- Supports generating full or medium size JPEG
Compatible Camera Models [USB or Wi-Fi]:
-X2D II 100C*
-CFV 100C*
-X2D 100C*
-X1D II 50C 
-CFV II 50C
*Only Chinese and English are supported within the app
This app is only compatible with iOS and iPadOS. To use it on Mac devices, please download Phocus for Mac from the official Hasselblad website.
For X1D/H system cameras, please download Phocus for X1D/H system from the App Store.
