bluejetty:00026645:ios.description:
Protect the World and Stay Safe with Citizen: Real-Time Alerts & Live Video
Citizen is the essential safety app for today's world. Live crime map, police & fire alerts, and breaking local news, all in one place. Citizen gives you real-time awareness of emergencies, crimes, and incidents happening near you before it hits the news. Watch live video from the scene, track active incidents on the map, and get instant 911 alerts for your neighborhood, workplace, or school.
What's happening near you right now: Know about crimes, vehicle pursuits, protests, robberies, wildfires, natural disasters, active shooters, hurricanes, and more the moment they're reported with instant alerts directly on your phone. Find out why police helicopters or fire trucks are in your area before anyone else does.
NEW: Incident Resolution
See how incidents end. Citizen now shows you real-time updates and resolution status on active events so you're not left wondering what happened. Follow an incident from first report to close.
Please note that Citizen may notify you of a crime in progress before the police respond. It's meant to protect you and your community, please use it responsibly.
Key Features:
* Live Incident Video: Watch breaking events unfold from multiple angles, or go live yourself to alert your community and get rewarded.
* Crime Map: See every nearby incident pinned on a live map, updated in real time and color coated to see what’s an active threat versus something that is resolved.
* Real-Time Safety Alerts: Get instant notifications for crimes and emergencies near you and your loved ones, for free.
* Incident Resolution: Track how events unfold and see when incidents are closed: full picture, start to finish.
* Alert Zones: Set areas you wish to get alerted on that you may not be near like your office, school, or family member’s home.
* Registered Offenders: View a nationwide map of registered sex offenders near your home, school, or workplace.
* Missing Pet and Persons: Help locate missing pets and loved ones with your community's help.
* Police Radio: Listen to live police scanners and radio clips directly on the incidents they correspond to. 
Now you can upgrade to Citizen Premium to get the full picture.
Citizen Premium: Get the most detailed information possible by upgrading to Citizen Premium. Access police and fire scanner audio clips, view detailed incident archives, set up multiple alert zones, and customize your notification radius for even more safety. Citizen Premium lets you stay safe and informed about what’s happening near your home, workplace, or school.
Download Citizen today to feel safer and more informed wherever you go!

Match 3 or more of the same kind to clear the board and collect the items you need to complete each level.
Whether you're popping pandas or bouncing bunnies, every level is packed with satisfying action and cute chaos.

- Animal-powered fun: Each bubble is an irresistibly cute critter!
- Puzzle-packed levels: Beat tricky stages and collect unique items.
- Relaxing yet challenging: No timers, just pure popping pleasure.
- Perfect aim, perfect pop: Use the walls, create combos, and strategize your shots.
Super easy to play:
- Tap to shoot animal bubbles into the field.
- Match 3+ of the same kind to pop them.
- Collect special items hidden behind bubbles to complete the level.
- Think ahead — the fewer shots, the higher your score!

bluejetty:00040411:ios.description:
Track work time, keep accurate timesheets, and prepare billable records without a subscription. WorkingHours is a personal time tracker for freelancers, hourly workers, employees, contractors, consultants, and anyone who wants a clear record of their workday.
Start the timer when work begins, pause and resume for breaks, then stop when you are done. Breaks can be subtracted automatically. If you forget to track something, add or edit entries manually and correct the details later. Sessions that cross midnight can be split automatically.
Keep your hours organized and useful.
• Assign time to tasks or projects
• Add tags, notes, and descriptions
• Automatically apply tags to projects or new entries
• Track overtime, hourly rates, earnings, and fixed fees
• Adjust time or earnings with flexible tag rules
• Search and filter entries quickly
Understand where your time goes with charts and visual reports. Switch between duration and revenue to review work patterns, check billable hours, or prepare records for clients and managers.
Export timesheet data in the format you need.
• Export to Excel or CSV
• Choose which columns to include
• Group records by day, week, month, task, or tag
• Create PDF invoices from tracked data with SubTotal
Capture time with less friction using widgets, notifications, NFC tags, and Apple Watch timer controls. Geofencing can detect workplace arrivals and departures, while Pomodoro focus sessions help structure concentrated work. You can also use Apple Shortcuts and view or import appointments from your calendar or Outlook.
Optional sync keeps your work available across supported phone, tablet, laptop, and desktop versions. It uses your own iCloud, OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, or WebDAV storage, so no WorkingHours account or registration is required.
WorkingHours is free to use, and Pro features can be tested with a 7-day trial. Pro is a one-time purchase linked to your Apple ID that unlocks Pro for iOS/iPadOS; a separate purchase may be required on other platforms.

bluejetty:00062860:ios.description:
WordDive: Learn a new language
Learn a new language efficiently! You can choose from English, Spanish, Swedish, Finnish and more.
Learn English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Russian, Swedish, Finnish and Estonian. 
Break the language barrier with WordDive!
You can try WordDive for 7 days completely free! After the free trial period, the monthly subscription costs 10.99€ / month.
WordDive is a Finnish language learning app that helps you effectively gain real-life language skills. The learning process is based on WordDive's patented multisensory and individually paced learning method. All learning material is created by Finnish language teachers and proofread and recorded by native speakers. 
• Choose a language: English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Russian, Swedish, Finnish or Estonian.
• Learn the most common vocabulary and essential grammar permanently.
• The material is created by Finnish language teachers.
• The language courses are based on the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).
• You can practice on several different devices: the results are saved automatically.
Start today and break the language barrier!
How does WordDive work?
With WordDive, you’ll learn by reading, writing, listening and speaking. The learning algorithm optimises the pace of the exercises individually so that the study items are transferred from working memory to long-term memory. This is what we call permanent learning.
Permanent learning means that you’ll learn vocabulary and the most important grammar topics by heart. It requires you to write what you’re learning correctly, without listening, on at least two separate days. Once you’ve learned the basics of the language permanently, your confidence in using it increases and your language skills start improving rapidly. 
The learning material is divided into skill levels and courses of approximately 40–60 study items. Following the clear and ready-made learning path is easy. You don’t have to worry about planning your studies – you can just enjoy learning. 
By real life language skills, we mean understanding the language you’re studying and being able to have spontaneous conversations with native speakers. With WordDive, you’ll reach a sufficient level of proficiency and learn things you need on the road, at work and in other practical situations!
Who is WordDive for?
WordDive is great for motivated adults who have full calendars and can’t always get to a specific classroom at a specific time. Everyone can choose a starting level that suits them and practice anywhere. 
Whether you want to learn the basics of Spanish for your holiday or hone your English skills for work, WordDive is the right choice. 
Why do I need to pay for WordDive?
• All learning material is created by Finnish language teachers and proofread and recorded by native speakers.
• No ads will distract you from learning.
• Our maintenance and customer service are there for you every day of the year.
Here's how to reach us:
For help using WordDive, please contact info@worddive.com.
More information about the service can be found on our website: www.worddive.com/en/
Follow WordDive on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WordDive 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/worddive
WordDive uses the standard Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00122316:ios.description:
▶What is the global K-pop fandom platform "Whosfan"?
Whosfan reflects the 'activities' of the K-POP fans into the artists' 'value' based on 'Hanteo Chart.'
Whosfan's goal is to collect the voices of the global fans in the changing fandom world and to create the culture where both the artists and the fans are satisfied.
[ "Hanteo Chart," the standard of the fandom's power ]
- Check the Initial Chodong (first week of release) sales in real-time!
- Easily check Hanteo Chart's Real-time/Daily/Weekly sales chart!
[ "Hanteo News," the fastest way to meet K-POP news ] 
- You can find the chart news of K-POP idols faster than anywhere else.
- Read news articles on Whosfan and raise the Star Chart rankings of the artist!
[ "Album Authentication," a shortcut to become a true fan ]
- Earn points and count towards chart when authenticating with the HATS card that comes with the K-POP album purchase
- Help protect the copyrights of your favorite artist!
[ "COMMUNITY & EVENT" for both the artists and the fans ] 
- Stability and security guaranteed with the Blockchain voting technology!
- A number of events that both the artists and the fans can be satisfied are also available! Participate now!
[ "CONTENTS," where fans activities count ]
- The fans can earn credit through a number of ways and contribute to the Star Chart.
- Actively communicate and participate to raise your favorite artist to the '1st place!'
[Information on Purchase]
You can purchase Whosfan Gold Coin on the app.
Price: The pricing can differ by the product, and you can check it from the purchase page (Store).
[Information on Required Access]
- Device ID (Required) : It is used for device differentiation and identification, checking login information, account and profile data checking for push notification.
- In-app Purchase (Optional): It is used for product purchase on the Whosfan app.
- Camera (Optional): It is used when authenticating albums, changing the profile picture or adding an image on the board or comments.
- Storage space (Optional): It is used for using the file stored in the device or saving the photo.
- Location (Optional): It is used when authenticating the album.

Checking schedules
Telephone and web messages
e-Prescribing
Viewing patient encounters
Examining lab results
Charge capture at the point of service

The product offers access to your patients’ information with a tap of the screen enabling you to provide your patients the best care possible and in a timely manner.

WHAT’S INSIDE
The Power Apps app is the fro
bluejetty:00061561:ios.description:
Get Power Apps to conveniently access your work or school apps no matter where you are: at home, on the road, in the field, off-campus, at the airport, or at the beach – anywhere life takes you.
WHAT’S INSIDE
The Power Apps app is the front door to the apps at your work or school. Which apps can you use? It depends on what’s been created for you. Here are some examples you might see, or ones you can make yourself using the Power Apps website:
• Campus app: Map your campus with icons for landmarks and facility details.
• Event registration app: Record attendees as they arrive using barcodes or QR codes.
• Expenses app: Let employees submit their expenses and upload photos of receipts.
• Health clinic app: Let patients check in to appointments with just a few taps.
• NFC reader app: Scan NFC tags on ID cards, equipment, packages, etc.
• Performance app: Visualize data and get insights with interactive dashboards.
• Sales app: See opportunities and leads, review comments, and approve for your P&L.
• Space planning app: Take 3D measurements and manipulate objects in mixed reality.
• Timesheet app: Collect, consolidate, and analyze shift data from employees.
This is just a handful of examples; the possibilities are endless. Build and share low-code apps for your work or school at the Power Apps website.
TIPS
• Swipe right to make an app a favorite, swipe left to add a shortcut to the home screen.
• As an admin, mark an app as Featured, so that it stays pinned to the top of the apps list.
• Some apps can work offline, and Power Apps will sync your data when you reconnect.
Accessibility: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2121429

bluejetty:00186353:ios.description:
Explore the creative side of coding with hands-on music-making! 
In Osmo’s Coding Jam, kids arrange physical coding blocks into patterns and sequences to compose original tunes. The game comes with over 300 musical sounds to produce the perfect song.
Kids can safely record and share their music with friends, family and the Jam community.
“a STEAM-based experience that promotes creative problem-solving.”
- VentureBeat
“Osmo Coding Jam teaches children coding with music”
- Forbes
About Osmo Coding Jam:
1. CREATE: Kids 5-12 use coding blocks to create explosive beats.
2. LEARN: Kids get to know coding’s creative side while developing an ear for rhythm, melody, and harmony.
3. SHARE: Once they’ve composed a jam, kids can safely share it with friends, family and the jam community.
Learn with our hands-on coding language:
 Research shows that tangible blocks are a game changer when it comes to helping kids learn. Each of our blocks is a programming command kids can use to create unique jams. As they explore playing with coding blocks, the volume of fun — and learning — gets turned up!
* Requires the Osmo Base and Coding Blocks. Each sold separately or as part of Osmo Coding Starter Kit or Osmo Coding Family Bundle.
* Compatible with most iPads. Please see our device compatibility list here: https://support.playosmo.com/hc/articles/115010156067
About Osmo
Osmo is using the screen to create a new healthy, hands-on learning experience that promotes creativity, problem-solving and social interaction. We do this with our reflective artificial intelligent technology.

When you want more, two studios are bui
bluejetty:00017231:ios.description:
Superimpose X is a serious photo editor, and the editor is yours with the app — layers,
masks, blend modes, brushes, effects, shadows, text and precision tools, with no
subscription to use any of it.
When you want more, two studios are built right in and unlock with a subscription: an AI
Editor that generates and transforms images, and a true multi-track Video Editor.
THE PHOTO EDITOR 
Build complex edits by hand with the control of a desktop app and none of the complexity.
Cut out people and objects, combine images, paint masks, adjust colour, add depth and
shadow, then refine every detail.
• Layer-based editing with up to 24 layers
• Magic Wand, Magic Lasso, brush and shape masks
• 18 blend modes and 16 adjustment layers
• Non-destructive layer blur and adjustments
• 63 photo effects, plus clarity, colour, tone and detail controls
• Text and curved text
• Motion, Zoom, Spin, Lens and Selective Blur, and gradients
• Warp, perspective transform and distortion
• Paint, smudge, clone stamp and effect brushes
• Shadow and Light Wrap tools
• Camera fill with real-time masks and blend modes
• Masking Library for reusable cutouts and stickers
• Session Library that saves your projects automatically
• PSD export with layers
• Over a million royalty-free stock photos
AI EDITOR 
Start from a photo, a sketch or a sentence and let AI do the heavy lifting, then take the
result back into the layer editor to finish it properly.
• Image generation from text
• AI editing and inpainting
• Background creation and replacement
• Outpainting and image expansion
• Enhance, relight and repair
• Sketch to image
• Headshot generation
• Face swap
• Image to image transformation
• Image to video
• AI people masking
VIDEO EDITOR
A real multi-track editor, not a template filler.
• Edit video, images, audio and text on multiple tracks
• Stack effects and animations for results that are yours
• Masks for precise work, including green screen
• Track objects through a shot and ramp clip speed
• Animate text with elegant presets
• Split, trim, rotate and freeze clips
• Colour effects, blurs and distortions
• Audio EQ, filters and transitions
• Royalty-free photos, videos, music and GIFs
• Export in a range of formats, including GIF
ONE APP, ONE PROJECT
The three studios share the same project. Composite a frame in the photo editor and drop
it on the timeline. Generate a background with AI and mask it by hand. Pull a still out of
a video and edit it as layers. Nothing is exported and re-imported just to move between
them.
Terms of use: https://www.superimposeapp.com/superimposex_terms_of_use.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.superimposeapp.com/privacy2.html

bluejetty:00119247:ios.description:
InternetowyKantor.pl – Your online currency exchange!
Make currency exchange easier with our app. InternetowyKantor.pl is more than just an exchange office – it is a complete currency platform on your phone. Gain instant access to live exchange rates, exchange funds safely 24/7 at a guaranteed rate, and send international transfers. Download the free app, which offers the full functionality of the InternetowyKantor.pl website wherever you are. Convenience and full control over your finances – all within arm's reach!
CURRENCY EXCHANGE ON YOUR TERMS
Our currency exchange app ensures convenience and full control over your transactions:
- Convenient 24/7 exchange – we offer round-the-clock currency exchange. Our platform never sleeps!
- Intuitive interface – it takes just a few clicks to exchange currency.
- Up to 35 currencies to choose from – access the most popular currencies, including EUR, USD, CHF, GBP, and many others.
ATTRACTIVE RATES AND TRANSPARENT RULES
Competitive rates updated every 10 seconds – you won't miss any opportunity.
- Savings – benefit from every transaction thanks to favorable exchange rates.
- Weekend exchange – trade on the same terms during weekends as well, thanks to fixed spreads.
- Transparent calculator – you know exactly how much you will pay and how much you will receive.
AN APP TAILORED TO YOU
Customize the app to your needs and make your daily finances easier:
- Set the order of your favorite currency pairs (e.g., EURPLN) for quick access.
- Add a widget to your iPhone's home screen and track selected exchange rates without opening the app.
- Receive notifications about the rates you care about via SMS, email, or PUSH.
SAFE AND CHEAP INTERNATIONAL TRANSFERS
Do you work abroad and earn in a different currency? Easily send your hard-earned money back to Poland:
- Make fast transfers to your own foreign account or to other people, companies, and institutions – to up to 83 countries.
- In a hurry? Choose instant transfers in EUR – SEPA Instant.
- Enjoy transfers in Euros, Dollars, Pounds, Francs, and 31 other currencies.
FINANCIAL TOOLS FOR DEMANDING USERS
Advanced tools for anyone who wants to manage their finances in a professional way:
- Clear currency charts for 6 different timeframes.
- Rate history analysis to help you make informed decisions.
- Loan Planner – automate your foreign currency loan installment payments and set up a standing order to buy and transfer currency.
- Currency Alerts – set up notifications, and we will send you a free SMS, email, or PUSH notification when a currency reaches your desired rate.
- Currency Wallet – your digital piggy bank. Store, exchange, and withdraw funds in various currencies.
SECURITY AND CONTROL AT THE HIGHEST LEVEL
Your finances are completely safe with us. We guarantee the highest standards:
- Log in quickly and securely using a PIN.
- Use biometrics – sign in with Face ID or Touch ID.
- Authorize account changes and transactions via secure mobile authorization.
- Check the current status of your transactions in real-time.
- Enjoy a convenient overview of your entire account transaction history.
Register in just a few minutes – it’s that simple! Start using all the features of InternetowyKantor.pl and save on currency exchange.

• It
bluejetty:00136264:ios.description:
Wotja is powerful & 'AI-free' system for Live Generative Music & MIDI. Use it to easily create & play on-device generated ambient music, soundscapes, textured drones, text-to-music melodies etc. Social share your creations + much more…
• It's FREE, ad-free, updates are FREE & it can be used for FREE forever in Lite mode (Go Pro to do the max!)
• It's actively developed & delivers awesome results
• It's well loved & users say e.g. "A Masterpiece!" (wotja.com/reviews)
• It's the *continued evolution* of 1990-02 SSEYO Koan (wotja.com/evo) which generated what became known as 'Generative Music'
WOTJA BUNDLE FOR APPLE INCLUDES*
• Wotja App (iOS, macOS)
• Wotja AUv3 Plug-in (iOS, macOS)
• Wotja Player App (tvOS [Flow Player], watchOS [Play control])
* iOS means for both iOS & iPadOS
=+=
FULL DETAILS ON WOTJA (it's very deep!)
• wotja.com/app
GENERATIVE MUSIC CREATOR, LAB & DAW
• Powerful engines: Generative Music ['WME'], Audio ['WAE'], Text ['WTE'] & Script ['WSE']
• 100s of editable generative music templates & SFX presets + many SoundFonts & Samples
• 48 interdependent Cells in 12 tracks for live mixing/sequencing
• AUv3 Plug-in (macOS, iOS)
• App Plug-in hosting: macOS [AUv3/AUv2], iOS [AUv3]
• Also supports:
 - Recording to WAV & MIDI [App, not Plug-in]
 - Core MIDI Out/In, Virtual MIDI Out/In, iCloud [iOS, macOS]
 - AirPlay [iOS, macOS]
 - CarPlay [iOS]
 - Ableton Link [iOS]
 - Text to Speech (TTS) [iOS, macOS, tvOS]
GENERATIVE MUSIC PLAYER
• Content-aware Player for A) playing/creating/editing Albums/Playlists and B) playing Schemas ('Flows') and shared Wotja URLs/URIs
• Supports API commands for use by 3rd Party Apps & Games
=+=
KEY *NEW FEATURES* IN WOTJA 26 ['W26']
• Generate minified Wotja Mixes, Schemas, Albums for sharing as Wotja URLs/URIs
• 26 IM Soft Piano SoundFont
• WAE S&G Unit: Load Sample from SoundFont; Sample Offset; Sample Duration 
• WME Chording: Quantise to; Pitch Offset Range
• Patterns: Don't Pad BRF to End; Meter Button (Editor)
• Force Use of Mix Rules/Simplify All Rules
• Updated Schemas, Piano Templates +
• More: wotja.com/new
W26 FEATURE SET ['26 FS']
• wotja.com/fs
=+=
W26: INCLUDED MODES OF OPERATION
• Lite [Default]: Very capable but MIDI Ch1 Out/In only; no save/export; various auto-timeouts & other limitations.
• Pro: *All* Lite mode Limitations unlocked; Recordings licensed for Commercial Use (see EULA).
• Play 26: Lite mode Auto-timeouts permanently unlocked in *Player & Playlist Screens only* and for the *26 Feature Set only*.
• Pro 26: As Pro above, but where Lite mode Limitations are permanently unlocked for the *26 Feature Set only*.
W26: IN-APP PURCHASE ['IAP'] OPTIONS
• Subscription ['SUB'] (Pro)
 - Whilst active unlocks Pro mode in all Wotja 23+ Apps & Plug-ins installed under your App Store User ID.
 - Period is 1 month, auto-renewing; easy to cancel.
 - Prices shown are for US region & may change from time to time.
 - Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
 - Automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
 - Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
 - May be managed by the user & auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Thirty Day Unlock ['TDU'] (Pro)
 - For thirty days from date of purchase unlocks Pro mode in the Wotja App & Plug-in but *only* on the device on which it is purchased AND provided the App is not uninstalled.
• One Time Buy ['XX OTB'] (Pro 26/Pro 26 Mobile/Play 26)
 - As relevant, permanently unlocks Pro 26/Play 26 mode in every Wotja 26+ App & Plug-in installed under your App Store User ID.
 - Does *not* unlock the relevant mode for New Features in Wotja 27 or later & whilst use of any such New Feature is detected by Wotja it will operate in Lite mode.
=+=
FEEDBACK/ISSUES?
• wotja.com/contact

bluejetty:00175274:ios.description:
Download the most comprehensive NOAA Marine Weather app for iOS.
MAIN FEATURES INCLUDE:
 + Real-time Marine Weather Buoy Data
 + 5-day NWS Marine Weather Forecast
 + 6-hour Historical Wave Trend Reports
 + 7-day Hourly WaveWatch III Model
 + 7-day Hourly Harmonic Tide Forecast
 + NOAA Marine Weather Map Overlays
 + Offshore Marine Zone Forecast
 + Detailed NWS Forecast Discussion
 + Apple Watch App
REAL-TIME DATA
 - Primary & Secondary Swell Height
 - Swell Period & Direction
 - Spectral Wave Energy Density
 - Significant Wave Height
 - Wind Speed, Gust & Direction
 - Air Temperature
 - Water Temperature
 - Pressure
 - Current NWS Alerts
6-HOUR HISTORY DATA
 - Primary & Secondary Wave Height
 - Swell Period & Direction
 - Wave Energy, Period, Direction
7-DAY NOAA WaveWatch III MODEL
 - Hourly Swell Predictions (1-6 swells)
 - Accurate Wave Height, Period & Direction
7-DAY HOURLY HARMONIC TIDE FORECAST
 - Interactive Tide Graphs
 - Hourly Tide Predictions 
 - Current Tide
5-DAY NWS MARINE FORECAST
 - Text Summary Forecast
 - Marine Weather, Sky, Wind, Waves
 - Includes Offshore Marine Zones
 - Tap any point on the map!
NOAA CHARTS (MAP OVERLAYS)
 - Radar Base Reflectivity
 - ENC Nautical Charts
 - NASA GOES Band 13
APPLE WATCH APP
 - View the latest buoy data with a simple glance
 - Includes Watch Complications
* Available for iPad & iPhone
-- PRO SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES --
 + Hourly Wave, Wind & Weather Forecast
 + NWS Severe Weather Push Notifications
 + NCEP Weather Forecast Models
 + Access 20,000 Weather Stations
 + High Resolution Satellite Imagery
 + NASA SST & Chlorophyll Map Overlays
HOURLY WEATHER FORECAST
 - Signifiant Wave Height
 - Wind Waves
 - Swell (Primary / Secondary Swell if Available)
 - Wind Speed, Gust, Direction
 - Air Temperature
 - Probability of Precipitation
 - Cloud Cover
 - Relative Humidity
SEVERE WEATHER PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
 - Customize NWS Alerts by Marine Zone 
 - Detailed Alert Information
16-DAY WEATHER FORECAST MODELS
 - Global Forecast System (GFS)
 - Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS)
 - North American Ensemble (NAEFS)
WEATHER SIMULATION FORECAST MODELS
 - WaveWatch III (WW3)
 - Nearshore Wave Prediction System (NWPS)
 - Great Lakes Coastal Forecast System (GLCFS)
 - Hi-Res Rapid Refresh (HRRR)
 - Hi-Res Ensemble Forecast (HREF)
 - North American Mesoscale (NAM) 
 - Hi-Res North American Mesoscale
 (NAM-HIRES)
 - High Resolution Window 
 (HRW-FV3, HRW-ARW, HRW-ARW2)
ACCESS OVER 20,000+ WEATHER STATIONS
 - Wind Speed, Direction, Gust
 - Dew Point, Humidity, Temperature, Pressure
 - Wind History Graphs
HIGH RESOLUTION SATELLITE IMAGERY
Fifteen (15) Satellite Imagery Filters
 - Visible (Band 2)
 - Near IR (Bands 4 & 5)
 - Infrared (Bands 7, 8, 9, 10, 13, 14 & 16)
 - Nighttime Microphysics
 - Day Cloud Phase
 - True Color
 - Air Mass
 - Sandwich
NASA MAP OVERLAYS
 - Sea Surface Temperature
 - Chlorophyll 
TERMS & CONDITIONS
https://lwbrandsllc.com/marine-weather-forecast-pro-terms-conditions/
--
IMPORTANT!
Please remember that this app can only show data the buoy collects. Not all buoys collect weather data. Not all buoys collect wave data. This app will display all data collected by a buoy.
This app is primarily designed to focus on buoys that display the most complete package of marine weather data (waves, weather, forecast, tide etc).
If you notice a missing a buoy, please contact me first rather than leaving a poor review. If you are correct, the buoy can be easily be added to the cloud database.
Lastly, please feel free to contact me with questions, feedback, feature requests and bug reports at support@lwbrandsllc.com
Enjoy.

bluejetty:00155947:ios.description:
يُوفّر المشروع برامج لحفظ وتعلم القرآن الكريم تلائم جميع الفئات العمرية، ومختلف المستويات، بما فيها المبتدئين في تعلم كلام الله تعالى، كما يقدم برنامجَا مخصّصا للبراعم واليافعين.
يُتيح تطبيق المراقي في نسخته الأولى مجموعة من الخاصيات الإبداعية التي تساعد طالب القرآن على متابعة حفظه والدخول إلى الحلقات الدراسية بطريقة سلسة وممتعة، تضمن تحفيز الطالب واستمرار صلته بكتاب الله تعالى.
الخاصيات التي يوفرها التطبيق:
• التسجيل في حلقات تعلم وتحفيظ القرآن الكريم عن بعد
• الدخول إلى غرفة الاستظهار مباشرة من التطبيق
• متابعة مسيرة الحفظ والاطلاع على الأحزاب المحفوظة
• الاطلاع على تقييمات المؤطر وتوجيهاته
• التنافس بين الطلبة في تحصيل المراتب الأولى في الحلقات
• الحصول على شواهد الحفظ وشارات التميّز
• التواصل المباشر بين طلبة الحلقات والمؤطرين
• أداء رسوم الدراسة بطريقة مباشرة
• إرسال تسجيل التلاوة والتوصل بالتقييم والملاحظات
• الحضور للدورات العلمية والمحاضرات التي تعتني بالقرآن الكريم
قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «خَيرُكُم من تعلَّمَ القرآنَ وعلَّمَهُ».

bluejetty:00142623:ios.description:
Whether it’s a birthday, wedding, or anything else life sends your way, Zoomin is right there with you. By printing your favourite photos onto anything and everything, we make customisation as easy as clicking a button. Perfect for when you’re looking to change your decor, treat a friend, or just put a smile on your face. 
How Zoomin Works
We’re the experts at creating custom print products with the click of a button. Our easy-to-use app allows you to take a photo, print it on a product, and have it sent direct to your door anywhere in India. It could be a calendar for the kitchen, a new mug for work, and a photobook for your anniversary all at the same time if you want to. The choice is yours! 
Capture Every Moment 
We love that you’ve come to us, and we can’t wait to help you capture every moment. From the little one’s first steps right the way through to the day they graduate, you can remember everything in your own special way. All you need to do now is pick your first product. 
A Huge Range to Choose From 
- Photobooks: 6x6, 8x8, 8x10, 10x8, and Layflat, Hardcover and Softcover Photobooks. Upgrade to Premium Paper, Hardcover, or Hardcover Premium, choose 20 or 32-pages, and browse our exciting new themes 
- Photo Prints: Choose from matte, glossy, or pearl finishes, and 10 unique sizes from 4x6" to 12x24"
- Collage Posters: Available in 3 giant sizes all the way up to 20x30
- Calendars: Choose from 3 different options for your new wall or desktop calendar
- Mugs: White, Black, Colour Inside, and exclusive Magic Mugs
- Magnets: Landscape, portrait, and a huge range of new and exclusive themes to choose from.
- Square and Polaroid Prints: Perfect for your Instagram shots
- Home Decor: Metal Prints, Canvas Prints, Large Prints, and even Framed Prints to breathe new life into your interiors in seconds 
- Custom Bag Tag: Ensure you luggage never gets lost again 
- Exclusive range of display products, and an easy-to-use dedicated ordering process
Amazing Features 
- Instant printing from your smartphone, Facebook, and Instagram account
- Premium professional paper, archival canvases, and a whole host of exclusive options
- Express overnight delivery every step of the way 
- Satisfaction guaranteed: We will reprint or refund your order if you’re not 100% happy 
- Online secure payments when using Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking and all wallet options — just what you need for peace of mind
- Cash on Delivery available to make life easy
- Exclusive Referral and Rewards program means it pays to use Zoomin
- Seamless syncing across all platforms and devices 
- Easy reordering ensures you get more of the prints you love 
Our Promise to You 
We’re proud to be India’s #1, so if there’s ever anything we can do to improve your Zoomin experience all you have to do is pop us a message.

bluejetty:00028372:ios.description:
No Cover Charge is your backstage pass to learning guitar. Step past the velvet rope and into a full training system built by working session musicians — from your very first chord to the licks you've been chasing for years.
No intro fees. No gatekeeping. Just plug in and play.
Choose Your Path
Structured courses that take you from absolute beginner to advanced technique. Blues, metal, theory, rhythm, lead — pick a lane or tour them all.
The Lesson Library
Hundreds of standalone lessons you can search, filter, and favorite. Learn what you want, when you want.
Backing Tracks
Jam-ready tracks across every style and tempo. Loop them, slow them down, and play along until it clicks.
The Backstage
A community of players sharing wins, questions, and gear talk. Post a clip, ask a question, trade tabs — no trolls at the door.
Track Your Progress
Daily streaks, practice stats, and badges that celebrate real milestones — First Riff, Lesson Marathoner, Shred God, and more. Pick up exactly where you left off, on any device.
Built for Real Practice
Adjustable playback speed for dialing in tough passages
Download-friendly video streaming
Clean, distraction-free player
Syncs across iPhone, iPad, and web
Whether you're learning your first open chord or finally nailing sweep picking, No Cover Charge puts a world-class guitar education in your pocket.
The stage is open. Step up.

bluejetty:00128584:ios.description:
Notion Calendar lets you schedule meetings and control your time like never before. It deeply integrates with Google Calendar accounts so that all your events are synced.
Along with speed, beauty, and light/dark modes, Notion Calendar includes powerful features:
- CONNECTED TO NOTION — add Notion docs, projects, and timelines.

bluejetty:00159520:ios.description:
Kinder World is a game about finding peace in everyday life. It's a cozy wellbeing game with a relaxing atmosphere, designed for quick stress release in just two minutes a session, with gentle evidence-based activities as you raise unique houseplants. 
Reasons to love Kinder World
With a warm and welcoming community, Kinder World is a comforting journey that helps you build a daily wellbeing habit. This experience meets you where you are in the moment, judgment-free.
Discover the power of noticing and naming your emotions, even on hard days. The gentle gameplay and friendly cast of characters will help you create and decorate a personal space for self-reflection and resilience.
Enjoy short daily activities inspired by arts & crafts practices, gradually unlocking stories about Kinder World and our charming characters. 
We understand that self-care and forming habits can be challenging, especially for neurodivergent, disabled, and chronically ill individuals. That's why Kinder World is founded on a judgment-free ethos, supporting emotional wellness and mental health as non-linear, personal journeys without toxic positivity.
Kinder World Features
Emotional wellbeing exercises in bite-sized sessions
- Acknowledge and accept emotions, manage stress & anxiety.
- Practice self-reflection, build empathy and tailor your journey.
- Emotional Naming: Fill a sand jar with daily moods & emotions, fostering self-empathy.
- Daily Gratitude: Answer gratitude prompts to savor your experiences.
- Pause & Breathe: Find inner calm using tactical breathing.
Grow unique houseplants
- Encourage plant growth with self-care exercises.
- Unlock new plants and unique creations as you develop healthy habits.
- Plants never die, ensuring a stress-free environment.
- Learn to understand your emotions and flourish alongside your virtual garden.
Creative self-expression:
- Create a personalized sand jar with arts & crafts-inspired activities.
- Customize your digital home inspired by cozy games like Animal Crossing.
- Design comfy spaces like a tranquil library, witch's atelier, or inspirational crafts room.
Relaxing journeys with comforting creatures:
- Meet friendly NPCs such as Samy the Dog, Luna the Fox, Quilliam the Hedgehog, and Professor Fern.
- These charming companions will support you with uplifting messages and letters.
A welcoming, kind community:
- Receive heartfelt messages from real community members.
- Enjoy artist-designed plant pot gifts from fellow players.
Research-based wellbeing activities:
- We collaborate with Wellbeing Researchers like Dr. Hannah Gunderman, ensuring our approach is informed by research.
- Experience mindfulness and wellbeing research translated into effective activities for your wellbeing journey.
Join the Kinder World cultivators:
- Connect with us on TikTok, Instagram, Twitter, and Discord!
- Visit playkinderworld.com to learn more.
If this sounds like you, download Kinder World now!
- Anyone looking for stress release and relaxation
- Wanting a self-care or wellbeing daily habit
- Cozy game fans that wish for a quality mobile experience
- Students or workers that need some comfort and soothing
- Anyone looking for cute, Studio Ghibli style atmosphere
- Parents that want to teach their children about emotions
- Lofi music or ASMR lovers that want to unwind
- Fans of lovely mascot animals like Rilakkuma or Gudetama
- If you love pocket camp games like Animal Crossing

bluejetty:00017981:ios.summary: Store coins and tokens in one secure multicurrency crypto wallet that you can trust. Easily receive, send Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Cardano, Ethereum, Bitcoin Cash, BSV, Classic, Litecoin, Tron, XRP, Binance Coin, Polkadot, BEP2, TRC10, TRC20, ERC
bluejetty:00017981:ios.description:
Store coins and tokens in one secure multicurrency crypto wallet that you can trust. Easily receive, send Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Cardano, Ethereum, Bitcoin Cash, BSV, Classic, Litecoin, Tron, XRP, Binance Coin, Polkadot, BEP2, TRC10, TRC20, ERC20, tokens, and many other altcoins – all in one lightweight, user-friendly app with adjustable fees. 
Guarda’s versatile mobile cryptocurrency wallet offers a range of financial features designed to cater to both beginners and seasoned cryptocurrency users. Available on Web and Desktop that can be effortlessly synchronized between each other and access all your funds regardless of the app or device you are using for cryptocurrency management.
NON-CUSTODIAL SECURITY
Get full control over your crypto wallet's private keys. Guarda Wallet likes to uphold the privacy, that is why it encrypts all users' data and securely stores it on the device itself – no one can gain access to user funds except the owner of the private keys. Enable Touch ID or Face ID to access the crypto storage without having to type the password every time.
SUPPORTED COINS AND TOKENS
Native support for more than 60 blockchains:
Bitcoin (BTC) | Ethereum (ETH) | Bitcoin Cash (BCH) | Binance Smart Chain (BSC) | Cardano (ADA) | Bitcoin SV (BSV) | Bitcoin Gold (BTG) | Monero (XMR) | Ethereum Classic (ETC) | Solana (SOL) | Expanse (EXP) | TRON (TRX) | Callisto (CLO) | Cardano (ADA) | Cosmos (ATOM) | Creamcoin (CRM) | DASH | Decred (DCR) | DigiByte (DGB) | Dogecoin (DOGE) | Groestlcoin (GRS) | Ontology (ONT) | Horizen (ZEN) | Komodo (KMD) | Aptos (APT) | Ontology (ONT) | Ubiq (UBQ) | Lisk (LSK) | Litecoin (LTC) | NEM (XEM) | NEAR Protocol (NEAR) | QTUM | Ravencoin (RVN) | Reddcoin (RDD) | XRP (XRP) | Stellar (XLM) | Tezos (XTZ) | Verge (XVG) | Vechain (VET) | Vertcoin (VTC) | WAVES | Hedera (HBAR) | Zcash (ZEC) | Ycash (YEC) | Polkadot (DOT) | Polygon (MATIC) | XDC Network (XDC) | Aryacoin (AYA) | eCash (XEC) | Algorand (ALGO) | Optimism (ETHOP) | Arbitrum One (ETHARB) | Zilliqa (ZIL) | Bitcoin Gold (BTG) | Nano (XNO) | Harmony (ONE) | Kusama (KSM) | Komodo (KMD) | Firo (FIRO) | FIO Protocol (FIO)
Supported staking of Komodo, ATOM, TRON, XTZ, NEO gas claim.
OVER 10K TOKENS
All Ethereum-based tokens, TRON-based tokens (TRC10, TRC20), Waves tokens, and more supported.
List of a few popular tokens available on Guarda:
MakerDAO (MKR), OMGToken (OMG), 0x Protocol (ZRX), Shiba Inu (SHIB), Pepe (PEPE), Basic Attention Token (BAT), Chainlink (LINK), Holo (HOT), Everipedia (IQ), Chiliz (CHZ), Augur (REP), Render (RNDR)
SUPPORTED STABLECOINS
Tether USDT (ERC20, TRC10), True USD TUSD, Paxos Standard Token, USD Coin USDC, DAI, Gemini Dollar GUSD, Binance BUSD, Stasis EURS and others supported.
Key Features
- Multi-Currency Support.
- Robust security with a non-custodial and no-KYC approach.
- Direct staking to earn crypto rewards.
- Provides secure backup options.
- Available on mobile, desktop, web.
MOST EFFICIENT TECHNICAL SUPPORT
Our customer support team is here 24/7 to answer all your questions. We value the time of our users – it never takes longer than 5 minutes to answer your request.
Сhat with our support online!
Email: support@guarda.com
Also, you can use our extensive FAQ section or Academy to learn more about wallet security, blockchain functionality, and specs.
Join our community on Telegram @Guarda_community and follow the news on Twitter @GuardaWallet

Elena and Nathan had barely returned from their exhilarating adventure in the City of Amazons when they decided to embark on another journey. This time, they were on a mission to find Atlantis, the lost city that had intrigued and fascinated Nathan for as long as he could remember.

Build better habits without the clutter. Streakly is the minimalist habit tracker designed for visual people who want to focus on one thing: Consistency.
Inspired by the "Seinfeld Strategy" and contribution graphs, Streakly visualizes your progress as a beautiful heatmap. See your entire year of discipline at a glance, fill your grid, and keep the momentum going.
WHY STREAKLY? Most habit trackers are too complex. They have too many charts, notifications, and features you don't use. Streakly brings it back to basics. It is a quiet place to mark your progress and feel good about your day.
# VISUAL MOMENTUM
- The Heatmap
See your habits as a stunning "Year in Pixels" grid. The more consistent you are, the brighter your streak shines.
- Weekly & Monthly Views
Zoom in to focus on this week, or zoom out to see your yearly trend.
- Beautiful Aesthetics
Clean lines, satisfying haptics, and a design that looks great in Light or Dark mode.
# PRIVATE & SECURE
- iCloud Sync (CloudKit)
Your data syncs seamlessly across your iPhone and iPad using your own private iCloud account.
- Privacy First
We don't see your data. It stays on your device and your Apple ID.
- No Accounts:
No sign-up required. Just download and start tracking.
# POWERFUL SIMPLICITY
- Interactive Widgets: Check off habits directly from your Home Screen.
- Flexible Schedules: Track daily habits or set specific days (e.g., "Gym on Mon/Wed/Fri").
- Unlimited History: Look back at years of progress.
# PAY ONCE, TRACK FOREVER We hate subscriptions for simple tools too.
- No Monthly Fees.
- No Ads.
- One Lifetime Purchase.
Get Streakly today and start filling your grid.

bluejetty:00175614:ios.description:
Combine, knock, and win live online at the Gin Rummy Palace!
This is a fast-paced two-player card game requiring great combination skills and timing. Play it online for free in one of the largest online card game communities! Seasoned Gin Rummy Masters and newbies alike will always find opponents at their level on our platform.
LIVE & EASY
- Try Gin Rummy without registration.
- Join an active community with chats and clubs. 
- Play live any time.
- Rise up to the league’s top 10.
- Rules and explanations in the tutorial, game help, or our website: https://www.ginrummy-palace.com/gin-rummy-rules/
OUR GIN RUMMY – YOUR STYLE
- Choose your card deck: Poker, French, German, etc.
- Level up with experience for more design options.
- Use the automatic player search or pick matches manually.
- Gin Rummy base rules or exciting modifications? You choose!
FAIR-PLAY
- Constant support by our customer service team.
- Reliable, independently tested card shuffling.
- Adjustable privacy settings at Gin Rummy Palace.
HOW TO PLAY
Be quick and combine in Gin Rummy: You aim to arrange your cards in valid combinations called melds. But you don’t place them on the table at first. Instead, you draw and arrange cards covertly while shedding redundant cards underway. Which cards are the key to your victory? Knock before your opponent does to gain victory points and bonuses!
Learn more about us and our games:
https://www.palace-of-cards.com/
NOTE:
You can download this app for free. It is permanently completely free to play. However, you can purchase optional game enhancements such as game chips, premium membership, and special playing cards within the game.
The game requires an active internet connection.
By downloading the app, you agree to our terms and conditions and our privacy policy.
TOS:
https://www.ginrummy-palace.com/terms-conditions/
PRIVACY POLICY:
https://www.ginrummy-palace.com /privacy-policy-apps/
CUSTOMER SERVICE:
If you ever need help, feel free to contact our friendly customer service:
support@ginrummy-palace.com
Gin Rummy is mainly intended for an adult audience. According to German law, Gin Rummy is not a gambling game. In our app, there is no real money and no real prizes to win. Practice or success in casino games without real winnings ("Social Casino Games") does not imply future success in games for real money.
Gin Rummy Palace is a product by Spiele-Palast GmbH (Palace of Cards). Playing with family, friends, and dedicated groups is one of the favorite pastimes for many people! Our mission: Giving this joy of playing a digital home at the Palace of Cards and building a lively player community through high-quality implementations of online card games.

bluejetty:00128660:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00128660:ios.description:
Frosthaven Companion is a companion application meant to lower the setup time and maintenance while playing Frosthaven. Some of its key features are:
- Create multiple parties to maintain the state of multiple campaigns at once.
- Allow for multiple devices to synchronize at the same time, allowing remote play, or everyone around the table to see all stats without sharing their device.
- Choose which scenario the group wants to play, and the application will automatically set up all the monster stats, monster ability decks, and loot deck for that scenario.
- Mark each scenario as started or completed, and track your progress.
- The application supports opening sections in a scenario. Doing so will automatically instantiate the monsters (normal & elite) in that section.
- At any point you can draw from the Monster or Ally Attack Modifier deck, or from an extra Boss deck.
- Input the initiative of your heroes and draw Monster Ability cards for each of the monsters. Heroes and enemies will automatically be sorted by initiative, and the ability cards of each monster drawn and revealed.
- Support for auto calculations of move and attack values on Monster Ability Cards.
- Maintains the hp, xp, loot, and the various conditions of each of your heroes and monsters easily.
- Create Summons from your Hero, and track their various statistics.
- Create NPCs and set their name and hp, as well as their conditions. You can also input their initiative or snooze them.
- Maintains the status of the 6 Elements.
- Stop at any point, and resume your session in the state it was when you left.
- Undo or redo any actions between each round.
- If you do not want to input player initiatives, you can disable player initiative or even hide players.
- If you do not want to play a pre-made scenario, create your own custom session by adding any monsters from the game.
- The app takes into account the majority of the scenario and sections special cards and hp for monsters.

bluejetty:00024111:ios.name: TBC Business
bluejetty:00024111:ios.summary: Consistent with our mission "MAKE PEOPLE'S LIVES EASIER", comes a completely new app that makes the most of the feedback we receive from businesses about their needs, wishes and what they’d be interested in to see in their mobile experience
bluejetty:00024111:ios.description:
Consistent with our mission "MAKE PEOPLE'S LIVES EASIER", comes a completely new app that makes the most of the feedback we receive from businesses about their needs, wishes and what they’d be interested in to see in their mobile experience.
We have created a platform to build upon years to come and we are here to listen to you.
NEW AND HIGHLY ANTICIPATED FEATURES INCLUDE:
• Approving multiple orders with a single digipass code.
 • In-app account switching for more than two linked business accounts.
 • IBAN scanner - lets you easily scan, copy and paste long IBAN codes using your phone's camera.
 • Other minor details aimed at making the experience more convenient and seamless.
Alongside completely refreshed user experience, users will also engage with familiar mobile banking services like simple & secure authorization; overarching dashboard, money transfers and currency conversions and so on.
 An incomplete list of features of TBC Business include:
SIMPLE & SECURE AUTHORIZATION
 Users may securely access their accounts in a variety of authentication methods, starting from User & Password combination followed by a simple 5-digit pass code or by utilizing smartphone’s biometric capabilities like Fingerprint ID or Face ID.
CONSOLIDATED DASHBOARD
 The home screen of the app now includes all the essential information and shortcuts to most frequently visited parts of the app.
 Users will instantly see their total balances corresponding to their cards / accounts; loans; deposits and guarantees.
 A simple swipe through the pending orders will let the users approve or cancel them right from the home screen.
PRODUCTS
 A dedicated page to products include all the details and actions available currently in client’s product portfolio ownership - corresponding balances to accounts / multicurrency cards, blocked amounts, transactions history and so on.
 All of these in some minor differences also apply to Loans, Deposits and Guarantees.
TRANSFERS
 Users may transfer and convert currency within own accounts in just a few taps. Make national currency transfers to state treasury or to someone else (Users may use IBAN scanner as part of this particular transfer) within TBC or to other Georgian banks.
TRANSACTIONS
 A new, dedicated section of the orders waiting for confirmation lets the respective rights owner select multiple items from the pending orders and approve all of them by just a single digipass code.
 Users will be able to navigate, filter, search, check the status or take action thru particular transactions in “orders” and “transaction history” sections respectively.
MORE 
 Users with multiple linked businesses will be able to switch between accounts without signing out of the app.*
A dedicated business banker will always be in reach of few taps on the “widget”, where users may choose their preferred method of contact to that person. **
 Users will also be able to send and receive messages to and from TBC via “messaging” in more menu.
 Hiding or showing accounts, changing password, setting up passcode or biometric parameters will all be available in the “settings” menu.
 Currency section includes standard and special rates*** as well as national bank’s rates applicable at that moment.
We are very excited to deliver this initial version of the app into your hands and we cannot wait to hear your feedback, which will be very much appreciated.
*switching business accounts applies to clients who have linked their business profiles to their retail user
**only a selected number of users (clients with business banker assigned) will be able to see the business banker widget
***special rates will only be visible to a selected number of users (clients with special currency rates)

Keep in touch with rapidl
bluejetty:00018142:ios.description:
We listened to your feedback and rolled out a revamped version of BHM Capital UAE!
BHM Capital UAE is an on-the-go modern & innovative cutting-edge trading application that will simply assist the modern day trader.
Keep in touch with rapidly moving financial market data, access the latest news & announcements, trading alerts & notifications associated with the user’s subscription will positively benefit in taking wise trading decisions.
Key features of BHM Capital UAE also include:
Effective Trading
• Status panel to get current market behavior and Portfolio snapshot.
• Order placement to buy/sell/amend/cancel/market and limit orders.
• Account summary to view your account balance details including buying power
• Portfolio summary to analyze your holdings and manage your portfolios.
• Order list to view the recent orders and search for past orders.
• Deposit, Withdraw & Cash Transfer facilities.
• Time and sales details to track in-depth trade information.
Real-time Market Data
• Market Overview offers a summary of the subscribed market sessions: Turnover, Volume, Trade details of the market, Top Active by Volume, Latest News & Announcements, Sector Summary & many more. 
• More views to analyze symbols behavior in the market.
• View, Create Watchlist & add the symbols of user-specific interests.
• Real-time announcements/news as released by the exchanges/providers
• Market depth information by price and by order with more levels.
• Monitor price movements of key Market Indices, Commodities & Currencies.
Powerful Analytics
• Top stocks including gainers, losers, most-active and many more views.
• Analyse the strength of a stock, to review any possible growth or threat to a stock and determine the trading strategy through Screener
• Access fast loading Intraday and historical charts.
Services
• Be updated with real-time recommendations and market information
• Customization of language, theme, trade settings & passwords
• High security with a one-time password generating system
• Generate research Reports for the subscribed markets.
To access this application you will need a Mubasher Brokerage account. To sign up for a brokerage account, please visit Mubasher UAE website https://www.alsafwamubasher.ae/

bluejetty:00180514:ios.description:
Controlling your smart LED has never been easier. 16 million amazing color choices, coolwhite or warmwhite, or many other tones in between. Select any color you want, vary the brightness, store favorite scenes, or choose one of the preset color sequences. 
MULTI-ROOM / MULTI-SCENE
Control the bulbs individually, or group them together. Create individual moods for different rooms. Full control, at your finger tip.
SECURITY LIGHTING
Going out of town? Set the smart LED to come on and off at certain times, and no one will know you are away. Set individual timers for daily, weekdays, weekends, or specific days.
PERFECT WAKE-UP or TURN-DOWN LIGHTING
Setup the smart LED to gently turn on the room lighting in the morning, or reduce brightness in the evenings. Perfect way to start the day or settle into the evening.
PARTY TOOL
Having a party? Set the device to MIC mode, where it’ll listen to the surrounding music and change colors to match the beat.
Want lighting to match the color of the room? Easy, use the camera from the APP to detect the surrounding color, which then auto-updates the LED device to matching colors.
SHARE
Have you created the perfect scene using your lights? Have multiple users at home? No problem, use the email to share devices with other members of your household.
SECURE
Setup passwords to ensure only authorized persons have access to your smart lighting network.

GSC4myCLAC lets you access your benefits plan information wherever you are, whenever you want-unplugged, but always connected.
GSC4myCLAC allows you to
• Submit a claim directly from your smartphone or tablet and it will be processed instantly.
• Find a healthcare provider near you.
• Access Drugs on the Go to see whether your drug is covered and how much will be covered.

• Check My Alerts for notification of any outstanding claim audits.
• Get easy access to Change4Life, GSC’s interactive health management portal that supports and encourages you to get and stay healthy.

• Check My Balances, a quick and easy way to check the balance details of your healthcare accounts.
And that’s not all. Over time, we’ll equip GSC4myCLAC with features that will allow you to stay even more connected with your benefits plan.
For more information, visit https://www.clac.ca/GSC4myCLAC
*Please note that some features may not be available for your benefits plan. Data charges from your mobile service provider may apply when you use this app. For specific questions regarding your CLAC Benefits Plan, contact your CLAC Benefits Team.

bluejetty:00136217:ios.description:
Stay Connected. Stay in Control. With the Lexus App.
The Lexus app makes it easy to manage your vehicle anytime, anywhere. Designed for convenience, safety, and peace of mind, the app lets you stay connected to your Lexus like never before.
Key Lexus Interface Features (1):
Remote Connect – Start or stop your engine, and lock or unlock your doors, among other features, including Digital Key (2) and Last Parked Location
Service Connect and Maintenance Made Simple – Schedule service with your Lexus Dealer and track your vehicle’s health
Drive Connect – Map your route using Cloud navigation, Live agent support via Destination Assist, and Voice commands like “Hey Lexus. Take me home” will help you get where you want to be
Safety Connect includes Roadside Assistance Support - press the SOS button inside your Lexus for enhanced roadside assistance.
The “Assist 24/7” button on the dashboard allows you to get roadside assistance support by phone (2)
Owner Resources – Access your vehicle’s owner’s manual and warranty guides
Log in or create an account and enroll in your included trials (3) to explore the Connected Services (1) available on select Lexus models (2).
Experience smarter, more connected driving, available through the Lexus app.
(1) Lexus Interface Services vary by vehicle and are subject to change at any time without notice. Services depend on 4G network availability, a cellular connection and GPS signal. Without anyone or more of these things, operability may be limited or precluded, including access to response center and emergency support. Further, if and when 4G network changes or is discontinued, or the underlying technology required to support service becomes obsolete, then the Lexus Interface Services will not work, and Lexus will need to discontinue impacted services. Services require account registration through the Lexus app and acceptance of the Lexus Interface Terms of Use:
For the U.S., Hawaii and Puerto Rico:
 https://www.lexus.com/privacyvts/images/doc/Lexus%20-%20Connected%20Services%20Terms%20of%20Use.pdf. Data charges may apply. For Lexus Interface Services’ vehicle-generated data collection, use, sharing and retention practices and agreements, see Your Privacy Rights | Lexus.com 
For México:
Privacy Notice: https://www.lexus.mx/connected-services?link[aviso_de_privacidad_ENG][SHOW_PAGE]=true
Terms & Conditions: https://www.lexus.mx/connected-services?link[terminos_y_condiciones_ENG][SHOW_PAGE]=true
(2) Available services vary by vehicle, subscription type, region, and select markets.
(3) All trials begin on original purchase or lease date of new vehicle, with the exception of Wi-Fi for which trial begins at time of activation. Paid subscription required after trial (if applicable).

bluejetty:00068271:ios.description:
Follow the schedule of Run Half Marathon, just need 18 weeks, 3 days a week, about 50 minutes for first half training and 100 minutes for the second half training, you can becoming a Half Marathon Runner from ZERO. 
No matter if you want to lose weight, get in shape, meet running goals, start jogging training or improve fitness, Run Half Marathon can help you to make it easy and well organized. 
Run Half Marathon includes alternate walking & running, and advises when to walk or run, keeps you motivated. GPS will track your routine, you can keep your training logs and share log by Facebook, Twitter, or email, all you need to do the take Run coach with you and start running.
Key features: 
⁃ From zero to Half Marathon training schedule, 18 weeks, 3 days a week, about 50 minutes for first half training and 100 minutes for the second half. 
⁃ Alternate running and walking. 
⁃ Human voice, alert sound and vibrate to advise when to run and when to walk. 
⁃ Automatically save your log after finishing each training. 
⁃ GPS to track the route of your running. 
⁃ User friendly display distance, time used, time remaining, counting down time of each set and current speed. 
⁃ Share your training log by Facebook, Twitter, or email. 
⁃ Beautiful cups as encouragement after you finish a particular plan. 
⁃ Listen to your own music in your iPod list. 
⁃ Set a reminder to alert you running. 
⁃ Support running in background and lock screen. 
⁃ Support Mi and Km. 
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad).
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. 
If you have any question, please email to linklinksapp@tom.com.

bluejetty:00126942:ios.description:
As an Inova patient, you can use our Inova app to access MyChart, a free service offered by participating Inova medical facilities and doctors' offices that gives you personalized and secure on-line access to portions of your medical records.
For virtual and in-person visits, you can save time by completing the check-in process using the Inova app.
Our mobile app also helps you find and get directions to our hospitals, primary and specialty care offices, urgent care, imaging, and lab locations.
With Inova you can:
- Request medical appointments with your primary care provider
- Use eCheck-in to check-in to you appointment prior to your visit
- View your health summary from the MyChart electronic health record
- View test results
- Request prescription renewals
- Access trusted health information resources
- Communicate electronically and securely with your providers
- Upload health and fitness data, including data from the “Apple health app,” when enrolled in self-tracking programs

bluejetty:00120978:ios.description:
Stream live video from your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch. With Broadcaster, you can go live instantly with the touch of a button or schedule your broadcasts in advance. Broadcast to Facebook Live, Youtube Live, or any RTMP destination you choose.
Features:
• Use the Go Live Now feature to begin streaming immediately without having to schedule your broadcast
• Receive notifications reminding you of upcoming scheduled broadcasts
• Add Facebook Live, YouTube Live, or any generic RTMP as a destination for your broadcast
• Manage all of your broadcasts, whether they're from the Broadcaster app, BoxCaster, or BoxCaster Pro
• Promote future broadcasts by scheduling them in advance (promote live and past events as well)
• Preview your broadcast with a low-latency stream for enhanced troubleshooting
• Broadcast using BoxCast Flow, a smarter protocol for transmitting video to the cloud
• View event analytics and replay past broadcasts
• Use channels to categorize related broadcasts
• Charge a ticket price for your events
• Easily keep score for games using the built-in scoreboard
• Extremely small app size to prioritize the space on your device

bluejetty:00122621:ios.description:
If you’ve opened a high-yield savings account or CD with the Bread Savings online bank, this app is for you. Start saving more towards your best life, even when you’re on the go.
Ready to download the app? Please sign in with your online banking username and password.
Want more information? Here’s everything you can do with this Bread Savings app:
• Access your savings or CD accounts quickly and securely. Touch ID and PIN authentication allow sign-in using your fingerprint or personal passcode.
• Monitor your activity. View your account balances and transactions, all in one place.
• Make deposits with mobile check capture. Use your phone’s camera to snap a picture of your check – easy as can be!
• Transfer funds effortlessly. Generate one-time or repeating automatic transfers to other linked bank accounts.
• Have it your way. Customize your interface and add your own tags, images and notes to create a personalized banking experience.
• Get your questions answered. Speak with Bread Savings Customer Care at the touch of a button.
Hey, if you’ve got a Bread Financial branded credit card and you’re looking to make payments to your account, we’re sorry, this app isn’t for you. Instead, Bread Financial credit card customers can go to Account Center for everything related to your account

bluejetty:00039587:ios.description:
LUFIAN Mobil Uygulaması ile Tarzına Hız Kat
LUFIAN mobil uygulaması, zamansız stil anlayışını hızlı ve pratik bir alışveriş deneyimiyle buluşturur. Tüm koleksiyonlara ve kategorilere tek dokunuşla ulaş, aradığın parçayı saniyeler içinde bul.
Akıllı Arayüz, Hızlı Alışveriş
Sade ve kullanıcı dostu tasarımıyla LUFIAN uygulaması, ihtiyaç duyduğun ürüne zahmetsizce ulaşmanı sağlar. Gelişmiş filtreleme, tek tıkla sepete ekleme ve hızlı ödeme seçenekleriyle alışveriş sürecini kesintisiz hale getirir. Beğendiğin ürünleri favorilerine ekle, stilini dilediğin zaman kaldığın yerden tamamla.
Gelişmiş Arama Seçenekleri
Yazılı aramanın yanı sıra sesli arama ve QR kod ile ürün arama özellikleri sayesinde aradığın ürüne en kısa yoldan ulaş. 
Kampanyaları Kaçırma
Uygulama bildirimlerini açarak özel kampanya ve fırsatlardan anında haberdar ol. LUFIAN, uzun süreli kullanım imkanını ve şıklığı avantajlı fiyatlarla sunar.
Favoriler ve Sepet Her Zaman Seninle
Stiline en uygun kombinleri oluşturmak için koleksiyonlar arasında keşfe çık. Beğendiğin ürünleri favorilerine ekle, karar verdiğinde sepetinden kolayca satın al.
Dil Özgürlüğü
LUFIAN mobil uygulaması Türkçe, İngilizce ve Almanca dil seçenekleriyle hizmet verir. 
LUFIAN mobil uygulamasını indir, en tarz parçalara her an her yerde ulaş.

bluejetty:00021604:ios.description:
Are you thinking of selling your car or buying a new one? Download the free coches.net app for iOS! Get a head start with the best tool for searching, finding, buying and selling second-hand, single-owner, 0-mile and new cars.
Coches.net has a wide range of vehicles of all makes and models. We have the car you are looking for! 
YOUR NEXT CAR IS AT COCHES.NET
Find the used car that best suits your needs and budget. Coches.net displays ads for more than 250,000 cars! 
With the easy-to-use coches.net app, you will find the best price for your next car, anytime, anywhere. 
That’s not all! We’ve now added a section specifically for vans, caravans, classic competition cars and licence-free cars, helping you to refine your search.
How can I find a car I am interested in?
Coches.net advertises all kinds of cars. Find yours by searching for make, model, price, financed price and cash price, secondhand, used, as-used, by the dealer, etc.
◉ Contact the seller directly to request more information. Make an appointment to see the vehicle or send a counteroffer. 
◉ Filter ads and sort them by most recent, lowest-highest price, more or less Kms, newest to oldest, etc.
◉ Save your favourites! Log in and create your wish list. You can also view your saved ads and current offers at the website: www.coches.net. 
◉ Never miss a deal! Activate the notifications feature and we will send you an alert when one of your favourite vehicles lowers its price, saving you time and money.
You'll get this information in real-time, so you can act quickly by contacting the seller and closing the deal on your next car. 
Are you interested in buying from a particular dealer? Coches.net displays countless ads from a wide range of automobile dealerships. 
Mercedes, BMW, Audi, Nissan, Volvo and Toyota are just a few of the makes you will find on coches.net. 
DO YOU WANT TO SELL YOUR CAR?
Thinking of selling your current vehicle? Post your free ad on coches.net and start receiving requests from interested buyers. 
Posting an ad is as easy as uploading several photos of your car, its technical information and setting a price. Coches.net will review your offer and publish it in accordance with our conditions.
What are the advantages of posting and selling my car on coches.net?
◉ Post you add quickly, easily and for free. Include as many photos as you like. 
◉ Share your ad with friends and community via email, Facebook and Twitter.
◉ Edit, delete and update whenever you want via our app. 
From Vans to 4X4s, SUVs to minivans and passenger cars, your next automobile is on coches.net
EXPLORE: ROAD TESTS AND VIDEOS
Get all the latest news from the world of motoring in your coches.net app in the ‘Explore’ section.
◉ Road Tests and videos. Power assessment, energy efficiency, consumption, price comparison, etc. All car models, both current and past are deeply analyzed by our experts.
◉ What's new in the sector: latest models, engines, redesigns of classic cars, features etc.
◉ What’s happening. Find the latest on new brands, events and fairs, driving laws, advice on safe driving, etc.
Coches.net is compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch.
Download the free coches.net app! 
Find your dream car, or sell your current one. 
Coches.net, your best ally when selling your car, or buying your next one.

Stop guessing your next workout – start training with structure, balance, and purpose.
I’m Anna, your coach and creator behind Growingannanas. After helping millions of women feel stronger and more confident through my YouTube workouts, I built this app to give you everything you need to transform - physically and mentally.
Why You’ll Love the Grow with Anna App:
Structured Fitness Plans
- No more random routines! Choose a plan personalised around your goals - whether you want to build strength, tone up, increase endurance, or stay consistent.
Cycle Syncing Workouts
- Train with your body, not against it. Access guided workouts designed to match your energy and hormones through every phase of your menstrual cycle - so you can move smarter and feel your best all month long.
Nourishing Meal Plans
- Fuel your body and support your goals with delicious, nutritionist-approved meal plans and recipes. No cutting out your favourite foods
Quick, balanced, and easy to follow
- Designed for sustainable results and lasting energy
Exclusive App Workouts
- Hundreds of follow-along sessions you won’t find on YouTube, including HIIT, strength, Pilates, yoga, mobility, and more.
Progress Tracking
- See your transformation in real time. Log your workouts, track your journey, and celebrate your wins.
Daily Coaching & Motivation
- Stay accountable and inspired with mindset tools, tutorials, and meditations from Anna - your personal coach every step of the way.
Supportive Global Community
Join #TeamGrow and connect with women worldwide who are showing up, lifting each other up, and growing together.
App-Only Benefits
• Structured plans for every fitness level
 • New challenges each month
 • Meal plans and healthy recipes
 • Cycle-syncing workouts for women
 • Progress tracking and motivation
 • Coaching, mindset, and community support
Real Results. Real Balance. Real You.
No extreme diets. No guilt. Just structured training, joyful movement, and nourishing meals that make you feel amazing.
Download Grow with Anna today and start your fitness transformation - strong, confident, and balanced.

bluejetty:00033245:ios.summary:
Stuck in a waiting room? Bored on your commute? Craving a story you can finish before your coffee gets cold? Shorts turns any spare minute into pure entertainment, with exclusive short dramas and movies made for watching on the go.
Dive in
bluejetty:00033245:ios.description:
Stuck in a waiting room? Bored on your commute? Craving a story you can finish before your coffee gets cold? Shorts turns any spare minute into pure entertainment, with exclusive short dramas and movies made for watching on the go.
Dive into a growing library of bite-sized stories and films, many inspired by best-selling novels, all in stunning high definition. With new episodes added constantly, no two visits to Shorts ever look the same.
WHY SHORTS
Most streaming apps ask for hours you don't have. Shorts is built differently: every story is told in fast, addictive episodes designed to fit into the small gaps of your day, whether that's a lunch break, a train ride, or the ten minutes before bed. No long setup, no filler, just the good parts, episode after episode.
MOVIES FOR EVERY TASTE
Explore an extensive range of genres, from contemporary romance to fantasy, thriller, and revenge sagas. Follow stories about modern love, unbreakable friendships, powerful CEOs, hidden identities, second-chance romance, forbidden love, and shady mafia underworlds. There's always something new and captivating to watch, no matter your mood.
FEATURES
– Exclusive short dramas and movies you won't find anywhere else
– New titles and episodes added frequently, so there's always something fresh
– Smart, tailored recommendations based on the most popular novel adaptations
– Seamless HD streaming with a clean, easy-to-use design
– Bite-sized episodes built for quick, addictive viewing
– Save and follow your favorite series so you never miss a new episode
– Pick up right where you left off, on any device
– Browse curated collections by genre, mood, or trending rank
– Smooth, low-buffer streaming even on the go
TAILORED RECOMMENDATIONS
Our recommendation engine studies what you love and curates a personal lineup of short dramas and films, so every story on your feed feels handpicked for you. The more you watch, the sharper your recommendations get.
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Commuters binge a full episode between stops. Night owls fall asleep to a cliffhanger and wake up ready for the next one. Anyone who loves a good story but doesn't have hours to spare turns to Shorts for entertainment that fits their schedule, not the other way around. Whether you have five minutes or a free afternoon, there's always a story sized just right.
TRENDING NOW
- Dear Stranger, I Love You: Write for love. Lie for survival. Fall anyway.
- Lessons in Love and Hate: Tutoring her enemy. Falling for him by accident.
- Engaged to the Secret Billionaire: Heiress fakes love... until when?
- Surrender to My Ex's Dad: Betrayed lover. Billionaire dad. Forbidden passion.
- Oops, I Married My Enemy: One impulsive wedding, zero regrets... or so she thought.
GETTING STARTED
Open the app, browse trending titles or search by genre, and tap any episode to start watching instantly. Follow a series to get notified the moment a new episode drops, and pick up exactly where you left off every time you come back.
Shorts is your ultimate companion for entertainment on the go or during downtime. Download now and start your next obsession.
SUBSCRIPTION
You can subscribe for premium access with unlimited stories
- Subscription is from $14.99 USD weekly
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one month"/"three months"/"one year" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Terms and conditions: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/19862208
Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/19862208

bluejetty:00150179:ios.description:
DailyTravel is an app designed by Westat to collect travel information for transportation studies. This information includes the location of places visited by participants along with details that explain the why, how, and when of travel to these places.
Transportation planners will use information collected from this study to develop forecasts of future travel in your city, region, and state. A number of households have been randomly selected to participate and represent households in the entire region. Only selected households have been provided a Personal Identification Number (PIN) and are able to use the DailyTravel app. The information that your household and other households in the survey provide will help build a complete and accurate picture of state and local transportation needs so that public funds for improvements can be spent where they are needed most.
Please visit the DailyTravel support website for more information. 
Warning: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00137392:ios.description:
Stay ahead in the intergalactic battle for democracy with the War Monitor for Helldivers 2 companion app, now featuring the addictive Stratagem Hero mini-game! Get real-time updates on the ongoing war, track planet statuses and liberation levels, and view the current Major Order all at your fingertips. Challenge your Stratagem skills and climb the ranks on the Game Center leaderboards. Enhance your Helldivers 2 experience with strategic insights and up-to-the-minute information, ensuring you're always ready for your next mission. Download the Helldivers Companion app War Monitor and do your part!
Features:
- Completely FREE with NO ADS! 
- Live updates on the Helldivers 2 intergalactic war
- Planet status and Major Order monitoring, view history of liberation, defense and player count with beautiful charts!
- GALAXY MAP! Plan and strategise your next moves, featuring supply lines!
- SUPER STORE ROTATION! Check the currently available items in the Super Store
- Armours Weapons, Stratagems and Boosters glossary to check the stats for all the equipment you might need out on the field!
- View details for each planet showing the current weather/environmental effects, statistics such as total Terminids squished and more 
- News and status updates, with notifications for live updates
- Check the current major order, and view the current progress
- Track the location of the DEMOCRACY SPACE STATION and view active effects 
- Widgets! Display current war stats right on your home screen! 
- The exciting STRATAGEM HERO mini-game, with high scores synced between Apple Watch and iPhone! (Now with sounds and custom loadouts!)
- Leaderboard rankings and Game Center integration for competitive play
Plus, get War Monitor on Apple Watch! Check the status of the war at a glance, and feel like a true Helldiver practicing stratagems right on your wrist!
Please note this is a continuous work in progress and might be prone to some pesky terminids!
Developed by James Poole.
Disclaimer: This app is independently created and is not officially affiliated with Arrowhead Game Studios or Sony. All game content and trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

Free Plan Includes:
> Unlimited campaigns

> EVERYTHING IN FREE PLUS

> ALL FEATURES IN PRO AND FREE PLUS
> All Pro features for you and your players in up to 2 campaigns

> 10% Marketplace discount

Join thousands of Game Masters and players running their best campaigns from D&D dungeon crawls to narrative-driven Call of Cthulhu mysteries and beyond on Quest Portal.
