bluejetty:00024761:ios.name: AA Big Book Ultimate Companion
bluejetty:00024761:ios.summary: Listen to the entire Alcoholics Anonymous Big Book as well as audiobooks, audio courses, and speaker tapes to help you stop drinking, live sober, and recover from alcoholism. The AA Big Book from Bill Wilson and Dr. Bob has helped millions
bluejetty:00024761:ios.description:
Listen to the entire Alcoholics Anonymous Big Book as well as audiobooks, audio courses, and speaker tapes to help you stop drinking, live sober, and recover from alcoholism. The AA Big Book from Bill Wilson and Dr. Bob has helped millions of men and women give up alcoholism and drug addiction. Learn from inspiring stories by Al-Anon speakers. Get tips on how to quit substance abuse through the use of the 12 step program. This app is like always having the AA Big Book in your pocket.
The Big Book is a necessary tool for members of Alcoholics Anonymous and Narcotics Anonymous. Its lessons have helped alcoholics and drug addicts for nearly 80 years by teaching them how to find sobriety through a power greater than themselves. Bill Wilson and Dr. Bob pioneered the 12 step program and started the tradition of Al-Anon meetings. This app not only helps you to master their teachings, but also provides hundreds of hours of content from addiction and alcoholism experts who built on the lessons from the Big Book.
LESSONS AT YOUR OWN PACE - Listen to stories of addiction and addiction recovery whenever you want. Can’t make it to a sober meeting or get ahold of your sponsor? Let Al-anon come to you. Create your own playlist that works for your specific addiction.
LEARN FROM EXPERTS - Hear from masters and professionals who work in the substance abuse, drug abuse, and alcoholism space. Learn tactics to get clean. Replace negative patterns with healthy habits. 
GET CLEAN - We understand that the goal is living sober. This app will aid in your recovery by giving you the guidance you need to quit and stay quit. 
FREE APP -This app is free to download and includes over 30 hours of free audio programs. To unlock and get all content, you’ll want to subscribe. (in-app purchase fees apply).
GET ON TRACK - Audiojoy makes it simple. Listen to an audio lesson every day and stay disciplined. Explore a rich library of tracks on abuse.
FEATURES:
This app is packed full of amazing features to help you recover and keep up with the al-anon community: 
+ 1000+ audio tracks, 100+ hours of content
+ Daily featured audio content
+ Search and explore all content
+ Add to a favorites list
+ Listen while offline
+ Build a playlist of the tracks you want to hear
+ Read along with the text version
+ Sleep and meditation timer
+ Looping relaxation and meditation sounds (over 2.4 million combinations)
+ Daily inspiration notifications with powerful artwork to keep you motivated
CONTENT INCLUDED:
This app includes hundreds of hours of amazing content on drug abuse, recovery, Alcoholics Anonymous, and more. We add new stuff weekly. Here is a sample of audio content you will find:
+ The Big Book of Alcoholics Anonymous
+ AA 12 Steps & 12 Traditions
+ Daily Reflections & Readings from the Big Book
+ How to Live Sober
+ AA Meeting Speakers
+ Narcotics Anonymous Speaker Tapes
+ Al-Anon Speakers and Stories
+ Stories from Bill Wilson
+ 12 Step Workshops for Addiction, Alcoholism and Al-Anon
+ Personal Stories of Recovery for Alcoholics Anonymous
+ Sober Meditations and Prayers
+ Guided Meditations for Mindfulness and Relaxation
+ Looping Sleep Sounds and Meditation Music
+ Inspirational Speakers and Motivational Stories
--------
We offer auto-renewing subscriptions as well a one-time unlock fee via in-app purchase. Details about our subscriptions for Audiojoy content are:
* 1 Month (auto renews every month) for $3.99
* 3 Month (auto renews every 3 months) for $6.99
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
* No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. 
Please read our privacy policy and terms of use: http://audiojoy.co/terms

bluejetty:00070402:ios.name: PokeT-Walk | Sync your Steps
bluejetty:00070402:ios.summary:
PokeT-Walk logs the steps you really walked but your phone never counted, and writes them into Apple Health.
No account. No sign-up. Nothing to connect. Pick a distance, tap once, and the steps and walking distance go straight into Apple H
bluejetty:00070402:ios.description:
PokeT-Walk logs the steps you really walked but your phone never counted, and writes them into Apple Health.
No account. No sign-up. Nothing to connect. Pick a distance, tap once, and the steps and walking distance go straight into Apple Health. Other apps that read Health decide for themselves whether to count them.
WHEN YOU NEED IT
• You walked at work, where you cannot carry your phone
• You went out for a walk or a run and left the phone at home
• Your battery died and those steps were never recorded
• You walked indoors or on a treadmill and want it to count
WHAT IT DOES
• One tap to log: pick a distance, press once
• Writes to Apple Health: steps and walking distance together
• History and charts: every entry you have synced, any time
• Custom Walk (PRO): any distance from 0.5 to 25 km, any pace from 2 to 12 km/h
• Natural Pace switch: the daily guard is yours to turn off in Settings
• Dark mode
HOW TO USE IT
1. Allow PokeT-Walk to write to Apple Health
2. Tap the distance you walked
3. Steps and distance are saved to Health
FREQUENTLY ASKED
Do I need an account?
No. There is no login and no sign-up.
Does it work offline?
Yes. Logging steps needs no internet connection.
Where do the steps go?
Into the Health app built into your iPhone. Any other app that reads Health can read them.
Will every app count these steps?
Not necessarily. Some apps and games only count steps their own software recorded and ignore anything another app wrote into Health. That is their decision, not a setting in PokeT-Walk, and no app can change it for them.
Is there a free version?
Yes. Logging steps is free. PRO removes ads and unlocks Custom Walk.
Is there a daily limit?
By default a Natural Pace guard keeps entries within a believable walking rhythm. You can switch it off in Settings, and then there is no limit.
How soon do the steps appear?
Writing to Health is immediate. Other apps that read Health refresh on their own schedule, which can take a while.
IF SOMETHING DOES NOT SYNC
Settings > Help covers how to check Health permissions, how to restore a purchase, and what to do when an entry does not show up.
ABOUT PRO
PRO removes ads and unlocks Custom Walk. Duration and price are shown on the purchase screen inside the app.
Terms of Use: https://ghapps1.wordpress.com/terms-condition/
Privacy Policy: https://ghapps1.wordpress.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00144818:ios.description:
maxbud is the ultimate companion for the AI Nutrition Scale, designed to revolutionize how you track your diet. By combining smart hardware with advanced AI, we transform nutrition tracking from a guessing game into a precise science—instantly.
Whether you are managing weight, focusing on protein intake, or tracking medications (like GLP-1 treatments), maxbud offers an all-in-one solution to streamline your daily health routine.
Why maxbud?
Speed: No more manual searching. Just weigh, snap, and record.
Precision: AI visual analysis combined with exact weight data delivers nutrition accuracy that photo-only apps can’t match.
Simplicity: Your diet, water, weight, and medication logs in one seamless timeline.
Key Features:
1. AI Nutrition Scale Integration: Place your food on the scale, and our app instantly calculates calories, protein, and macros based on the exact weight. Say goodbye to tedious manual entries and database searching—logging your meals is now faster than ever.
2. Precision Beyond Estimation: Visual AI is good, but Weight + AI is better. Maxbud eliminates the guesswork of portion sizes. By combining the precise data from your smart scale with image recognition, we provide the most accurate nutritional breakdown for your meals.
3. All-Day Nutrition & Protein Tracking: Monitor your daily intake with ease. Whether you are aiming for a calorie deficit or high protein goals, maxbud visualizes your progress. Track calories, carbs, fat, fiber, and protein in real-time.
4. All-in-One Health Hub: Simplify your lifestyle. maxbud isn't just for food; it’s your complete health command center:
-Diet Record: Stay on top of your nutrition with a clear, detailed history of your daily meals.
-Weight Tracker: Visualize your progress and spot trends over time.
-Water Reminder: Stay hydrated with smart, timely alerts.
-Medication Management: Log injection sites, track dosages, and monitor side effects effortlessly.
5. AI Health Coach: Have a question about a specific food, a side effect, or your diet progress? Chat with Max, your AI assistant. Max is ready to provide instant answers, nutritional advice, and motivation whenever you need it.
6. Insightful Analytics: Visualize your journey with clear charts and summaries. See how your diet affects your weight and identify patterns to help you reach your goals faster.
7. Apple Health Sync: Effortlessly sync

ENDALGO is BEST for
 
● Sports Groups - Organize pickup games that are looking for more people. Collect RSVPs, waitlists, and payments. 
 
● Activity Groups - Organize events and collect payments. Sell memberships with various pricing packages. 
 
● Sports Teams and Clubs: Host tryouts, tournaments, and social meetups. Start registrations for the new seasons.  
 
● Coaches - Host classes, training sessions, and clinics with our experience feature. A seamless booking solution, calendar settings, and a simple payment process.  
 
● Local communities - Sell registrations for local events, chat with people, and host social events along with our RSVP feature.  
 
● Activity hosts - Earn money doing what you love by organizing your experience. Host Dance classes, group yoga sessions, group fitness, etc. 

What can you do as an ENDALGO user? 

● Join groups to stay connected

● Discover activities and sports near you

● RSVP to events you love to attend

● Register for events or memberships

● Book experiences to meet local experts

● Chat with people you meet

● Start your group for free

What are our users looking for? 

Join ENDALGO to start your soccer, basketball, camping, cycling, dance, fitness, boot camp, yoga, hiking, social, health and wellness, rock climbing, running, rugby, skateboarding, kickball, and more groups that people are looking for.

Why ENDALGO?
 
ENDALGO is the best way to build and grow your community. We are working on a mission to build a healthier community by connecting people through sports and activities. It’s a free platform for group organizers to organize their groups. 
 
We value your feedback! Send us your feedback and/or suggestions so we can make ENDALGO better for you & your groups.

Email: help@endalgo.com

Capture life’s moments with the Moleskine Journal app. More than a diary, Moleskine Journal allows you to add different media to each written entry, bringing texture, color and depth to your memories. 
Effortlessly capture your thoughts, showcase your favorite images, and log your mood and daily habits. Reflect on your experiences and personal growth with ease. Moleskine Journal transforms your journaling routine into a daily ritual that inspires consistency and mindfulness. 
This beautifully designed app is a powerful companion for your personal journey, always on hand to capture everything.
Features: 
TEXT JOURNAL ENTRIES 
Easily capture your thoughts and experiences with intuitive text journal entries. Document your daily reflections and ideas with ease and simplicity. 
CUSTOM AND SUGGESTED PROMPTS  
Enhance your journaling with a selection of prompts from our extensive library or create custom prompts that align with your personal interests and goals. 
HABIT TRACKER  
Track your daily habits and routines with ease. Visualize your progress and stay motivated as you work toward building and maintaining positive habits. 
[COMING SOON] RICH MEDIA CONTENT 
Enrich your journal entries with diverse media content. Add images, videos, and audio to create a vibrant and engaging record of your life’s moments. 
[COMING SOON] MOOD TRACKER  
Monitor your emotional well-being with the mood tracker, allowing you to log your feelings and gain insights into your emotional patterns over time.

bluejetty:00175944:ios.name: Bible Oil Painting By Number
bluejetty:00175944:ios.summary: Bible Oil Painting Game is more than just a game; it's a spiritual companion for individuals of all ages who yearn for a deeper connection with God and Jesus through the mesmerizing art of painting. For those who find solace in the Holy Boo
bluejetty:00175944:ios.description:
Bible Oil Painting Game is more than just a game; it's a spiritual companion for individuals of all ages who yearn for a deeper connection with God and Jesus through the mesmerizing art of painting. For those who find solace in the Holy Book and delight in coloring by numbers, Bible Coloring is your sanctuary!
The game is a treasure trove of sacred images waiting to be adorned with color. From divine narratives, holy characters, to scripture verses, and symbolic Christian icons, there's an abundance of spiritual inspiration to explore.
- Biblical Narratives: Relive the Creation, Adam and Eve, The Tower of Babel, and more!
- Holy Characters: Paint the Lord, Jesus, Virgin Mary, Joseph, Noah, Asher, Benjamin, and more!
- Sacred Scriptures: Immerse yourself in painting Bible verses or holy writings, engaging in a daily conversation with God!
- Biblical Creatures: Pigeon, sheep, lion, and more!
- Christian Symbols: Cross, Church, Prayers, Holy, Hallelujah, Bible Story, Bible Verse, and Christian Festivals!
Moreover, Bible Coloring also serves as a delightful family game, fostering quality time with Bible verses and God. Gather your loved ones around tablets and phones, and engage in a friendly race to see who can bring the pictures to life first. It's a wonderful way to bond and connect with the Lord!
Bible Oil Painting also offers a unique opportunity for you to commune with God, anytime, anywhere. It's a simple yet profound way to color the words of God and engage in prayer through holy coloring pages. Whether you're seeking to pass the time or waiting in a queue, this coloring book invites you to create your own masterpieces and construct a vibrant secret garden right on your mobile device!
Highlighted Features of Bible Oil Painting Game
- Enjoy the convenience of coloring by numbers without the need for pencil or paper, anytime, anywhere.
- Dive into a plethora of Bible themes such as Holy, Hallelujah, Bible Story, Bible Verse, and Christian Festival.
- Suitable for all age groups, offering a wide variety of holy pictures with varying levels of difficulty, from simple to challenging.
- Utilize helpful hints to locate tiny coloring cells and complete your artworks swiftly.
- Effortlessly zoom in and out while painting your images using simple finger movements.
- Experience the user-friendly interface and straightforward navigation of the app.
- Showcase your artistic creations by sharing them with your loved ones and friends.
Don't miss out on the divine journey of creativity and spirituality that Bible Paint by Number offers! Join now and start transforming beautiful biblical images into your own vibrant masterpieces.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00134663:ios.summary:

SMS is supported on ALL of our US and Canada Numbers! Getting started is easy, all you need to do is activate one
bluejetty:00134663:ios.description:
The completely new Callcentric SMS app has been re-designed to provide the best SMS experience with your Callcentric account.
SMS is supported on ALL of our US and Canada Numbers! Getting started is easy, all you need to do is activate one of our SMS Access Plans on your Callcentric account and install this app on your iOS device. That's it!
REQUIRED TO USE THIS APP 
• An active Callcentric VoIP service account
• Callcentric SMS Access Plan & US/Canada phone number
NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED
• MMS Messaging (group messages, attachments, etc)
• SMS Messaging with International numbers (outside of US/Canada)
FEATURES & HIGHLIGHTS
• SMS Messaging in real-time
• Dark Mode support for easier viewing 
• Option to use the Contact List in your device 
• Support for messaging with multiple numbers via a single interface
• Enable/Disable SMS functionality on any of your US, Canada, or toll-free numbers
• Store the username and settings for multiple accounts for fast switching between logins
• Show your SMS number (the number you are sending from) in the conversation list - useful when you use multiple SMS numbers. Enable in settings
• Set a default SMS number to use for sending messages or manually choose the SMS number you want to use on a per message basis. Enable in settings
Access to Contacts (optional):
Used to let you select a contact to send an SMS to, and properly show name information on messages received with an entry in your iPhone/iPad contacts. Your Contact list will NEVER to be uploaded to Callcentric. Data is used locally within the app. We do not have access to your Contacts outside of the app.
Notifications (optional):
We use push notifications to notify you of incoming SMS messages in real-time when the app is in the background. WARNING: if you do not enable notifications you will not receive notice of new incoming SMS messages until the next time you open the app.

bluejetty:00026538:ios.description:
Beat Swiper is a unique mobile rhythm game where your goal is to slash the beats as they come flying towards you.
Swipe & Enjoy!
Immerse Yourself in the Ultimate Rhythm Adventure with Beat Swiper!
Prepare for an electrifying rhythm experience that brings pulse-pounding gameplay to your fingertips. Beat Swiper lets you slice through blocks and conquer challenges, all in sync with the music!
Unleash Your Inner Rhythm Master
Become a skilled swordsman and cut through blocks as they fly towards you. Swipe in the correct direction to slice each block, following the rhythm and mastering each level’s unique patterns.
Endless Challenges
Put your skills to the test in a series of rhythm-matching and saber precision challenges, each featuring fresh patterns and tempos to keep you engaged.
Immersive Visual and Audio Experience
Step into a world of neon colors and pulsating beats. Beat Swiper’s vibrant visuals and dynamic soundtrack will elevate your gaming experience to new heights.
Compete for Glory
Challenge friends or players worldwide to see who can achieve the highest score. Prove your rhythm prowess and claim the title of ultimate Beat Swiper champion.
Perfect for Rhythm Game Enthusiasts
If you love rhythm-based action, Beat Swiper is the perfect mobile game for you. Its intuitive controls and addictive gameplay will keep you slicing through challenges wherever you go. Master your saber skills and conquer every level.
Be in touch with us :
contact@beatswiper.com

- When you confirm your purchase, the payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

- In order to avoid being charged, please be sure to complete it 24 hours before the end of the subscription.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Cohérence Cardiaque Respirotec
L’application par excellence de la Cohérence Cardiaque développée par le Dr David O’Hare, auteur de 7 livres sur la Cohérence Cardiaque, dont Cohérence Cardiaque 365 et Cohérence Kid.
Intégrez la technique d
bluejetty:00040756:ios.description:
Cohérence Cardiaque Respirotec
L’application par excellence de la Cohérence Cardiaque développée par le Dr David O’Hare, auteur de 7 livres sur la Cohérence Cardiaque, dont Cohérence Cardiaque 365 et Cohérence Kid.
Intégrez la technique de la Cohérence Cardiaque dans votre vie et vivez mieux.  La Cohérence Cardiaque est reconnue médicalement et scientifiquement comme la méthode numéro 1 pour gérer le stress, réduire l'anxiété et réguler les émotions.
Vous aurez accès gratuitement aux nombreux guides respiratoires de la Respirotèque, la page la plus visitée du site numéro 1 de la cohérence cardiaque, www.coherenceinfo.com.
Variez votre pratique avec les nombreux guides offerts sur des vidéos inspirantes de scènes de nature. Vous pourrez choisir entre 6 rythmes respiratoires :
- Equilibre 5/5
- Equilibre Plus 5/6
- Equilibrelax  4/6
- Equilibretonic 6/4
- Enfants 4-8 ans 3/3
- Enfants 9-12 ans 4/4
Les bénéfices de la Cohérence Cardiaque :
Les bénéfices constatés d'une pratique régulière de la Cohérence Cardiaque comprennent entre autres :
Au plan psychologique et émotionnel :
- Réduction du stress
- Augmentation de l’énergie et de la résilience
- Une plus grande clarté mentale, meilleure prise de décision
- Augmentation des capacités intellectuelles et créatrices
- Augmentation de l’équilibre émotionnel
- Amélioration de la capacité d’écoute, de la qualité de présence
Au plan physiologique et de santé
- Augmentation du taux de DHEA (l‘hormone de jeunesse)
- Réduction du taux du cholestérol
- Réduction de l’hypertension artérielle
- Réduction du diabète
- Amélioration du sommeil 
- Augmentation du système immunitaire
- Perte de poids
De nouvelles vidéos seront ajoutées régulièrement afin de varier votre pratique.
Deux rythmes respiratoires dédiés à la pratique des enfants sont aussi inclus car la Cohérence Cardiaque est de plus en plus utilisée dans les écoles et par les enseignants.
Guides respiratoires personnalisés :
Créez vos propres guides respiratoires à partir des photos de votre téléphone.
Choisissez 5 photos sur votre téléphone et téléchargez-les comme fond d’écran de vos guides respiratoires. Ainsi vous pourrez créer des guides respiratoires par thème. Par exemple famille, amis, nature, voyage, etc.
Si vous voulez avoir une pratique régulière de Cohérence Cardiaque impliquant aussi des émotions, des moments de contemplation, des moments de plaisir, la possibilité de choisir l'image est une caractéristique plus qu’intéressante.
En choisissant des photos de personnes qui vont sont chères, d'autres à qui vous voulez dire merci, des personnes malades dont vous désirez la guérison, vous développerez des émotions telles que la gratitude, la reconnaissance et la compassion.
Cela augmentera les bienfaits de votre pratique car, en plus de l’induction respiratoire vous bénéficierez de l’induction émotionnelle et vous amplifierez votre état de Cohérence Cardiaque afin d’entrer en Résonance Cardiaque.
Caractéristiques de l’Application
- 5 photos soit une photo différente à chaque minute pour une séance de 5 minutes
- Guide auditif sous forme de gong
- Compte à rebours
- Durées des sessions de 3 à 20 minutes

listings.name: Respirotec – Cardiac Coherence
listings.description:
The cardiac coherence app created by Dr. David O'Hare, author of 7 books on cardiac coherence, including "Cohérence Cardiaque 365" and "Cohérence Kid".

Bring the cardiac coherence technique into your daily life and feel better. Cardiac coherence is a simple, well-known breathing practice used to manage stress, ease anxiety and regulate emotions.

FREE BREATHING GUIDES
Get free access to the many breathing guides of the "Respirotèque", set over inspiring nature videos. Choose between 6 breathing rhythms:
• Balance 5/5
• Balance + 5/6
• Balancerelax 4/6
• Balancetonic 6/4
• Young children (4–8 years) 3/3
• Children (9–12 years) 4/4

Two of these rhythms are designed for children, as cardiac coherence is increasingly used in schools and by teachers.

REPORTED BENEFITS OF REGULAR PRACTICE
• Less stress
• More energy and resilience
• Greater mental clarity and focus
• Greater emotional balance
• Better sleep

PERSONALISED BREATHING GUIDES (PREMIUM)
Create your own breathing guides from the photos and videos on your phone: up to 5 photos, shown one after another, or up to 5 videos, played in sequence. Create themed guides: family, friends, nature, travel and more.

Choose photos of people who are dear to you, people you want to thank, or people whose recovery you wish for, and you will cultivate gratitude, appreciation and compassion. Breathing combined with emotion strengthens your coherent state.

FEATURES
• Personalised guides with up to 5 photos or 5 videos
• A ball that rises and falls with your breath, in the size and colour of your choice
• Audio guide: Tibetan gong
• Audio guide: music by Anthony Doux, musicologist
• Countdown timer
• Sessions from 3 to 20 minutes
• Session reminders, up to 3 times a day

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Personalised guides and reminders are available with Premium, an auto-renewable yearly subscription that includes a free one-week trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, after the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.coherenceinfo.com/support/mentions-legales/

Respirotec is a wellness app and does not replace medical advice.

bluejetty:00088896:ios.description:
HEY, INNKEEPER, GOT A ROOM FOR THE KNIGHT?
Looking for a fun idle game that takes you back in time? Welcome to the Middle Ages in this crazy tavern clicker game! As most of the arguments here end with a fight, we need a new innkeeper for the Fat Boar Inn! Ready for a management game that’s a real challenge? In this original simulator game, build a medieval hotel empire and become a hospitality tycoon.
Historic tavern game: Had enough of cheap motels and corporate hospitality? In this original hotel simulator, you can become a tavern tycoon: provide rest for weary travellers by running a real medieval inn: construct new rooms, buy furniture and upgrade it all to bring the maximum comfort the Middle Ages can offer to your guests.
Build a tavern empire: From the remote mountains to the bustling metropolis, the game already has eight inns in very different environments for you to explore and expand. Open and improve them all in this hotel simulator to become a real medieval magnate.
Let the feasting begin: Operate a kitchen and bar to satisfy visitors’ needs with medieval delicacies and THOUSANDS OF LITRES of drink for your tavern’s thirsty guests. Give them roast venison with ale, and keep the gruel to a minimum if you want to progress in the game.
Old-fashioned business: Make your purse swell and get the resources you need by providing the very best in medieval service, meeting your visitors’ needs, and hiring new staff to keep the coin rolling in while you’re not in the game.
Good inn-vestment: Plough your profits back into the business in this tavern clicker game by purchasing new services including restaurants, more luxurious lodging, and fun facilities including gyms, bathhouses and beaches to turn your inn into a luxury medieval resort.
What’s on at the inn? Explore a whole range of exotic services – fight at the coliseum, chill at the bathhouse or explore exciting new activities like fishing, bar games and diving.
Medieval menagerie: As you progress through the game, collect cute pets and adorable farmyard animals that will roam around your taverns to the delight (and surprise) of your guests.
Bring me masons! Become a builder and construct spectacular landmarks that will really make your inn stand out from the crowd and boost your idle income in the game!
Time off from the tavern: Take a break from the medieval hospitality business to compete in the Chocolate Factory and Fishing events, with more fun and exciting special locations coming soon!
MAKE SURE THERE’S ALWAYS ROOM AT THE INN
Think you can make it in the cutthroat world of medieval innkeeping? Download Idle Inn Empire now, open your first humble inn and start raking in the gold in this fun and original medieval tavern clicker game!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

listings.name: Idle Inn Empire: Hotel Tycoon
listings.description:
HEY, INNKEEPER, GOT A ROOM FOR THE KNIGHT?
Looking for a fun idle game that takes you back in time? Welcome to the Middle Ages in this crazy tavern clicker game! As most of the arguments here end with a fight, we need a new innkeeper for the Fat Boar Inn! Ready for a management game that’s a real challenge? In this original simulator game, build a medieval hotel empire and become a hospitality tycoon.

Historic tavern game: Had enough of cheap motels and corporate hospitality? In this original hotel simulator, you can become a tavern tycoon: provide rest for weary travellers by running a real medieval inn: construct new rooms, buy furniture and upgrade it all to bring the maximum comfort the Middle Ages can offer to your guests.


Build a tavern empire: From the remote mountains to the bustling metropolis, the game already has eight inns in very different environments for you to explore and expand. Open and improve them all in this hotel simulator to become a real medieval magnate.


Let the feasting begin: Operate a kitchen and bar to satisfy visitors’ needs with medieval delicacies and THOUSANDS OF LITRES of drink for your tavern’s thirsty guests. Give them roast venison with ale, and keep the gruel to a minimum if you want to progress in the game.


Old-fashioned business: Make your purse swell and get the resources you need by providing the very best in medieval service, meeting your visitors’ needs, and hiring new staff to keep the coin rolling in while you’re not in the game.


Good inn-vestment: Plough your profits back into the business in this tavern clicker game by purchasing new services including restaurants, more luxurious lodging, and fun facilities including gyms, bathhouses and beaches to turn your inn into a luxury medieval resort.


What’s on at the inn? Explore a whole range of exotic services – fight at the coliseum, chill at the bathhouse or explore exciting new activities like fishing, bar games and diving.
Medieval menagerie: As you progress through the game, collect cute pets and adorable farmyard animals that will roam around your taverns to the delight (and surprise) of your guests.
Bring me masons! Become a builder and construct spectacular landmarks that will really make your inn stand out from the crowd and boost your idle income in the game!


Time off from the tavern: Take a break from the medieval hospitality business to compete in the Chocolate Factory and Fishing events, with more fun and exciting special locations coming soon!

MAKE SURE THERE’S ALWAYS ROOM AT THE INN
Think you can make it in the cutthroat world of medieval innkeeping? Download Idle Inn Empire now, open your first humble inn and start raking in the gold in this fun and original medieval tavern clicker game!

Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00017947:ios.description:
Gateway Bank Mobile App is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Gateway Bank Mobile App:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Gateway Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Gateway Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00022239:ios.description:
I wish you could be happy today with my music.
Calm and relaxing game with the Guitar Girl's performance! Be more zen!
Gather the scattered puzzles, and give the girl's daily life a special and wonderful makeover.
■ Calm and relaxing puzzle games enjoyed with guitar melodies
Complete many challenging levels and unlock new album!
Pop many puzzles at once and get a special puzzle game item.
Complete the consecutive puzzle combos and blast them!
■ Give her fashion a makeover! One of the best fashion games \( ﾟヮﾟ)/
Unlock more than 66 types of fashion and 80 types of guitars.
Make over guitar girl's style with more than 70 kinds of accessories!
From lovely clothes for the warm spring to casual&funky fashion for the busking in front of the bakery!
Give her the best makeover for that special day! Jump into fashion games!
■ Girl's Beautiful Guitar Play
Make your own playlist with 38 beautiful and comfortable guitar music!
■ Refresh the calm zen world with more furnitures
The Girl's room, the classroom, picnic spots, and busking streets, practice room, concert stage, beach concert!
Furnish special and zen places with more views and scenes!
One of the best makeup games / makeover games / fashion games / style games!
■ Complet my own pictogram
Feed the girl's happy moments and get hearts.
■ Various & Uniques puzzle games
Challenge various missions in the puzzle games!
Test my own puzzle game skills by matching them with the Girl's guitar music.
No time to get bored! Blast difficult tasks by using special boosters such as candy and butterfly in the match 3 games!
■ Generous rewards awaiting every day
Grab candy, gold, heart, and chocolate rewards a handful!
Clear the daily match games and get rewards needed for accomplishing various missions in the match 3 games!
When reaching a higher star level, generous rewards such as special candy and chocolate will be given!
■ High quality match 3 & fashion art
Enjoy beautiful anime arts in matching games!
High quality puzzles and fashion designs are ready!
■ The Girl's Mini Game
 1. Match League
 - Play against opponents from around the world in online match3 leagues.
 - Games are played on the same game board in turn, so players' choices affect each other.
 - Compete in matches to check your ranking and earn coins.
 2. Bejeweled
 - Classic color matching game which is the most addictive puzzle!
 - Enjoy 9 puzzles within each 5 themes after 50 levels.
 - Complete the theme and receive huge rewards such as accessories, music, and coins.
 3. Tripeaks
 - Exciting card game that anyone can easily enjoy!
 - Enjoy 6 Tripeaks within each 10 themes after clearing 75 levels.
 - After completing one theme, the new Tripeaks opens after 2 days.
 - Complete the theme and receive huge rewards.
 4. 2048+Match3
 - Earn 2048 by matching colors!
 - 2, 4, 8, 16, 36, ... , 2048 ... The more colors you merge, the higher number you get.
 - After level 30, you can open the competition with users all over the world.
 - The ranking uses Playgame ID, and the ID can be changed in Playgame.
 - Raise your ranking and get huge rewards.
----------------------------------
[Notice]
1. The app includes partial cash (real-money) items and game money payment function.
Actual payment will be proceeded when purchasing partial cash items, so please be aware.
2. Digital products purchased in the game may be able/limited to be refunded according to the Act on the Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce.

bluejetty:00144195:ios.name: Baby Bottle & Pumping Tracker
bluejetty:00144195:ios.summary: With the lack of sleep and repeated routine, it's easy to forget when your baby is last fed. Our easy-to-use and intuitive App helps new parents to stay organized in your daily activities with your baby using iCloud Sharing. Easily log an
bluejetty:00144195:ios.description:
With the lack of sleep and repeated routine, it's easy to forget when your baby is last fed. Our easy-to-use and intuitive App helps new parents to stay organized in your daily activities with your baby using iCloud Sharing. Easily log and review your baby’s feeding, sleep, development, diaper, growth, vaccine, health and more. Let the app deals with all the details so that you can focus on spending precious time with your newborn!
TRACKING
Adamo Baby Tracker makes it easy to record mummy's
* Pumping, and
* Breastmilk Inventory;
and your baby's
* Breastfeeding duration,
* Bottle-feeding duration and amount,
* Solid-feeding ingredients, duration and amount
* Diapers usage and possible health issues,
* Sleep duration,
* Playtime activities and duration,
* Growth (weight, length, head circumference),
* Temperature,
* Medication,
* Vaccine,
* Symptoms, and
* Diary to keep your beautiful memories.
From Release 2.3 onwards, the App supports sharing of data with other caregivers!
TIMELINE
All the activities log can be viewed on the timeline and can be easily filtered, retrieved and edited.
REMINDERS
Tired of calculating your baby’s next feeding or your next pumping time? Schedule reminders for activities easily at a specific time or by interval (in hours or days) with Adamo Baby Tracker.
STATISTIC CHARTS
The premium charts crunch the tracking data to provide you information on
* how often and how much your baby was fed,
* how often and how much breastmilk you have pumped,
* how often your baby pooped,
* how many diapers your baby consumed the last 7 or 28 days,
* how often and how long your baby slept,
* how often and how long your baby spent on the playtime activities,
* which of your baby’s development skills were stimulated, 
* your baby’s temperature pattern over one or 7 days, and
* whether your baby have a healthy growth rate compare against children of the same age on WHO’s International Growth Chart.
Download Adamo Baby Tracker today and let the App save you time!
What is ‘adamo’?
Adamo means ‘love passionately’ in latin. Adamo symbolizes pure love for children and aspires for children to grow up with love and the passion for life.

https://baby-tracker-adamo.com/adamo-app/TermsOfService.html
Privacy Policy:
https://baby-tracker-adamo.com/adamo-app/PrivacyPolicy.html

bluejetty:00184835:ios.description:
Screen mirroring - TV cast is a reliable and very easy to use screen casting or streaming tool to help mirror iPhone or iPad screen to your TVs in high quality or real time speed.
The application is perfect for
- Making presentation in a business meeting
- Cast photos & videos to your TVs
- Stream your favorite movies and apps on big TVs
- Cast youtube, Vimeo, facebook, dailymotion, ... & any web videos to TVs
Please notice that our screen mirroring app is not suitable for playing games on TV, because the normal delay time is from 5s to 6s. We are working hard to make it come true for gamers. We have Optimize Speed mode with 0s latency for TVs.
Features
- No need to install any app on TVs
- Mirror any application or games (for watching) wirelessly on your iPhone/iPad screen to TVs over your wifi network
- Streaming or casting photos, videos, music from your iPhone&iPad to TVs
- Cast youtube, Vimeo, facebook, dailymotion, ... & any web videos to TVs
- No cables, no additional hardware, nothing else needed
How to start mirroring?
- Connect your iPhone/iPad and your TV to the same wifi network
- Open the app and connect the app to your TV
- Allow your TV connect to your iPhone/iPad
- Open the app and click on Start Mirroring to start mirroring on your TV
- To stop mirroring click on top red bar of your iPhone
The app works best for iPhone 7 & above, iPad 3 & above, iOS 12 +.
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription
- The pricing are from $3.99 weekly with 3 days free trial, $11.99 monthly and $19.99 onetime lifetime
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
Privacy Policy: http://lqlstudio.com/index.php/privacy/
Terms of Use: http://lqlstudio.com/index.php/terms/

bluejetty:00136859:ios.description:
Lambus - Your all-in-one travel companion!
Conquer the world with ease and plan your next adventure with Lambus - the ultimate travel app that has everything you need for your trip! From trip planning to organizing your documents to managing expenses, we've got it all under control so you can focus on your adventure! Whether you're traveling solo or on a group adventure, Lambus is your reliable companion on every trip.
# Simply plan, experience more!
So much world, so little time! That's why we've made itinerary planning as easy as possible. Mark your destinations as stops and add interesting places effortlessly. Want to change something? No problem! Move or delete your stops in a snap. Planning your trip has never been so easy!
# Import itineraries made easy
Whether you're planning a bike tour, motorcycle tour or hiking adventure - with Lambus you can easily import .gpx files from popular manufacturers like Garmin and all participants of your trip will have instant access to the itineraries. Or you can simply create a new route directly in our route planner.
# Everything in one place - No more chaos in your documents
No more confusing lists and lost emails! With Lambus, you collect all your travel documents in one safe place. So you (and your travel companions) can access them at any time, even offline!
# Keep travel expenses under control
Lambus makes it easy to keep track of your travel expenses. You're on a group trip and want to split the expenses? No problem! We'll even do the math for you! Just fill in the form, calculate your debts and pay directly.
# Manage practical notes
Whether you want to share your Airbnb PIN code with the group, create a packing list, or just jot down your passport number, Lambus helps you manage notes easily and securely.
# Get inspired!
Still no idea where to go next? Browse through our Discover feature and get inspired by the many destinations. Whether it's an exciting road trip through the USA, a city break in a European metropolis or a relaxing beach vacation - you'll find it here. Every day we publish exciting trips with stops and travel tips!
# Book your tickets
With our transportation feature, you can not only plan routes between stops, but also easily deposit or book your transportation. Once you book your tickets, they are automatically added to your travel documents!
Visiting more than one place? Lambus is the ultimate travel app for backpackers, road trippers and world travelers! Plan your next adventure effortlessly with our innovative travel planner. What are you waiting for? Download Lambus and start your next adventure with us!

Nexar is not just any typical
bluejetty:00174836:ios.description:
Compatible dash cams: Nexar Classic is the operational app of Nexar's WiFi dash cams: Nexar Beam, Nexar Pro, and other compatible models. 
For nexarOne and beam2 LTE dash cams, look for the Nexar Connect app.
Nexar is not just any typical dash cam app. When paired with a Nexar dash cam and an active Nexar subscription, it transforms into your car's safety hub. Nexar automatically records in sync with your driving sessions. Videos are streamed to the app, and significant events, such as hard braking and accidents, are automatically detected using an advanced AI algorithm. These events are immediately saved to your phone and backed up to your private, unlimited cloud storage, allowing you to access evidence whenever needed.
Joining Nexar means becoming part of a community of drivers who prioritize safety. The Nexar app is constantly being enhanced, and we are dedicated to developing a service that not only improves your driving experience but also has the potential to save lives.
\---
FEATURES
Records as you drive
When paired to a compatible camera, Nexar starts recording automatically, whenever you start driving, and streams video to the app. The app works in the background, so you can use other apps while driving.
Detects dangerous incidents
Nexar uses AI algorithms and sensors to automatically capture dangerous incidents like hard brakes, sharp turns, and harsh accelerations.
Protects your car even when parked
Nexar senses impact and starts recording, even when your car is parked. Watch parking incidents when your phone connects to your dash cam.
Provides instant evidence
In case of an accident, the footage is automatically displayed on the Nexar app, and can also be accessed directly from the dash cam’s SD card.
Backs up to the cloud
All driving incidents and clips that you are creating are automatically uploaded to your private unlimited Nexar cloud account.
View & share your videos
After every drive, you'll be able to see its summary, including the route and any incident clips that were recorded. Share these clips and other data with friends, family, or your insurance provider, directly through the app.
\---
5 THINGS YOU SHOULD KNOW
Nexar saves what matters most. Your drives are saved to your phone based on available space. Dangerous incidents are automatically uploaded to your Nexar cloud, where they are never erased.
Nexar lets you control how much storage the app uses.
The dash cam connects to the app using its own WiFi signal. You'll still be able to use your data plan.
Nexar won't drain your data plan. The app uses data only after an incident was detected, to back up important evidence to your Nexar cloud account.
You own your data. We never share any individual's data unless they authorize it.
\---
24/7 SUPPORT
Need help? We're always here to assist. Reach us by email at support@getnexar.com or by in-app chat.
\---
KEEP YOUR PHONE CHARGED
Any app that uses GPS can deplete your phone battery faster, and Nexar is no different. That's why we recommend that you keep your phone charged while using Nexar - a charged phone is a happy phone!
\---
Nexar subscription
Full access to all features of the Nexar app is enabled with an active Nexar subscription.
Privacy: https://www.getnexar.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Backs up to the cloud

Nexar saves what matters most. Your drives are saved to your phone based on available space. Dangerous incidents are automatically uploaded to your Nexar cloud, where they are never erased.

The dash cam connects to the app using its own WiFi signal. You'll still be able to use your data plan.

Nexar won't drain your data plan. The app uses data only after an incident was detected, to back up important evidence to your Nexar cloud account.

You own your data. We never share any individual's data unless they authorize it.

24/7 SUPPORT

\---

KEEP YOUR PHONE CHARGED

Any app that uses GPS can deplete your phone battery faster, and Nexar is no different. That's why we recommend that you keep your phone charged while using Nexar - a charged phone is a happy phone!

bluejetty:00126300:android.description:
Have you ever dreamed of running your own business and making tons of money? Well, get ready to put on your boss hat and dive into the exciting world of Money Print Idle!
In this super fun mobile game, you get to be the boss of your very own money printing factory. You start out with a small factory, but as you make more money, you can upgrade your machines and hire more workers to help you print even more cash!
But here's the catch – this is an idle game, which means you don't have to play it all the time. In fact, you can even make money while you're not playing! That's right, you can build an Idle Bank and watch as your riches grow, even when you're taking a break from your phone to do homework.
And if you're feeling competitive, you can join in on the Boss Money feature and compete with other players around the world to see who can make the most money the fastest. It's like a race to become the ultimate money maker!
But that's not all – as you progress in the game, you can unlock new adventures and challenges that will test your skills as an adventure capitalist. With each challenge you overcome, you'll become a better and smarter money maker.
The game is easy to play and the graphics are bright and colorful, making it perfect for kids of all ages. And the best part is, it's free to play, so you can jump right in and start making money right away. If you enjoy My Little Universe, you will be ADDICTED to this money print idle game!
So what are you waiting for? It's time to get to work and become a money-making superstar in Money Print Idle!

bluejetty:00114625:ios.description:
Protect your online accounts with secure, standards-based two-factor authentication. Authenticator App – 2FA MFA generates time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) directly on your iPhone, giving you a reliable second step for sign-ins without depending on SMS codes.
Authenticator provides reliable security for both personal and work accounts. From email and social media to crypto platforms and business tools, the app helps keep your login information protected and easy to access. Commonly supported platforms include: Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter (X), LinkedIn, Amazon, Dropbox, PayPal, eBay, Snapchat, Pinterest, Reddit, Yahoo, Shopify, Slack, Zoom, Airbnb, Uber,... 
Access your authentication codes anytime, even without an internet connection. Codes are generated directly on your device, so weak signals or offline situations won’t block your sign-ins.
Key features
- Secure TOTP verification codes
Generate time-based one-time passwords that add a strong extra layer of protection to your accounts. These codes refresh automatically and work with most online services that support authenticator apps, helping keep your sign-ins secure.
- Fast and easy account setup
Add new accounts in just a few steps by scanning a QR code or entering a secret key manually. The setup process is simple and clear, so you can start using two-factor authentication right away.
- Full control over your 2FA accounts
Manage all your authentication entries in one place. You can edit account names, update secret keys, or remove entries anytime when accounts are no longer needed.
- App lock with Face ID, Touch ID, or PIN
Protect access to your authentication codes with biometric security or an app passcode. You can also enable auto-lock to automatically secure the app when you leave it or switch to another app.
- Built-in password storage
Store your website and app login details in a dedicated passwords section. Easily create, edit, copy, or delete credentials, giving you convenient access while keeping everything organized.
- Private in-app browser
Sign in to your accounts using the built-in browser designed for privacy. It does not save browsing history, logs, or cookies, helping reduce traces when accessing sensitive accounts.
- Clear settings and simple controls
Customize how the app works through clean and easy-to-understand settings. Manage security options and app behavior with full visibility, so you always know what features are active.
Subscription Information
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings.
• If a trial is offered, the full subscription price will be charged after the trial ends unless canceled in advance.

bluejetty:00185640:ios.description:
The easiest way to bring photos to life by animating, combining and blending unlimited layers. 
—————————————
IMAGINATION IS THE LIMIT
—————————————
То create motion in an image just paint the area you want in the direction you want it to move. To stop an animation just paint over it with the stop brush. It’s that simple. No anchors, no points, no arrows. 
Add layers from your photos or use the integrated Unsplash and Pixabay browsers. Turn every layer into an animated special effect with blending and masking. To tune the appearance to your liking you can adjust contrast, saturation, brightness and hue for each layer.
Export your animation as a seamless loop up to 20 seconds video or as a live wallpaper. At your disposal are predefined templates for Facebook and Instagram stories and posts.
The app contains premium features. You can test all of them for free as much as you want, but you won't be able to export your creation.
--------------------------

--------------------------
Projects
* Auto-save all animations in editable projects
Animate
* Animation and stop brush
* Brush size, strength and feather
* Animation speed

Adjust (p)
* Blending

* Opacity
* Contrast

* Saturation

bluejetty:00143618:ios.description:
Join the 2,000,000 people who already use the app and complete short missions with your smartphone in stores near you. Making money in your free time has never been easier!
We work with the largest brands (Coca Cola, Nestle, Heineken, Ferrero, Mattel, etc.): collect information on their products and receive an average of $5 for a 10-minute mission. Some mini jobs can earn you up to at $25!
HOW IT WORKS
√ Select a mission on the map or from the list of missions
√ Read the mission description and book it if you are interested
√ Go to the location and follow the instructions to complete that mission
√ Receive your pay in your bank account or Paypal account
Accumulate experience points: the higher your level, the more opportunities you will receive to book missions and earn cash
WHAT TYPES OF MISSION ARE THERE?
With BeMyEye, you can make money by doing different types of mini jobs:
▸ Check the presence of products, promotions, sales demonstrations, etc. in a shop: take some pictures and answer a few questions
▸ Play the role of mystery shopper: talk briefly with a salesman and answer a questionnaire
▸ Situate a specific place by placing a marker on the map
▸ Take a survey or quiz from home
Download the app to see all the mini jobs available around you!
PUBLICATION OF NEW MISSIONS
We recommend that you book the mini jobs that interest you as soon as they are published.
If there is no mission available near you, don’t hesitate to check back regularly on the application: new missions are published every day.
We also send you alerts to inform you of the latest published missions.
PAYMENT
No credits to unlock , the mini jobs you do allow you to earn real money directly: the payment is secure, receive your pay directly in your bank account or Paypal account 
TERMS OF USE
You must be at least 18 years old to do missions for BeMyEye
The app is completely free and no purchase is required after installation: download BeMyEye, register and start earning real money now.
SUPPORT
Our operations teams are available every day to help you accomplish your missions and make easy money. In case of problems or to submit suggestions and ideas, send us a message directly via the in-app chat, email us at support.uk@bemyeye.com or visit our Facebook and Twitter pages.
Want to find easy and fast side jobs to make money in your free time? Download the BeMyEye app today and discover the missions available around you. 
With BeMyEye, you can earn money with polls or questionnaires, by taking some photos in a store, by playing the role of mystery shopper, etc.: simple mini jobs you can do with your smartphone.

bluejetty:00120165:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120165:ios.description:
Authentic Hadith Collection - Sahih Bukhari, Muslim & More
Immerse yourself in the profound wisdom of our beloved Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W) with this comprehensive Islamic library app. Access thousands of authentic Hadith from a collection of four revered books, all in one place. Designed for the modern Muslim, this app brings the timeless sayings of the Prophet to your fingertips, helping you connect with the Sunnah daily.
COLLECTION OF AUTHENTIC BOOKS:
- Sahih Bukhari
Generally regarded as the most authentic book of Hadith after the Quran. Imam Bukhari spent 16 years compiling it, covering all aspects of life to guide the Ummah.
- Sahih Muslim
Compiled by Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj, this collection is known for its stringent acceptance criteria. It features approximately 4,000 authentic Hadith distilled from 300,000 narrations.
- Sunan Abi Daawud
A critical collection focusing on legal rulings. Abu Dawuud spent 20 years gathering 500,000 narrations, selecting only the most authentic for inclusion.
- Al Muwatta
Compiled by Imam Malik ibn Anas over forty years, this is a complete record of the legal and social parameters of the original Muslim community, featuring only the most verified narrations.
KEY FEATURES:
► Daily Hadith
Start your day with inspiration. The app selects a unique Hadith of the day for you to read and reflect upon.
► Bookmarks
Save your favorite or relevant Hadith for quick access later. Build your own personal collection of wisdom.
► Elegant Themes
Choose from beautiful themes to make your reading experience comfortable and visually pleasing.
► Easy Navigation & Fast Scrolling
Find specific Hadith quickly with fast scrolling and easy topic categorization.

bluejetty:00130404:ios.description:
Car Company Tycoon is a unique economic simulation game about car manufacturing. The game spans the era from the 1970s to the present day. Design the car of your dreams, create engines from scratch, and conquer the global market. Can you become an automotive tycoon?
Build the Perfect Engine:
Construct a powerful V12 or an efficient 4-cylinder engine. Adjust piston diameter and stroke, experiment with turbochargers, camshafts, cooling systems, and exhausts. Choose engine materials, connecting rods, and other components. With over a hundred customization options, you can create your perfect engine!
Design Your Dream Cars:
Premium sedans, sports coupes, SUVs, wagons, pickups, convertibles, or family hatchbacks — dozens of body types with advanced editing options are waiting for your creativity. Create unique designs, enhance interior quality, and meet customer needs in the market.
Rise from a Startup to an Industry Leader:Begin your journey in the 1970s, explore cutting-edge technologies, gain reviews from auto critics, and compete with other manufacturers. Develop winning strategies, navigate global crises, participate in ecological initiatives, and respond to market challenges.
Historical Mode:
Immerse yourself in narrative historical events reflecting real moments in the automotive industry. Stay updated on in-game news that influences market demand and customer preferences. Your actions will shape the legacy you leave in automotive history.
Become an Automotive Tycoon:
Manage your company, conduct recall campaigns, negotiate important contracts, and enhance your company’s reputation. Participate in races, hire staff, and overcome unexpected challenges. Random events will test your management skills, and every decision you make will determine your company’s destiny.
Your Goal — Become a Global Market Leader!
Create iconic cars that win the hearts of millions and become a symbol of success in the automotive world. Download the game for free and start your journey to success today.See you in Car Company Tycoon!

"Spider Solitaire is one kind of classic solitaire card game. Spider Solitaire allows you to customize your experience with various Spider Solitaire themes, and challenges you with interesting Spider Solitaire levels. Spider Solitaire is so interesting that I bet you will say loudly, ""Fantastic!"" when you are playing this Spider Solitaire card game. If you like classic card games like Klondike Solitaire, TriPeak Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, Spades, and Hearts, then this Spider Solitaire is really for you!
This Spider Solitaire is not rigid. You can choose your favorite backgrounds, card faces, card backs, and even the victory animations after you win a game. There are 100+ backgrounds and card backs in this Spider Solitaire.
Spider Solitaire has daily challenges waiting for you. When you complete daily challenges for several days, you will get a gift box; when you complete daily challenges for a month, you will get a trophy. Daily challenges make Spider Solitaire more interesting. You can play 1 Suit at the beginning, and if you want to challenge yourself or try your luck, you can play 2 Suit and 4 Suit.
Spider Solitaire has other gameplay features around the card games, such as sea adventure pass, solitaire puzzles, home design, collecting stars to unlock more themes, and more.
Spider Solitaire welcomes you! Play this Spider Solitaire card game now! It is more than you can imagine!

bluejetty:00084327:ios.description:
YOUR PROGRAM. YOUR COACH. YOUR PEOPLE.
Your Pridefit coach builds a personal training program around you: your goals, your experience, your equipment, even that shoulder you’ve been babying since 2019.
PERSONAL PROGRAMS
No two members get the same plan. Home or gym, beginner or advanced, it’s built for you and meets you where you’re at. After you finish your first 6-week program, you’ll work with your coach to continue progressing and building the best programs possible. Together. 
1-1 COACHING
Unlimited chat and video messages with your coach. Stuck on form? Send a video and get real feedback from someone you trust. Need to adjust your plan? Just ask. Your coach checks in, answers your questions, and keeps you accountable.
You’ll also join a group onboarding call with Sam, Pridefit’s founder, to set your goals and build your game plan.
EVERYTHING ELSE YOU GET
-A huge on-demand workout library: muscle building, HIIT, bodyweight, cardio, and recovery
-Video demonstrations and easy substitutions for every exercise
-Habit tracker for sleep, nutrition, and mindset
-Recipes that add to your life instead of restricting it
-Exercise logs, calendar, and achievements to track your progress
-Apple Health compatibility
-24/7 access to the world’s largest LGBTQIA+ fitness community
New workouts and recipes drop weekly!
WHY A GAY FITNESS APP?
Because starting is easier in a room where you already belong. Our coaches are gay, our community is gay, so there’s no need to “come out” here. Sometimes all it takes to build a sustainable fitness routine is an environment where you feel safe & supported. We’ve got you covered.
WHAT MEMBERS SAY
Members tell us the same story: they’d tried everything, they were intimidated, and this is the one that finally stuck because they’re not just a number in a massive fitness app. They’re part of a tight-knit community of LGBTQ+ people who are all working to get healthier.
Start with a 7-day free trial.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Account settings. bluejetty:00022431:ios.description:
Count down to your next event — a vacation, your favorite band's concert, a movie premiere, a graduation, an anniversary, and more — in style!
Features:
LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS: Add countdown widgets to your lock screen! First, set up your countdown in the Countdown app. Then, pull down your lock screen, long-hold an empty area and tap "Customize."
FLEXIBLE UNITS: Years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, and even heartbeats! (e.g. "3 months 14 mins" or "56,713 heartbeats")
DRAG the Countdown and DISPLAY it wherever you want.
Use YOUR OWN PHOTOS as the background, including INSTAGRAM and FACEBOOK PHOTOS! Or browse a large selection of FREE BACKGROUND PHOTOS.
Flip through your background photos while counting down.
Set your own MUSIC for each Countdown.
Customizable FONTS, font colors, and background colors.
Add YOUR OWN PHRASE — "the concert of the year," "little pumpkin's dance performance," "we board the plane."
Create Countdowns straight from your CALENDAR EVENTS.
MULTIPLE Countdowns — rearrange them however you like.
REMINDERS for your events.
SHARE a live Countdown or a screenshot via Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, or email.
Count down to ANNIVERSARIES that repeat every year. (e.g. "25 days until my 10th anniversary!")
COUNT UP from past events. (e.g. "21 days since…")
SMART TOOLBAR stays hidden until you tap the screen — more room for your Countdowns.
Works in PORTRAIT and LANDSCAPE mode.
=== Countdown Premium ===
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS: Count the days to your event without ever opening the app.
SLIDESHOW MODE: Automatically cycle your background photos with a choice of animation styles and speeds.
NO ADS: No distractions or clutter — just you and your countdown.
Make each second count!
In addition to the free features above, Countdown Premium is available as a subscription. Premium subscribers get an ad-free experience, home screen widgets, and slideshow mode.
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions are charged to your payment method through your Apple ID account and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription anytime in Account Settings.

Get ready to move weapons and create your own Battle-Royal Weapon Collection! Download Idle Royale Tycoon - Incremental Merge Battle Game, one of the best Merge based sliding block puzzle game available on AppStore.
Do you love to play a 4 x 4 puzzle game but tired of math and numbers? Are you looking for an Battle-Royal puzzle game for your iOS device? Search no further! Idle Royale Tycoon - Incremental Merge Battle Game place for you to play and compete with your friends. 
“Weapon Merge” is a unique concept of weapon building based on the classic Match 2 3 game-play. Rather than planning, you drag and drop the weapon tiles to merge Rocket Launcher, Ak47, V-coins and epic gliders in order to create larger inventory and increase the population of your Battle-Royal Idle Merge Game. The objective of this puzzle game is to build a Weapon Inventory as large as possible and unlock many different Weapons and secret Skins and Rarity.

 -Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 -Transfer money between your accounts

 -Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 -View and save your monthly statements
 -Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Enterprise Bank Pittsburgh app, you must be enrolled as an Enterprise Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00137159:ios.description:
Choose the mightiest one from the 7 shooter characters, become your favorite hero. Navigate the correct path, rescue the hostages, accomplish the mission.
Embark on a heart-pounding journey of covert operations in "Sniper Destiny: Lone Wolf," a gripping first-person shooter that takes precision shooting and tactical strategy to the next level. Immerse yourself in the role of an elite sniper, armed with only your trusty rifle, as you navigate through intense scenarios and engage in adrenaline-pumping sniper missions.
In "Sniper Destiny: Lone Wolf," your mission is clear: save hostages, eliminate high-profile targets, and become the ultimate stealth assassin. Armed with a variety of sniper rifles, including high-powered long-range weapons, you must showcase your marksmanship skills to execute flawless shots. The game's realistic graphics bring each mission to life, creating an immersive environment where every decision matters.
As a sniper, adaptability is key. Explore diverse environments, from sprawling cities to enemy hideouts, each presenting its own set of challenges. Utilize the surroundings to your advantage, carefully selecting vantage points and remaining undetected. The dynamic nature of the game keeps you on your toes, requiring strategic thinking and precision in every move.
"Sniper Destiny: Lone Wolf" offers a unique blend of strategy and action, with challenging missions that demand careful planning and execution. Your arsenal includes cutting-edge weapons and gadgets designed for covert operations. Choose the right tools for each assignment and prove your mettle as a versatile sniper.
This game stands out with its emphasis on realistic gameplay, where your skills are put to the test in various mission scenarios. From rooftop sniping to long-distance precision shots, every mission presents a new challenge. "Sniper Destiny: Lone Wolf" delivers an unparalleled sniper experience, allowing you to dominate the battlefield, rescue hostages, and establish yourself as the ultimate sniper in this gripping FPS adventure.
Download "Sniper Destiny: Lone Wolf" now to experience the excitement and adrenaline of being a lone wolf sniper. Can you handle the pressure, make the perfect shot, and emerge victorious in this intense sniper showdown? It's time to prove your skills in the world of covert operations and become the stealth & silent hunter the mission demands.

You can cancel the subscription at any time in your Account Settings.

bluejetty:00128135:ios.description:
Space Simulator is the best space simulator already created for iOS devices!
We focus our efforts and development team on bringing the best set of commands to our spaceship! So, the experience of flying on the infinity space is very accurate!
The game simulates the spaceship, it's engines, moving parts and all planets from our solar system!!
Become an astronaut! And explore the space at your will!
Features
- Realtime Earth rotation.
- You can watch the night becoming day, and day becoming night in different places of the planet!
- All planets from solar system.
- Realistic sun
- Asteroids ring.
- All planet moons!
Some technology provided by Nasa:
- Realist terrain using Nasa’s photos and elevation.
- Realist texture for all planets from Nasa’s photos.
- Using Nasa’s utility FoilSim 3 to calculate the physics of the spaceship (really realistic). 
- Using real airfoils from our library, the engines, rockets and trusters are very accurate.
Real world simulation:
- Weather forecast.
- Turbulence and G-Force
- Real clouds
We are thinking about everything we can do to improve the space simulator experience! So please, feel free to contact us to give your feedback!
Have a good trip astronaut!

bluejetty:00066338:ios.description:
Upgrade your logic and relax your mind with Sudoku - Brain Puzzle Games – the ultimate number puzzle game trusted by millions worldwide.
With over 5,000 handcrafted Sudoku puzzles across multiple difficulty levels, this game is perfect for your daily brain training, whether you're a beginner or an expert. Play at your own pace, online or offline, and enjoy a smart, smooth, and stress-free experience.
Key Features
- 5,000+ Classic Sudoku Puzzles
Enjoy endless logic challenges with new puzzles updated weekly.
- Four Difficulty Levels
Easy, medium, hard, and expert – ideal for new players and seasoned solvers alike.
- Daily Challenges and Rewards
Stay motivated with fresh daily puzzles and unlock trophies as you progress.
- Smart Hints and Pencil Notes
Use hint tools and take notes to develop your solving strategies.
- Undo/Redo, Auto-Save, and Fast Fill
Play without pressure. Make corrections, pause at any time, and continue exactly where you left off.
- Customizable Themes and Dark Mode
Choose game themes based on your mood and gameplay environment.
- Duplicate Number Highlighting
Avoid mistakes with automatic detection of repeated digits in rows, columns, and boxes.
- Full Offline Support
Play Sudoku anytime, anywhere. No internet connection needed.
- Ad-Free Game Environment
Play without interruptions or data tracking.
Advanced Game Modes and Features
Have you tried Killer Sudoku or Letter Sudoku? Explore new puzzle types with unique logic patterns to challenge even experienced minds. Join global leaderboards and unlock limited-time seasonal themes to personalize your experience.

- Boost focus, memory, and logical thinking
- Suitable for all ages – kids, adults, and seniors

- 100% privacy friendly and secure – no login required

Download Sudoku now to challenge your brain, unwind after a busy day, or fuel your puzzle-solving passion. Whether you're on a commute, relaxing at home, or just looking for a quick mental workout – Sudoku Free is the perfect companion.

bluejetty:00129984:ios.description:
Calorie counting is as easy as 1-2-3.
Get the most out of your diet with this easy-to-use app that allows you to keep track of your daily calories, nutrients, and meals.
Our calorie counter and water tracker app that gives you access to all your nutrition data, so you can make healthier lifestyle choices.
Cut fat, build muscle, maximize health. Lose weight and get fit with this super-easy app that tracks your food. Simple, fast, powerful!
Calorie counters and macro trackers both work to help you lose weight, but macro trackers are more effective. A macro tracker is a next generation food tracker that focuses on macros, not only calories. The Food & Macro Tracker By lilbite is a free app that makes tracking your food easy, and helps you reach your fitness goals.
The Food & Macro Tracker App by lilbite has been designed to help anyone understand what a calorie is, much less a gram of carbohydrate. For those who are health-novices, the idea of using a macro tracker can be overwhelming. Many barely understand what a calorie is, much less a gram of carbohydrate. With the Food & Macro Tracker App, that has changed.
 The underlying reason any diet works is because of energy balance. Food faddism comes and goes, but calorie trackers have been around since the beginning of time, because they are the reason any diet can or does work. Calories consumed and calories expended determine an energy surplus leading to weight gain and fat gain, or an energy deficit leading to weight loss and fat loss. This is why calorie counters are so popular. They help people reach their fitness goals.
 Macronutrients are the nutrients that create any calories from the foods we eat. Without macros, no calories will be made. Macros serve different purposes in the body. For example, protein builds and repairs muscle tissue, and fat helps store energy. A balance of macros ensures optimal weight loss and health improvements.
Great Lilbite features :- 
Use the Daily Calorie Calculator to find out how many calories you need per day to reach your target weight.
•Choose your goal, lose weight, maintain it or gain muscle mass.
• Nutritional information of thousands of foods.
• Calculate your caloric needs.
• Calculate all your macronutrients.
• Create Custom Foods (Premium)
• Water Tracker - track your daily water intake needs (Premium)
• Set Custom Calorie Intake (Premium)
• Set Custom Water Intake (Premium)
• Set Custom Diet (Premium)
• Custom Reminders / Notifications to keep you on track (Premium)
• Dark Mode!
• NO registration or sign up required! 
Powered by fatsecret Platform API
INTEGRATION WITH THE HEALTH APP
• Write nutrition data to the Health app - calories, carbs, protein, fat.
Terms & Conditions: https://www.lilbite.app/tos
Privacy policy: https://www.lilbite.app/privacy
---------------------------------------
Optional auto-renewing Premium Subscription is available (price varies by territory, includes free trial) located on the Upgrade page. Payments will be charged to your iTunes Account after confirmation. Subscription automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed in your iTunes Account’s Settings after purchasing. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
NOTE: Lilbite is not a medical app. Suggested calorie intake is just an estimate based on your profile. Please consult your health provider if you want to use it for medical purposes or to obtain specific diet needs.
