bluejetty:00096263:ios.name: Sand Block Color Escape Puzzle
bluejetty:00096263:ios.summary:
Sand Block Color: A Fun & Relaxing Puzzle Game
Escape the noise of the everyday and step into a world of serene focus. Sand Block Color is more than just a game—it's a tranquil sanctuary for your mind, a place where logic and artistry flow
bluejetty:00096263:ios.description:
Sand Block Color: A Fun & Relaxing Puzzle Game
Escape the noise of the everyday and step into a world of serene focus. Sand Block Color is more than just a game—it's a tranquil sanctuary for your mind, a place where logic and artistry flow together in perfect harmony. We’ve designed this experience for thinkers, dreamers, and anyone seeking a delightful mental challenge that calms the spirit as it sharpens the mind.
Imagine a puzzle where the pieces don't just fit; they transform. Tired of the same rigid blocks? Prepare to be mesmerized as each shape you place gracefully dissolves into vibrant, flowing sand. This is your personal escape into a universe of intelligent strategy, deeply satisfying visuals, and the simple, profound joy of solving a truly clever puzzle.
A TRULY FRESH & DYNAMIC PUZZLE EXPERIENCE
Experience a revolution in puzzle mechanics. Unlike traditional games built on static grids, Sand Block Color introduces a groundbreaking fluid dynamic system that feels both magical and real. This creates an ever-changing puzzle board that is organic and alive, where every move you make has a tangible, cascading effect.
The sensory details are crafted to transport you. The gentle whisper of settling sand, the satisfying chime of a cleared line, and the ASMR-like visual effects combine to turn every session into a moment of pure relaxation. It is a unique and elegant fusion of a challenging logic game and a beautiful, interactive piece of art.
DISCOVER THE FEATURES
INCREDIBLY SATISFYING SAND PHYSICS
We’ve poured our hearts into creating a fluid simulation that is both beautiful and believable. Watch with delight as streams of different colors interact, stack, and fill the lines with stunningly smooth animations. The subtle blend of colors where they meet and the gentle cascade as lines are cleared make every action a rewarding visual treat. It’s a mechanic you can not only see, but truly feel.
A POWERFUL BOOST FOR YOUR BRAINPOWER
This is more than just a pastime; it's a comprehensive and enjoyable brain exercise. Each level is a meticulously crafted logic puzzle designed to challenge your cognitive skills in new ways. Sharpen your spatial reasoning as you visualize the flow of sand. Enhance your forward-thinking and problem-solving abilities by planning several moves ahead. Regular play is a delightful way to improve focus, memory, and mental agility.
HOW TO PLAY & MASTER THE FLOW
Drag & Drop: Intuitively place the upcoming puzzle pieces onto the grid.
Watch the Flow: Observe as they dissolve into beautiful streams of flowing sand.
Match & Clear: Strategically position your pieces to create solid lines of matching colors.
Plan Ahead: Think like a grandmaster! Anticipate how the sand will settle and plan your moves to set up powerful, board-clearing combos.
Build Streaks: Keep clearing lines consecutively to activate a score multiplier for massive bonus points!
THE PERFECT FIT FOR YOUR DAY
Sand Escape is designed to fit seamlessly into your life. Whether you have five minutes to spare while waiting in line or a whole evening to dedicate to deep, immersive puzzle-solving, the game adapts to your schedule. It’s an experience that is both instantly accessible for beginners and deeply rewarding for puzzle veterans, making it a wonderful game for all ages.
Are you ready for a smarter, more beautiful, and deeply relaxing challenge? Join thousands of players who have found their new favorite way to relax and train their brain.
Privacy Policy: https://longsealink.com/privacy.html
Terms of Services: https://longsealink.com/useragreement.html

bluejetty:00031298:ios.description:
The MyGabb app is designed to help parents protect and stay connected with their kids as they explore the world with Gabb devices. With intuitive parental controls, GPS location and easy device management, MyGabb gives you the tools to support your child’s safety and growing independence.
Quickly view your child’s location, set up customizable Safe Zones with alerts, and manage who they can contact—all from one simple app. Whether you’re managing one device or several, MyGabb makes it easy to stay informed and in control.
Key Features:
Location tracking and history
Customizable Safe Zones with alerts
Intuitive Parental Controls
Easy device pairing and management
Parent-approved contacts
Designed exclusively for Gabb devices
Learn more about Gabb:
Gabb provides safe tech made specifically to protect kids, connect families, and empower parents. Gabb devices—Gabb Watch3 Gabb Phone 4 Pro, Gabb Phone 4, Gabb Phone 3 Pro—were all created with kids’ safety as the top priority and provide safe “tech in steps” options for kids 5-18.
All Gabb devices come with unlimited talk and text with no access to social media, internet, or unsafe apps. Parents can stay safely connected with their kids through GPS tracking, safe messaging, geofenced safe zones with alerts when a child’s device enters or leaves specified locations, and more. Gabb’s growing list of safe apps, like Gabb Music and Gabb Messenger, give kids more ways to learn the benefits of technology without all the dangers.

bluejetty:00200080:ios.summary:
AGAIN. is the rehearsal app that remembers why the band stopped — and, new in Version 2, who said what in a writing session or a table read.

bluejetty:00200080:ios.description:
AGAIN. is the rehearsal app that remembers why the band stopped — and, new in Version 2, who said what in a writing session or a table read.
EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
No account. No ads. No servers. Your recordings, the words and the notes never leave your iPhone. Listening, telling voices apart and writing the notes all happen on the device.
You run the tune. Somebody stops it. "Bass, you're early on the bridge — verse two is four bars, not eight." Everyone nods. Next week nobody remembers. AGAIN. does.
PICK THE MODE
Band rehearsal, Writing session or Table read: one dropdown on the record screen. An imported recording asks the same.
BAND REHEARSAL: IT FINDS EVERY STOP
Put the phone where it can hear the room, tap Record and play. On-device sound analysis tells music from talking. Each time the band stops to talk, that stop becomes a rehearsal letter — A, B, C — like the boxed letters in a score. It keeps going with the screen off, as long as the rehearsal runs.
WRITING SESSIONS AND TABLE READS: SORTED BY VOICE
No instruments stopping? AGAIN. tells the voices in the room apart. Hear a few seconds of each, give it a name, and AGAIN. knows that voice the next time. Mark who leads the room — the director, the lead writer — and every time they speak up becomes a stop. Tap Mark a stop now whenever you like; long pauses and music that stops count too. Every line plays back, in the voice's own colour.
IT WRITES THE NOTES
What was said is transcribed on your iPhone and turned into short notes: who it's for, which song, what kind of fix. A band gets tempo, entrance, ending, arrangement, dynamics, sound, pitch and lyrics. A table read gets line, delivery, pacing, blocking, cue and character — from the director's words, not the reading. A writing session gets lyric, melody, chords, structure, groove and hook. Each note says who said it. Wrong? Edit any note, or write your own.
▶ THE 15 SECONDS BEFORE
Every stop and every note has a play button that plays the music right before the band stopped. No scrubbing. Everyone hears the spot.
MORE THAN ONE BAND, MORE THAN ONE SETLIST
Play in a band, a choir and a trio? Tap the band's name to switch. Each band keeps its own players, setlists, rehearsals, notes and named voices. Give a band as many setlists as it needs (Sunday service, the wedding, the club set) and pick one before you record: its songs are the ones you tap while you play.
BY SONG, BY PLAYER, BY WORD
Songs: every note on each tune, across rehearsals. Players: each musician's list, ready to send. Search: notes and full transcripts.
SEND THE NOTES
Share a whole rehearsal's notes, or one stop's, to a text, an email or the group chat. Each musician's list has its own Send.
AGAIN. records other people's voices. Always tell the room you're recording and follow the recording laws where you play.

bluejetty:00131984:ios.description:
Are you a parent looking for a new baby cam? Don’t want to spend your money on a Motorola or other expensive standalone devices? The Baby Monitor is a cheap but reliable baby monitoring app helping parents watch their baby easily and in every moment they can’t be with them. 
Thanks to this new baby monitoring app, you can change your old phone into one of the two needed devices and take care of your sleeping baby more effectively than ever before.
Let’s summarize the facts:
(1) Thanks to Baby Monitor, you can turn your old mobile phone device into a Child Unit and your new mobile into the guarding Parent Unit. Watch your baby from an unlimited number of Parent Units and share the joy with all your loved ones.
(2) Connecting the devices only takes a few seconds. Setting it up is really easy!
(3) You can watch your baby anywhere. Baby Monitor works via WiFi as well as via 3G, 4G, and LTE.
(4) Thanks to inbounded subscriptions, you can strengthen the connection between the devices and relay sound, pictures or play lullabies via special cloud connection.
(5) You can choose a time period of a month, three months, six months or a twelve-month auto-renewable subscription. It’s up to you how long you need to use our baby monitor. 
(6) The app is highly noise-sensitive. Don’t worry about letting your baby in the cot and going to the kitchen or bathroom. Your mobile alerts you when your baby is awake.
(7) Do you keep forgetting about the battery status of the Child Unit? Don’t worry. Baby Monitor keeps tabs on the battery status and alerts you when the battery is running low. 
Baby Monitor is a must for parents looking for a cheap alternative to the classic standalone monitors. Download the app and monitor your baby up to a week for free with subscription trial.
__
We offer weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly subscriptions. 
All subscriptions are auto-renewable. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours before the end of the current period. All subscriptions can be managed by the user in Account Settings. 
Terms of Use: https://www.anniebabymonitor.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.anniebabymonitor.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00159762:ios.description:
Crowd Sort is a fun and challenging puzzle game! Try to sort the colored guys in the tubes until all colors are in the same color tubes? it's like a water sort puzzle. Be satisfied and entertained as you see the swarm of the crowd moves quickly to their color tubes.
FEATURES:
- One tap color sorting control
- Unlimited undo
- Extremely smooth puzzle gameplay. No need to wait for the crowd to finish moving, you can queue up multiple moves with that big brain.
- Night Mode. You can enable/disable it from the settings panel
- A lot of unique sorting levels
- Easy to play, difficult to master
- No time limit puzzle game, just enjoy the game and play sorting puzzle as long as you want
HOW TO PLAY:
- To begin sorting - Tap any lane to move the crowd to another color tubes,
- The rule is that people only move to the other lane if it is empty or they can see the same colored crowd runners at the end of the new lane.
- If you get stuck or misclick while sorting, you can always undo your move or restart the puzzle game level!
- Enjoy and watch the hordes of tiny people collide and interact as they flow like water color sorted from one lane to the next color tubes.
Crowd Sort is a really fun and challenging brainteaser. Download sorter brain teaser game! Sort it now!

bluejetty:00016136:ios.description:
Card Crawl is a solitaire-style dungeon crawler game played with a modified deck of standard cards.
Pocket Tactics – Card game of the year 2015
Pocket Tactics – Reader’s choice game of the year 2015
Pocket Tactics – Editor’s choice game of the year 2015
German Games Award – Nominee for best game design 2016
Clear the dungeon of 54 cards by using item-cards, slaying monsters and managing your limited inventory. On each run, you can use five ability-cards (mini deck building) to gain unique skills. By collecting gold, you can unlock 35 more ability-cards to access new tactics and even higher scores.
Card Crawl’s four single-player game modes are enhanced by Game Center to let players compare their scores and the associated decks. A typical game lasts two or three minutes and is a perfect “one more game” experience while waiting in line or commuting.
FEATURES
• Solitaire-style gameplay
• Four game modes (normal, constructed, daily & delve)
• Dungeon deck editor for building and sharing custom dungeon decks
• 35 unlockable ability-cards
• Mini deck building
• Game Center integration
– To compare high scores and decks
– To challenge your friends
– To access tricky new achievements
• Two to three minutes of playtime per game
ACCOLADES
"A brilliant distillation of the dungeon crawler, Card Crawl is well worth a look." — Pocketgamer
"Card Crawl is an enjoyable, casual card game that feels a touch like Diablo-Meets-Solitaire." — 148Apps
"There’s something about a solitaire card game that really does it for me, and Card Crawl is one of the best I’ve played."
— Pockettactics
"It's got great art, gameplay with cards that isn't like other card-based dungeon crawlers and is perfect for sitting back and relaxing while playing it." — Toucharcade
"Taken purely as a variation on Solitaire, Card Crawl is clever as heck, with a standout style and simple yet rewarding gameplay." — JayIsGames
"It’s a unique and interesting hybrid that plays out very well. If you love dungeon crawlers and card games like Hearthstone, then this is a no-brainer." — AppAdvice
"The most intriguing thing about Card Crawl is its simplicity."
— MACNN
"Card Crawl is an impressively solid card game that borrows what works from other games and spins it into its own, unique, game." — Gamezebo
"Card Crawl is really creative and unique game, in which strategy and luck is equally needed." — iPlayApps
"Card Crawl is a very polished card game with a high addiction factor." — AppGemeinde
"Card Crawl is easily suited for anybody who loves casual short game." - ModernJamming
Learn More about Tinytouchtales & Card Crawl at www.cardcrawl.com

bluejetty:00027047:ios.description:
While the rich stinks of meat and wine, the bones of the poor litter the roadside.
Great injustice often leads to strange occurrences
Snow in July can only be remedied through blood.
Warm Snow is a Roguelike action game with a background set in a dark fantasy world, where the eerie 'Warm Snow' holds sway. You will play as the Warrior 'Bi-an' on a crusade against the Five Great Clans, in order to save a world teetering on the brink of destruction.
【A Dark Tale of Sword and Snow】
A strange phenomenon appeared during the 27th Year of the Longwu Era. Snow fell from the sky, which was warm rather than cold to the touch, and did not melt.
People who breathed in the 'Warm Snow' lost their minds and became monsters. This phenomenon was later known as 'Warm Snow'.
Embark on a journey as Warrior 'Bi-an' to search for the truth behind the 'Warm Snow' and put an end to the this never-ending darkness.
【Countless Combinations】
Seven sects, varied Relics, unpredictable excaliburs, the game is full of Rogue-like elements which will keep each challenge in your journey fresh and unique.
Each time you venture into the world would be a whole-new experience, pick your favorite playing style and challenge yourself.
【Thrilling Flying Sword System】
Perform critical destruction with swords that flicker between shadow and light. Control your flying swords with different attributes, attack modes and Relic boosts.
【Reincarnate and Collect the Fragments of Truth】
You decide how you will grow stronger!
Boost your abilities with talent points that you can assign at will.
The truth about this world is hidden in the randomly dropped 'Memory Fragments'.
Are you ready to discover the secrets behind the Five Great Clans and reveal the truth of this world?
【Mobile Version Optimizations】
· Button customization and Auto-Dash: Adjust the position and size of buttons according to your preferences. Enable the Auto-Dash feature to start auto dashing with the left joystick.
· Adjust the viewing distance freely: Adjust the size of the screen display according to your preferences.
· Auto Enemy Tracking: Enable the Auto Enemy Tracking feature for a silky smooth combat experience.
Minimum device requirement: iOS 12.0 or higher. Memory requirement: 4GB. Available RAM: 4GB
SUPPORT
If you encounter any issues during the game, you can send us feedback via the in-game Customer Service Center.
Customer Service Email: warmsnowgh@bilibili.com
Official Site: https://warmsnow.biligames.com
Twitter：https://twitter.com/WarmSnowGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/gC2nRfEQ
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@warmsnow6951

bluejetty:00032127:android.description:
Embark on a spiritual journey with our FREE and easy-to-use app, featuring the soulful recitation of the Holy Quran by Sheikh Abdelbasset Abdessamad. This user-friendly app is designed for seamless navigation, allowing you to immerse yourself in the divine wisdom of the Quran at your convenience and without the need for an internet connection.
🌟 Key Features 🌟
✅ Offline Listening : Access the entire Quran offline. Enjoy Sheikh Fares Abbad recitations without needing an internet connection, ensuring your spiritual journey is uninterrupted. 
✅ HD Quality Audio : Enjoy the highest quality MP3 audio that brings each verse of the Quran to life with clarity and precision. 
✅ Listen and Read Simultaneously : Experience a multi-sensory engagement with the Quran. Listen to Sheikh Abdelbasset Abdessamad’s recitation while reading the Arabic text or translation, enhancing understanding and retention. 
✅ Advanced Search Functionality : Quickly locate specific verses or surahs with a few taps, making your Quran study more focused and efficient. 
✅ Shuffle Play : Mix up your daily Quran listening with our shuffle feature, which randomly plays different surahs, offering a refreshing way to engage with the Quran. 
✅ Background Play : Our app ensures that the recitation continues even when you use other apps or lock your screen, perfect for continuous listening without interruption. 
✅ Bookmarking & Highlights : Mark your favorite verses for easy access and highlight sections for deeper study and reflection.
Our app is designed to be straightforward and accessible for everyone, from beginners to those who regularly recite the Quran. 
Share the beauty of Sheikh Abdelbasset Abdessamad’s recitation with friends and family, and don't forget to rate and review us on the store. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve and expand our offerings.
✅Explore More on Our Developer Page : Delve deeper into the Quran with other renowned reciters like Maher Al Muaqly and Abdelbaset Abdessamad available on our developer page. Expand your recitation library and enrich your spiritual practice with diverse and revered voices.
Download now and immerse yourself in the soothing recitation of the Quran, available anytime, right at your fingertips !

bluejetty:00063772:ios.description:
Pampering yourself is in the agenda! Getting your nails done is a hobby of yours? Well, take it to the next level with our new game My Nail Makeover and become a great nail artist!
Nail Art isn’t called an “art” for nothing! With My Nail Makeover you will be able to become a great nail designer, carrying out every step of a perfect manicure in your own beauty salon!
First you’ll need to wash your client’s hands to clean away any dirt, and then you 
apply the moisturizer to get rid of calluses or rough patches on the skin. You’ll leave their hands silky smooth like a true beautician! 
The next step is to apply a sponge with nail polish remover to erase the old, chipped nail polish. Now you’re ready to work your magic as a true nail artist with all the tools at your disposal! Click on the plier and the nail file to shape your nails - you can get a more vampy pointy shape or a cute rounded one - there are 8 shapes to choose from! You are also able to choose skin tones, rings and bracelets!
Then comes the most important part! You can actually paint and decorate the nails however you want! Choose from a multitude of shades of nail polish and different kinds of top coats that give beautiful effects to your art! Finally, you can add some bling to your work adding beautiful rhinestones and beads! 
HIGHLIGHTS
• BECOME a great nail artist!
• PAINT your nails with a myriad of SHADES of nail polish!
• SHAPE your nails - There are 8 shapes to choose from!
• CHOOSE different kinds of top coats with beautiful effects
• ADD rhinestones and beads
Download our game now and show off your “handwork”!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00063430:ios.name: Ghost Hunting Tools - Detector
bluejetty:00063430:ios.summary:
The lights flicker. Your phone hums in your hand. Somewhere in the static, a voice is trying to come through. Are you listening?
Ghost Hunting Tools is a full paranormal investigation kit running on your phone. Spirit box, EVP visualizer,
bluejetty:00063430:ios.description:
The lights flicker. Your phone hums in your hand. Somewhere in the static, a voice is trying to come through. Are you listening?
Ghost Hunting Tools is a full paranormal investigation kit running on your phone. Spirit box, EVP visualizer, ghost detector, and EMF meter, all in one app. Built for first-time ghost hunters and veteran investigators alike. Free to use, with a Pro upgrade when you are ready to dig deeper.
What's inside
Spirit Box and Ghost Talker
Open a session and the app scans for ghostly signals, pulling words from a curated dictionary in real time. Read them on screen, find every one again in your Word History, and watch as patterns start to form. The kind of one-word-at-a-time communication serious investigators look for, without the radio hiss.
EVP Visualizer
Watch the background static the app generates on its own (it never uses your microphone). When a signal is strong enough to become a word, darker bars rise: that is the EVP behind it. Some words you will write off as coincidence. Others will sit with you longer than you expected.
EMF Detector
A working EMF meter pulled straight from your phone's sensors. Watch the readings spike when something steps into the field. Cross-reference with the spirit box and you have two channels lining up at once.
Sensor Dashboard
EMF, pressure, vibration. Your phone has more paranormal-detection capability than most people realize, and the dashboard reads them side by side. The EMF Alarm sounds when the field rises or drops past your trigger level. Easy-to-follow graphs let you spot the moment everything goes quiet, right before it doesn't.
The Word Bank
A large dictionary of words the app surfaces during scans. No filler, no random noise for the sake of it. Just the vocabulary that paranormal investigators have reported reaching for them again and again. Pro unlocks a much bigger bank and lets you add your own words.
Pro Version
Remove ads, unlock the expanded dictionary, and add custom words of your own: names of the deceased, places of interest, anything you suspect might be listening. Pro purchases also fund continued development of the app, so the hunt keeps getting better because of the people who go pro.
Why people keep this app on their home screen
You do not have to believe in ghosts to enjoy Ghost Hunting Tools. You just have to be curious about what happens in the quiet moments. Open the app at a bonfire, in a basement, in an empty hotel room. Bring a friend. Tell us what you find.
Ghost hunt safely
Trust your instincts. Don't go alone to places you don't know. If something feels wrong, close the app and walk away. Tools are tools, and your judgment is what keeps you safe.
A note on entertainment
Ghost Hunting Tools is built for fun and curiosity. We can't promise you will talk to a real ghost. We can promise you will have a story.
Privacy Policy: https://weaseldev.com/privacy/ghosthunting.html
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Why people keep this app on their home screen

You do not have to believe in ghosts to enjoy Ghost Hunting Tools. You just have to be curious about what happens in the quiet moments. Open the app at a bonfire, in a basement, in an empty hotel room. Bring a friend. Tell us what you find.

Ghost hunt safely

Trust your instincts. Don't go alone to places you don't know. If something feels wrong, close the app and walk away. Tools are tools, and your judgment is what keeps you safe.

A note on entertainment

Ghost Hunting Tools is built for fun and curiosity. We can't promise you will talk to a real ghost. We can promise you will have a story.

bluejetty:00095136:ios.description:
Imagine your family’s next chapter with Family AI Studio.
Turn parent photos and ultrasound images into imaginative AI portraits, explore possible looks across different ages, create a grow-up video, and discover playful family insights—all in one creative studio.
CREATE FAMILY PORTRAITS
• Generate a future-baby portrait from parent photos
• Turn an ultrasound image into a creative baby portrait
• Bring everyone together in a future-family portrait
• Imagine a future sibling or a baby with the family pet
• Create shareable images for special moments
EXPLORE EVERY AGE
See an imaginative portrait at different stages of life, from baby and child to teenager and adult. You can also create a short grow-up video that brings the journey to life.
FIND A STYLE FOR EVERY STORY
Choose from everyday looks, school and seasonal themes, holiday cards, fantasy worlds, anime-inspired art, royal portraits, space adventures, and heritage-inspired styles.
ENJOY PLAYFUL AI INSIGHTS
• Compare a child’s visual resemblance to each parent
• Explore visible facial features and an apparent-age estimate

• Combine selected parent traits to explore possible outcomes
• Discover baby-name ideas with origins and meanings
• Create a playful zodiac profile from an expected due date
MADE FOR EASY CREATING
Clear photo guidance helps you choose suitable inputs. Generated results are stored in History on your device so you can revisit, save, share, or delete them.

Selected photos and ultrasound images are uploaded only when you request a generation. Family AI Studio’s own backend does not retain a server-side copy of uploaded or generated images after processing completes. OpenAI and fal.ai process the necessary inputs and may temporarily retain request data for security and service operation as explained in our Privacy Policy. bluejetty:00153687:ios.description:
Imagine a world where the zombies have taken over... but YOU are one of the last humans left! In this awesome action-packed game, you step into the boots of a brave survivor, fighting back against waves of super scary, super aggressive zombies who are hungry for one thing: BRAINS! (Ew, right?!)
But don’t worry - you’re not just running around with a stick. No way! You’ll get to upgrade your weapons, unlock crazy new ones, and build the ultimate zombie-smashing gear! Whether it’s a lightning blaster, freeze gun, or mega rocket launcher - you’re gonna need some serious firepower to stay alive!
This isn’t just one tiny level. Nope! You’ll move across a giant map filled with dangerous places, hidden secrets, and zombie hideouts. Beat levels to unlock new zones - like spooky forests, haunted cities, creepy labs, and more! Every area brings new challenges... and even bigger, badder zombies.
Here’s the cool part: you’re not just a fighter - you’re a thinker, too! Use points and parts you collect to research new weapons and tools. Maybe you’ll unlock a flamethrower, or even some robotic armor to help you take on those zombie bosses!
Your human isn’t just going into battle in PJs. You get to equip gear for your head, torso, arms, legs, feet, and hands. Want a helmet that gives you more defense? Or gloves that make you reload faster? What about super speedy boots or armor that shocks enemies when they hit you? You can mix and match gear to build your perfect zombie-fighting outfit!

bluejetty:00140164:ios.description:
Welcome to explore Dual App - Duo Web Scanner
Have you ever thought about:
Switch between multiple accounts on the same device freely?
Log in to the same account on multiple devices?
Now, with this app, you can do all this and more!
Just scan the QR code, you can quickly and easily connect to manage multiple accounts so that your life and work will not interfere with each other.
In addition, a password lock is added to the application to protect your privacy from leakage and provide high security.
Main Features:
- Dual Apps
Say goodbye to the trouble of switching between devices or accounts. With this application, you can effortlessly manage two accounts on one device, doubling your communication capabilities. Separate and organize personal and business conversations, all in one application.
- Built-in copywriting
When you use mainstream social software such as WhatsApp, you can communicate through built-in common phrases, celebrity quotes, and Kaomoji, instantly improving communication efficiency.
- Fast and stable connection
Scan the QR code in the dual app and you can easily log in to your account. Run smoothly after logging in, no need to worry about accidental logout.
- Chat Recovery:
Recover messages, photos, pictures, videos, audio, contacts, files, passwords from WhatsApp and other mainstream social software in just 2 simple steps.
Instant Sync Messages
You can read, reply and download all messages from cloned accounts, such as WhatsApp and other mainstream social software in real time. Never miss any messages.
- Sticker Maker
Unleash your creativity and personalize your chats with custom stickers. This intuitive sticker maker app allows you to create unique stickers with your own images, turning ordinary conversations into lively exchanges.
- Status Maker
With a rich font library and powerful editing functions, it is easy to create imaginative statuses to express yourself, allowing you to show your creativity and interact with contacts in a unique way.
- Beautiful Fonts
Provides a variety of text effects, just enter the text you want to get cool font effects.
- Text Maker
From multiple fonts and symbols to emoticons, this app has everything to make your profile more original and your messages more impactful.
- Direct Chat
Want to send a message, but found that he is not in your contacts? With Direct Chat, you can send messages directly without adding contacts.
- Passcode Lock
Protect your privacy with a digital passcode to ensure your messages are hidden from prying eyes.
Subscriptions:
If you subscribe through Apple, payment will be charged to your App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. bluejetty:00035699:ios.description:
PERSONALIZED DAILY VIDEO COACHING
Every day, you’ll receive a personalized video lesson & meditation from your Mindfulness Coach to give you practical tools for living a life with calm and ease.
SHORT MINDFULNESS PRACTICES. ANYTIME. ANYWHERE.
Explore our 1-2 minute long mindfulness micro-practices, breathing exercises and short meditations to provide you with in-the-moment support when you need it the most.
LEARN TO PRACTICE MINDFULNESS & MEDITATION
Join our community of over 1 million people transforming their lives by learning mindfulness, cultivating a habit of mindful meditation or deepening their practice of mindfulness with our mindfulness courses from world renowned mindfulness teachers.
REDUCE STRESS AND ANXIETY
Learn & practice a better way of living with 100s of talks, courses, micro-practices, guided meditations, music & soundscapes to reduce stress and anxiety, meditate and sleep better. Meditation sessions are available in lengths of 5, 10, 15 or 20 minutes so you can choose the perfect length.
IMPROVE YOUR SLEEP
Fall asleep fast and get better rest with our Sleep Shuffle, guided sleep meditations, sleep music and soothing nature soundscapes.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Track your Mindful Minutes within the Apple Health app.
MAKE A DIFFERENCE IN THE WORLD WITH YOUR PRACTICE
When you take a Mindfulness Plus subscription, we donate a portion of our revenue to non-profit organisations who are bringing mindfulness to people in need. To date, we’ve donated over $500,000 to mindfulness nonprofits around the world.
MEET YOUR HOSTS:
*Cory Muscara, MA - Mindfulness Advisor to The Dr. Oz Show. Instructor at University of Pennsylvania. Former Monk. Co-founder of Mindfulness.com
*Melli O’Brien - Speaker. Writer and Mindfulness Teacher. Co-founder of Mindfulness.com. Host of The Mindfulness Summit, the world's largest mindfulness conference.
MEET YOUR WORLD RENOWNED TEACHERS:
*Rhonda Magee, JD - Author. Professor of Law, University of San Francisco
*Shamash Alidina, MA - Teacher. Author of Mindfulness for Dummies
*Kelly Boys - Author. Mindfulness Trainer for the United Nations
*Vidyamala Burch - Author. Pain & illness Specialist. Founder of Breathworks
*Mark Coleman - Mindfulness Teacher. Wilderness guide and author.
*Rich Fernandez - the CEO of the Search Inside Yourself Leadership Institute.
MINDFUL MEDITATION & TALKS ABOUT MINDFUL LIVING
*Jon Kabat-Zinn, PhD - Professor of Medicine. Bestselling author. Founder of MBSR.
*Tara Brach, PhD - Mindfulness Teacher. Psychologist and bestselling author.
*Sharon Salzberg - New York Times bestselling author.
*Jack Kornfield, PhD - Mindfulness Teacher. Bestselling Author 12+ books.
*Dan Siegel, MD - Bestselling author. Director UCLA Mindful Research Center.
*Judson Brewer, MD - Psychiatrist. Director of Research, Center for Mindfulness.
*Elisha Goldstein, PhD - Author. Founder, Center for Mindful Living LA.
*Mark Williams, Phd - Professor. Director of Oxford University’s Mindfulness Center.
We believe training your mind is the single greatest investment you can make in life and everyone has the right to the healing power of a mindfulness practice — and money should never be the reason why someone can't access the tools, support, and community to benefit from it. With Mindfulness.com, if you can't afford a Mindfulness Plus subscription, please send us an email, and we will unlock a free year for you to enjoy.

Welcome to Shadow Slayer! Join our heroes' adventure in Foliga, a once happy and peaceful world turned dark. Undead bosses are now crowding everywhere. But this will end now! Stock up on epic hero powers to start the battle of the century today! 
Unlock your potential and learn new skills to battle monsters while exploring all the possibilities of this new and exciting action hack and slash game!
Grab your weapons and friends to join this exciting anime fighting RPG now! You will find it full of opportunities to battle fierce enemies, unlock skills, and power up your hero to the max! Grow stronger every day and battle the undead bosses of Foliga in this legendary battle!

Tons of different monsters and bosses are waiting for you in the dungeons! Go into training to prepare yourself, challenge them to a battle, and show off your fighting skills!

Players will get to play as multiple different characters, each with their own unique skills, gameplay, and assets. Each character is going to have a distinct way to play the game and a distinct approach to the strategy and the combat.
- MYSTERIOUS TREASURE CHESTS
Discover hidden treasures everywhere, you need to be observant to find them. Do not miss a treasure, because they are very valuable.
Play anytime, anywhere, even when offline.

apple-macos:1585359750.name: Molly - Shop smarter. Pay less
apple-macos:1585359750.description:
Automatic price check
Molly automatically checks the price of the product you're looking at. If you can save money on other webshops, you’ll get direct links to the cheapest option.
Automatic discount check
Have you noticed that almost all webshops have a discount code field? Molly automatically finds and applies discount codes for you and keeps the one that gives you the biggest savings. No more wasting time searching for doubtful codes. Molly works in more than 25,000 webshops, and we’re constantly adding new ones.
Price alerts
Is the item lovely but too expensive? Let Molly track price drops and notify you as soon as the price fits your budget. You can also track price drops on wishlists shared by friends and family.
Help to save
In some situations, Molly gives a discreet tip on where you can save the most. Even when you search on Google, Molly highlights where you can get extra discounts.
Save favourites
You can easily add your favourite products to your own lists. If you're looking for a new bike, create a list of all the ones you’re considering. Molly gives you an overview and finds the lowest prices for each of your favourites.
Share wishlists
When you see an item you want, add it to your wishlist with one click and share it with friends and family. They can reserve items so you get exactly what you want.
Safety
Have you ever discovered bad shop ratings too late? Molly automatically shows you reviews before you shop. With Molly installed, you can shop more safely. Help us warn others about scams – write to kontakt@mollyapp.dk
Search & save
Molly gives you a shortcut to find the cheapest prices on the product you’re considering. You might even save more with a discount code.
Visibility
As your shopping assistant, Molly is always within reach. Important messages pop up automatically – otherwise, click the icon for info. Molly automatically minimizes when you continue on the webshop.
One-click copy
If Molly can’t test the discount codes herself, you can always try them manually. Just tap the code to copy it automatically, then paste it into the discount code field.
Sharing discount codes
If you have a discount code you want to share with other users, you can email it to us at kontakt@mollyapp.dk
 or enter it in the webshop’s discount field, and Molly will ask if you want to share it.
Follow webshops
Click the heart when visiting your favourite webshop. Molly will let you know when new discount codes can save you money. Keep an eye on the NEW icon so you don’t miss a good deal.
Made for you
Molly expands automatically with information useful to most users. If certain message types aren’t your style, you can disable them in the settings – for example reviews or helpful tips.

IMPORT FROM ALMOST ANYWHERE
- Websites: paste or share a link. Most recipe sites import in seconds.
- Social media: share a post or video link. Where a platform doesn't make the recipe available, paste the caption or add a screenshot instead.
- Photos and scans: take a photo of a recipe card or cookbook page. The text is read on your device, and the photo itself never leaves it.
- Documents: PDF, Word, text and HTML files.
- Or type a recipe in yourself.
NOTHING MADE UP
If a recipe doesn't say how much, how long or how many it serves, azest4food leaves it blank rather than guessing. Parts it is unsure about are marked for you to check. Duplicates are spotted before you save them twice.
A COOKBOOK THAT WORKS
- Search across titles, ingredients, notes and tags.
- Favourites and collections.
- Scale servings while you cook.
- Works offline: browse, search and edit without a connection, and your changes sync when you're back online. If the same recipe was changed on two devices, you choose which version to keep.
- Built for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a side-by-side view, keyboard shortcuts and a menu bar on larger screens.
FREE AND PREMIUM
The Free plan includes unlimited recipes you add yourself, website imports, search, favourites, collections, syncing across your devices and 10 AI-assisted imports a month.
Premium raises that to 200 AI-assisted imports a month and lets you save your whole cookbook as a PDF. Premium is a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. If you cancel, you keep every recipe.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your cookbook is private to you. No ads and no tracking. AI-assisted imports send only the recipe text to our AI provider, never your name or e-mail address.
